izzyondroid:de.badaix.snapcast.name: Snapcast - multi-room audio in perfect sync
izzyondroid:de.badaix.snapcast.description:
Snapcast is a Snapcast control client and player for Android. It uses the Snapcast JSON-RPC API to control your synchronous multi-room audio player.
 This App is not meant for productive use and will only run when you have a Snapserver installed in your local network.
 Snapcast is a multi-room client-server audio player, where all clients are time synchronized with the server to play perfectly synced audio. It’s not a standalone player, but an extension that turns your existing audio player into a Sonos-like multi-room solution.
 The server’s audio input is a named pipe /tmp/snapfifo . All data that is fed into this file will be send to the connected clients. One of the most generic ways to use Snapcast is in conjunction with the music player daemon (MPD) or Mopidy, which can be configured to use a named pipe as audio output.

izzyondroid:me.d3sox.betternetworktiles..name: Better Network Tiles

izzyondroid:me.d3sox.betternetworktiles..description:
NOTE: This app requires shell access, which can be granted using either Shizuku or root.
 This application aims to improve various network related quick-settings tiles.
 It adds an alternative unified internet tile. Next to this, separate Wi-Fi and mobile data tiles are also available if you just want to go back to the behavior of Android 11 or lower.
 And just in case your ROM doesn't support it there are tiles for NFC, Airplane mode and Bluetooth too.
 Tapping the new alternative internet tile will simply toggle between Wi-Fi and mobile data. This reduces the amount of taps needed from 3 (tap tile, disable Wi-Fi, enable data) to just 1 quick tap. In situations where you still want more control, long pressing the tile will redirect you to the relevant settings page.
 This has been tested and confirmed working on Pixel devices running Android 12, 13 and 14, but other devices will probably work too.

fdroid:com.martinmimigames.littlemusicpl.name: Little Music Player
fdroid:com.martinmimigames.littlemusicpl.summary: Android 1.0+ mini notification based audio player
fdroid:com.martinmimigames.littlemusicpl.description:
This project is a light-weight, simple, yet compatible audio player.
Supports Android 1.0+
It allows you to play audio and video files, like how you expected to. Most importantly it is designed in hope to make it compatible with different Android versions.
Its usage is as easy as opening or sharing the file you want to play with the app, or selecting it directly from the app. Enjoy your music!
Note that this project was originally known as simple music player.
Currently partially support m3u/m3u8 playlist files. More information below in section Playlist Support.
You can find most information about Little Music Player just below.
Different variations
- Tiny Music Player https://github.com/martinmimigames/tiny-music-player
 Smallest, most minimal, with the trade-off of only having the most basic features.
Playlist support
- Folder-based playlist on Android 5.0+
- Temporary playlist via multi-share function
- Partial m3u/m3u8 support
m3u/m3u8 features supported:
- Audio stream url (http/https)
- Absolute audio path (e.g. /storage/emulated/0/Music/Example.mp3)
- Nested m3u/m3u8 files (Absolute path only)
- Custom audio name via "#EXTINF: [duration], [custom name]" , does not support duration
Features
- It's free
 Everyone should have the right to listen to music, therefore we aim to make it accessible.
- No advertisement
 We simply want a distraction-free experience for you, so you can relax and enjoy!
- Compact
 Less than half a MB in size, one of the tiniest audio player apps on Android! No need to worry about bloated apps again. (Currently less than 30 KB)
- Unbelievably compatible
 Strangely addicted to support, we believe that nobody should be excluded due to an older device. Therefore we have theoretical support starting all the way back from Android 1.0, and tested support on Android 2.3 and above. Isn't it amazing?
- Clean & Simple
 No awkward layout, no hidden options and straightforward, so you can focus on the content. Enjoyment is key, right?
- It simply works :)
 Even in the modern world, there is always something seeming to fail. Luckily for you, this app was designed to work just like it is supposed to. It supports all audio types that your device supports.
- Minimal permissions required
 Have you ever met an app asking for a bunch of unrelated permissions? Have you ever had some strange requests reminding you of a malware? Not this app! We will explain how we use all our permissions, so you know it's safe to use.
- No hidden third-parties
 It is completely open-source, and uses as little third-party libraries as possible.
If you worry about size, compatibility or privacy, this is the best app for you!
We use the foreground service permission to provide audio playing while using other apps.
We use the notification permission for displaying playback control, as we are mainly a notification
based music player.
We use the internet permission to allow for audio streaming, however such function is still being
developed, and can be very buggy.
We use the read storage/audio/video permission to open the audio files. Required for older devices, and m3u/m3u8 processing.
(Beta function)
Share a url containing a media file to Little Music Player to stream it.
Or use a m3u file with the stream url inside.
Issues
Issues and pull requests are always welcome!
Since we do not have telemetry in the app, we rely on you to report issues and give feedback.
You can submit issues the following ways:
- via Github issues at https://github.com/martinmimigames/little-music-player/issues
- via email: martinmimigames@gmail.com
Made by Martinmimigames
Official website at https://martinmimigames.github.io
Last update of Description:
- 20-07-2023 dd-mm-yyyy
Important:
- Please read the license!

fdroid:io.github.munzzyy.magpie.name: Magpie
fdroid:io.github.munzzyy.magpie.summary: Tamper-evident incident journal with encrypted, self-proving exports
fdroid:io.github.munzzyy.magpie.description:
People document disputes with a camera roll and a notes app, and months
later it proves nothing: files re-save, dates shift, entries vanish.
Magpie is an incident journal with receipts:
* Every entry (photo, note, file) is hash-chained to the one before it.
 Edit, reorder, or delete anything and the chain breaks visibly.
* Everything is encrypted on your device with your passphrase. Locked
 means unreadable, including to the app.
* Exports are plain zips carrying your files, the chain manifest, and a
 small python script anyone can run to verify the record without Magpie.
* Share the one-line head hash early (email it to yourself, send it to
 someone you trust) and the whole record is pinned to that moment.
This app requests no permissions. Photos come through the system camera,
and the operating system refuses every network connection. No accounts,
no analytics, no dependencies. GPL-3.0-or-later licensed.
Honest limits: tamper-evident is not court-admissible by itself, device
timestamps are claims until anchored, and there is no passphrase
recovery on purpose.
Runs on Android 9 and newer, with Android System WebView 84 or newer.
Android 9 has had no security fixes since January 2022, so on a phone that
old Magpie works, but the phone itself is easier to break into.

fdroid:io.github.yazanj082.momiji.name: Momiji
fdroid:io.github.yazanj082.momiji.summary: Unofficial Remote Play: play your PS5 or PS4 on Android, at home and away
fdroid:io.github.yazanj082.momiji.description:
Momiji streams games from your PS5 or PS4 to your Android phone, tablet, TV box or Samsung DeX, at home or away. It's free and open source, with no ads or tracking.
 Easy to set up 
• Finds the consoles on your network and wakes them up from rest mode.
• Registration in three explained steps. Sign in with Sony in your browser (or inside Momiji on devices without one), and Momiji fills in your Account ID for you. Passkeys work too.
 Play anywhere 
• Away from home, your consoles connect through PlayStation Network once you sign in with Sony.
• Play a console in one tap from shortcuts, a Quick Settings tile, a widget or the Android TV home screen.
• Picture-in-picture keeps the stream going in a small window when you leave the app.
 Play with a real controller 
• DualSense, DualShock 4, Xbox and other controllers, with rumble.
• Button mapping, stick dead zone and a test for each controller, and its battery level in the stream menu.
• DualSense touch haptics on the controller's own actuators over USB, its light bar, gyro and touchpad.
• On-screen controls for touch, hidden while a controller is connected.
• On dual-screen handhelds like the AYN Thor, the second screen becomes the touchpad, with the PS, Create and Options buttons.
 Great picture, low latency 
• Up to 1080p at 60 fps, with H.264 or HEVC and up to 100 Mbps.
• Quality presets: Smooth, Balanced or Sharp, also for each console.
• Super resolution sharpens the stream on screens with more pixels than it, like a phone's or a 4K TV.
• Hardware decoding in low latency mode, with the display's refresh rate matched to the stream.
• An optional filter against color banding in dark scenes.
 For the living room 
• Works with a TV remote or controller on Android TV boxes, and can start right into Momiji.
• In Samsung DeX, the stream fills the TV, with its sound on the TV.
In English and Arabic.
Before you start, turn on Remote Play on your console: Settings → System → Remote Play on a PS5, or Settings → Remote Play Connection Settings on a PS4.
Momiji is based on Chiaki and chiaki-ng, and is licensed under the AGPL-3.0. Its source code is at github.com/yazanj082/momiji.
Momiji is an unofficial app and is not endorsed or certified by Sony Interactive Entertainment. PlayStation, PS4, PS5, DualShock and DualSense are trademarks of Sony Interactive Entertainment LLC.

apple-itunes:1567437057.description:
Organic Maps is a fast, detailed offline map and GPS navigation app for travel, hikes, and rides. Plan, import, and record routes, and enjoy smooth guidance without draining your battery or using an internet connection. Explore places and navigate safely during your outdoor adventures and travels around the world. The app offers unlimited map downloads and updates every two weeks. OpenStreetMap-based, volunteer-made, privacy-first, 100% offline, and 100% free.
OFFLINE: The app works 100% offline — including search and navigation. You can explore the map and navigate without an internet connection, saving on mobile data and roaming fees. And with no background data transfers, your battery lasts much longer.
FAST: Zooming, search, and route calculations work noticeably fast.
DETAILED & UPDATED: The maps are rich in detail and refreshed twice a month to reflect real-world conditions. Unlike many well-known competitors, they include building labels, benches, hiking paths, and other helpful information.
OPENSTREETMAP-BASED: OpenStreetMap is a wiki-style world map built and maintained by millions of volunteers — locals who know their areas best. This community effort results in highly detailed maps, often more accurate than commercial ones in less-mapped regions. Organic Maps updates its data from OpenStreetMap every two weeks, keeping your maps fresh and reliable. And if you notice something missing, you can add it to OpenStreetMap and help improve the map for everyone.
PRIVACY-FIRST: We don’t collect any data or identifiers. This means there’s no risk of data leaks and no distractions like ads or noisy notifications — just a clean, private map experience.
IMPORTANT FEATURES
EXPLORE PLACES: Search by address, name, or category, discover millions of POIs, and view detailed information such as opening hours, Wikipedia articles, wheelchair accessibility, and other helpful details. All available offline.
GPS NAVIGATION: Enjoy voice-guided, turn-by-turn directions. Create walking, hiking, cycling, or driving routes — including routes between cities, countries, and multiple waypoints. CarPlay is supported.
HIKING & CYCLING TRAILS FROM AROUND THE WORLD: Enable special map layers to discover popular hiking and cycling routes worldwide, all sourced from OpenStreetMap. Switch between layers to see colored bike and MTB routes, as well as official hiking paths.
3D TERRAIN & DEPTHS: See shaded relief, ocean and sea depths, and detailed contour lines. Tap anywhere on the map to see elevation.
PUBLIC TRANSPORT: Plan subway, light rail, bus and tram routes; see line numbers at stops. Live timetables are in development.
MAP STYLES: Choose map layers that fit your activity — Outdoors, Contour Lines, Hiking, Cycling, or Metro/Subway.
TRACK RECORDER: Record, import, export, and share your routes and favorite places. Supports KML, KMZ, GPX, and GeoJSON formats.
WIKIPEDIA ARTICLES: Explore Wikipedia articles for places you discover on the map. Type “?wiki” in the search to find all places with Wikipedia articles.
MAP EDITOR: Contribute to OpenStreetMap by adding missing places or editing the map directly from Organic Maps.
DARK MODE: Switch to a dark theme for comfortable viewing at night.
iCLOUD SYNC: Easily back up and sync all your bookmarks and tracks via iCloud.
Try the app — it’s 100% free, ad-free, fast, and fully offline. Enjoy a fast, reliable, and private map experience, and share it with others!

apple-macos:6824530356.name: FootPrints: Travel Map
apple-macos:6824530356.description:
FootPrints colors the countries and regions you've visited on a clean world map, using the location data already stored in your photos.
- Automatic, from your photos
FootPrints reads only the location and capture date of your photos and videos to find where they were taken. New ones are picked up automatically each time you open the app.
- Color for "when", shade for "how much"
Older first visits appear blue, recent ones orange. The more photos you took somewhere, the deeper the color. Switch to year-only or count-only views anytime.
- Where you took your photos
Show the places you took photos as small red dots on the map. Tap a dot to see the photos taken there and the trips they belong to.
- Satellite and plain map
See your colored countries over satellite imagery and zoom down to the streets, or switch to a clean plain map that also works offline. Toggle between a flat map and a globe you can spin with your finger, complete with the current day/night line.
- Zoom from countries to regions
Zoom into any country you've visited and the borders smoothly switch to its states, provinces, or prefectures.
- Trips, made for you
Your photos are grouped into trips by date and place. See the cities you stopped in, follow each trip's route on the map, turn it into a video where the map follows your path, or look back day by day on a calendar. Add titles and notes to trips and days.
- Trip journal
Each trip opens with a cover photo and goes day by day, with that day's places, notes and photos. Add a caption to any photo.
- Trip Album
Put a trip's title, dates, map and route, places, notes and photos on one page, and share it as an image or PDF.
- Year in Review and badges
Sum up each year's places and trips in a single image to share, and collect badges like "10 countries" and "All 6 continents".
- Replay your travels
Press play on the year slider and watch the countries fill in, year by year.
- No photos? Add them anyway
Mark places you visited without photos, like childhood trips. They appear hatched and sync between your iPhone and iPad via iCloud.
- Places you want to go
Mark countries you want to visit next. They appear on the map with a dashed outline.
- Share your map
Turn your travel map and stats into a single image and send it to friends.
- Compare with family and friends
Overlay your map with people you invite to see the countries you've both visited and the ones only they have. Sharing uses iCloud, and you choose what each group, such as “Family” or “Friends”, can see. Photos and notes are never shared.
- Fix wrong locations
Photos with a wrong location, like ones others sent you, can be left out of your totals with a long press.
- Widgets and Siri
Keep your world map, this year's travels and trips from this day in past years on your Home Screen and Lock Screen. Or just ask Siri, “How many countries have I visited in FootPrints”.
- Statistics
See countries visited, progress by continent, new places per year, and your most photographed places.
- Private by design
All photo processing happens on your device, and your photos are never uploaded. For satellite imagery and city names, the area you're viewing and the locations of your stops are sent to Apple's map service (not when Satellite is off). Nothing is sent to the developer. No ads, no tracking.

apple-macos:6751715860.name: PDF Scanner | Document Scan
apple-macos:6751715860.description:
How do you turn a stack of receipts into organized digital files? What about converting handwritten notes into searchable PDFs? Document Scanner uses advanced image processing and optical character recognition to transform any paper document into high-quality digital files you can search, share, and store.
Whether you are digitizing business receipts for tax season, converting meeting notes for team sharing, or archiving important contracts, this scanner handles everything from single pages to multi-page documents with automatic edge detection and perspective correction.
HOW IT WORKS
The app captures documents using your phone camera with enhanced image stabilization and lighting adjustment. Advanced algorithms automatically detect document edges, correct perspective distortion, and enhance text clarity. The OCR engine processes text in over 50 languages, making scanned content fully searchable. Processing happens locally on your device for privacy, with results available in seconds.
KEY FEATURES
— Automatic Edge Detection: Point your camera at any document and watch as the app instantly identifies borders, even on cluttered desks or uneven surfaces.
— Perspective Correction: The app automatically straightens skewed pages and adjusts for camera angle, producing professional-looking scans every time.
— OCR Text Recognition: Scanned documents become searchable with optical character recognition that works on printed text, handwriting, and even faded documents.
— Multi-Page PDF Creation: Combine multiple scans into single PDF documents with consistent formatting. Perfect for contracts, reports, or any multi-page paperwork.
— Cloud Integration: Save directly to iCloud, Google Drive, Dropbox, or OneDrive. Access your scanned documents from any device, anywhere.
WHO USES THIS APP
Small business owners who need to digitize receipts, invoices, and contracts for accounting and record-keeping. Students and researchers who want to convert textbook pages, handwritten notes, and research materials into searchable digital libraries. Remote workers who need to share physical documents with team members instantly. Homeowners managing important documents like insurance policies, warranties, and legal papers.
HOW TO GET STARTED
1. Open the app and position your document on a flat surface with good lighting
2. Tap the camera button and let auto-detection frame your document
3. Review the scan, choose PDF or JPEG format and add to your document library
For best results, ensure documents are flat and well-lit. The app works in various lighting conditions but performs optimally with natural light or bright indoor lighting.
SUBSCRIPTION
Annual Plan: $19.99 per year — less than $2 per month
Weekly Plan: $4.99 per week with 3-day free trial
Payment charged to App Store account upon purchase confirmation. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is disabled at least 24 hours before current period ends. Manage subscriptions in Account Settings. Unused free trial forfeited upon subscription purchase.

flathub:io.github.bkbilly.lnxlink.name: LNXlink
flathub:io.github.bkbilly.lnxlink.description:
LNXlink is a Linux companion app that seamlessly integrates your system with external applications like Home Assistant. It uses MQTT, a lightweight messaging protocol, to enable real-time data exchange and remote control capabilities.
 Features:
 Sensors: Automatically discover sensors that monitor and control the system.
 Home Assistant: Uses MQTT Autodiscovery to create entities and shows if update is required.
 No sudo required: No need to be root user to install and use, unless used on server setup.
 Easily expanded: Any new module is automatically imported and custom modules can be added.

flathub:io.github.dfandrich.gpscorrelate.name: GPS Correlate
flathub:io.github.dfandrich.gpscorrelate.description: GPS Correlate takes a GPS track stored by any of a number of GPS devices and phone apps and correlates the time stamp of a digital photo with the location of the track at that same moment. The location of the image is then stamped directly into the image file using the appropriate EXIF GPS tags. The resulting image then contains not just the time the photo was taken but its exact location, too. The location is used by various other applications and services (such as Google Photos) to display a map of where the photo was taken.

flathub:io.github.dummerle.rare.name: Rare
flathub:io.github.dummerle.rare.summary: Games launcher for Epic Games Store
flathub:io.github.dummerle.rare.description:
Rare is a frontend for legendary-gl, an open source alternative for
 the Epic Games Launcher.
 Why Rare?
 Tries to be as lightweight as we can make it while still offering a feature-full experience
 Supports all major platforms (Windows, Linux, Mac)
 Gets out of your way when you don't need it, allowing you to enjoy your games
 Rare supports all core features from the Epic Games Launcher,
 like installing and launching games, also many options to launch
 games with compatibility tools.

flathub:io.github.gillesdegottex.FMIT.name: FMIT
flathub:io.github.gillesdegottex.FMIT.summary: Free Musical Instrument Tuner (FMIT), a Tool for tuning musical instrument
flathub:io.github.gillesdegottex.FMIT.description:
Find an estimation of the fundamental frequency (f0, not the perceived pitch) 
 of an audio signal, in real-time, and compare it with the closest note in the 
 scale.
 Tune your musical instruments with advanced features, including traces of 
 frequency and volume, adjustable base tuning frequency, multiple choices of 
 tuning scale (chromatic, Werckmeister III, Kirnberger III, diatonic and 
 meantone), microtonal tuning with Scala file (.scl) support and statistics.
 Perform real-time sound analysis with views for waveform period, harmonics 
 amplitude and Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT). Change various analysis 
 parameters and tradeoff between precision and speed.
 Choose between multiple sound capture systems, including ALSA and JACK.
 Show or hide individual panels and go from a simple analog tuner view to an 
 advanced real-time analysis toolset, or anywhere in between.

flathub:io.github.gnoooo.typst-ide.name: Typst IDE
flathub:io.github.gnoooo.typst-ide.description:
Typst IDE is a local editor for Typst. Write documents in a modern editor with live preview,
 and keep your files on your own machine: no account, no cloud, no browser.
 Features include:
 Live preview rendered by the same compiler as Typst.app
 Click in the preview to jump to the matching source position
 Preview automatically follows the editor cursor
 Project file manager with drag & drop, imports and images
 Markers (TODO, FIXME, …) highlighted in the editor, with a marker book
 Global and per-project notes, templates, history
 PDF export, bibliography helpers, configuration import/export
 JSON themes with light and dark variants

flathub:io.github.gopher64.gopher64.name: Gopher64
flathub:io.github.gopher64.gopher64.summary: Highly compatible N64 emulator, built-in netplay
flathub:io.github.gopher64.gopher64.description:
Gopher64 is an open-source Nintendo 64 emulator written in Rust. Although it is the successor
 to Simple64, Gopher64 was written from scratch. Where it made sense, portions of the code were
 adapted or inspired by existing elements in Simple64/Mupen64Plus and ares. Gopher64 does not use
 any per-game hacks or settings, and it does not use plugins.

flathub:io.github.ksharindam.chemcanvas.name: ChemCanvas
flathub:io.github.ksharindam.chemcanvas.description:
A very intuitive and easy to use 2D chemical structure drawing tool.
 You can draw molecules and reactions, mechanisms, generate SMILES, save drawings as PNG or SVG. Or you can calculate various properties of molecules.
 Features :
 Supports most popular file formats
 Supports modern file formats like Marvin MRV, Chemdraw CDXML
 Export to PNG, SVG, and Editable SVG
 Many bond types including wavy bond, Cis/Trans, Bold double, Any Bond etc
 Aromaticity detection and add delocalization ring
 Search and load structure from PubChem
 Reagent bottle label printing tool

flathub:io.github.prateekmedia.appimagep.name: AppImage Pool
flathub:io.github.prateekmedia.appimagep.description:
Simple AppImageHub Client
 Main Highlights:
 Simplified categories
 Download from github directly, no extra-server involved
 Integrate and Disintegrate appimages easily from your system
 Version History and multi download support
 FLOSS and non profit app

flathub:io.github.realgarit.PKHeX-Avalon.name: PKHeX-Avalonia
flathub:io.github.realgarit.PKHeX-Avalon.description:
Open a save from the main series games, from Red and Blue through Legends: Z-A, and change Pokémon,
 boxes, the party, items and trainer details. Each Pokémon gets a legality check, so you can spot
 problems before you save.
 Game-specific editors cover Pokédex progress, events, raids, fashion, mystery gifts and more.
 Changes stay in the app until you save, and the previous file is backed up automatically.
 PKHeX-Avalonia is a fan project built on the PKHeX engine. It is not affiliated with Nintendo,
 Game Freak or The Pokémon Company.

flathub:io.github.tyleruploads.mdez.name: MDEZ++
flathub:io.github.tyleruploads.mdez.description: MDEZ++ (mdez) is an open-source, lightweight, cross-platform C++20 and Qt GUI Markdown editor. Instead of a WYSIWYG editor, MDEZ++ renders a real-time live preview of your text in a split-screen pane using a fast, native, and minimal GUI. MDEZ++ can also edit any text-based file format, including HTML, plain text, and code files, making it highly versatile.

flathub:io.gitlab.zulfian1732.jollpi-tex.name: Jollpi
flathub:io.gitlab.zulfian1732.jollpi-tex.description:
Jollpi is a lightweight text editor focused on simplicity and native GTK integration.
 The application applies a custom GTK styling to maintain a consistent visual appearance across different environments.
 Key features:
 Modern GTK4-based interface
 Syntax highlighting for many programming and markup languages
 Multi-tab and multi-window editing for working with multiple files
 Find & Replace, Go to Line, and fast navigation tools
 Automatic file change detection and reload
 Customizable fonts, themes, and wrap mode
 Mini map, line numbers, auto-bracket and auto-indent

flathub:io.otsaloma.nfoview.name: NFO Viewer
flathub:io.otsaloma.nfoview.description:
NFO Viewer is a simple viewer for NFO files, which are "ASCII"
 art in the CP437 codepage. The advantages of using NFO Viewer
 instead of a text editor are preset font and encoding settings,
 automatic window size and clickable hyperlinks.

flathub:net.tidycustoms.Publii.name: Publii
flathub:net.tidycustoms.Publii.summary: Static CMS for privacy-focused, SEO-optimized websites
flathub:net.tidycustoms.Publii.description:
Publii is a desktop-based CMS for Windows, Mac and Linux that makes creating static websites fast and hassle-free, even for beginners.
 Unlike static-site generators that are often unwieldy and difficult to use, Publii provides an easy-to-understand UI much like server-based CMSs such as WordPress or Joomla!, where users can create posts and other site content, and style their site using a variety of built-in themes and options. Users can enjoy the benefits of a super-fast and secure static website, with all the convenience that a CMS provides.
 What makes Publii even more unique is that the app runs locally on your desktop rather than on the site's server. Available for Windows, Mac, Linux once the app has been installed you can create a site in minutes, even without internet access; since Publii is a desktop app you can create, update and modify your site offline, then upload the site changes to your server at the click of a button. Publii supports multiple upload options, including standard HTTP/HTTPS servers, Netlify, Amazon S3, GitHub Pages and Google Cloud or SFTP.

flathub:net.zdechov.app.xTactics.name: xTactics
flathub:net.zdechov.app.xTactics.description:
It is a highly configurable turn-based strategy game inspired by mechanics of Risk board game.
 Features:
 Zoom-able map.
 Map can be generated in cyclic mode to simulate world without borders.
 Application configuration stored in XML file.
 Allows to save and load game to game file in XML format with extension .xtg.
 Localization support (English, Czech)
 High DPI support.
 Multiple map cell shapes as hexagons, squares, triangles, isometric, and random mesh.
 Bridges between remote cells visible as lines.
 Multiple players support. Players can have different color and other starting properties.
 Application automatically open saved game file given as command line parameter after execution.
 Computer player settings to be low, medium or highly aggressive in attacking.
 Use Shift key during mouse click to attack maximum available power is moved without dialog confirmation.
 Use Control key during mouse click to move with maximum one time and repeated unit counts to selected target cell.
 Game option "Fog of war" which cause map to be covered to black and only explored cells will be visible.
 Auto save game to file option in settings.
 Map shape can be selected as Rectangular, Rounded or mask from image file.
 Support for symmetric map usable for two players game.
 Confirmation dialog for ending game.
 Support for switching large icons in toolbar.
 Support for cities. Cities can configured to be used as only growing cells.
 Allows to set grow rate as square root of cell power.
 Amount of inaccessible cells can be adjusted in New game dialog.
 Player mode human or computer.
 Graph window can be shown from menu which presents development of various statistic values during game turns.
 Load recent menu action to load recently opened/saved files.

flathub:org._2009scape.Launcher.name: 2009scape
flathub:org._2009scape.Launcher.description:

flathub:org.freeciv.sdl2.name: Freeciv SDL2 client
flathub:org.freeciv.sdl2.summary: SDL2 based client for the Freeciv game
flathub:org.freeciv.sdl2.description:
Freeciv is a Free and Open Source empire-building strategy game inspired by the history of human
 civilization. The game commences in prehistory and your mission is to lead your tribe from the
 Stone Age to the Space Age...
 This client for connecting to network games, or to launch local single-player games, is based
 on SDL2.

flathub:org.nsnam.NetAnim.name: NetAnim
flathub:org.nsnam.NetAnim.description:

flathub:xyz.rescribe.rescribe.name: Rescribe
flathub:xyz.rescribe.rescribe.summary: OCR images, PDFs and Google Books
flathub:xyz.rescribe.rescribe.description: An easy-to-use desktop tool to recognise and extract text from images, PDFs and Google Books. It uses the Tesseract OCR engine, combined with modern and efficient preprocessing and analysis pipelines, to produce high quality output in plain text, hOCR and searchable PDF format. The tool has been built with a focus on OCR of historical printed works, but it includes modern language options and also works well on modern printed works.

fedora-packages:android-tools/android-to.name: android-tools

These commands are what is called a 'service' in ADB. Fastboot is used to manipulate the flash partitions of the Android phone. It can also boot the phone using a kernel image or root filesystem image which reside on the host machine rather than in the phone flash. In order to use it, it is important to understand the flash partition layout for the phone. The fastboot program works in conjunction with firmware on the phone to read and write the flash partitions. It needs the same USB device setup between the host and the target phone as adb.

fedora-packages:coin-or-Bonmin/coin-or-B.description: Bonmin (Basic Open-source Nonlinear Mixed INteger programming) is an experimental open-source C++ code for solving general MINLP (Mixed Integer NonLinear Programming) problems of the form: min f(x) s.t. g_L <= g(x) <= g_U x_L <= x <= x_U x_i in Z for all i in I and, x_i in R for all i not in I. where f(x): R^n --> R, g(x): R^n --> R^m are twice continuously differentiable functions and I is a subset of {1,..,n}. Bonmin features several algorithms * B-BB is a NLP-based branch-and-bound algorithm, * B-OA is an outer-approximation decomposition algorithm, * B-QG is an implementation of Quesada and Grossmann's branch-and-cut algorithm, * B-Hyb is a hybrid outer-approximation based branch-and-cut algorithm. The algorithms in Bonmin are exact when the functions f and g are convex; in the case where f or g or both are non-convex they are heuristics.

firefox-addons:909373.name: Auto Tab Discard
firefox-addons:909373.summary: Increase browser speed and reduce memory load and when you have numerous open tabs.
firefox-addons:909373.description:
"Auto Tab Discard" is a lightweight browser extension that automatically reduces the amount of memory used by open but inactive tabs, helping to conserve battery life on portable devices by disabling JavaScript code and DOM events on discarded tabs.
Preview:
 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ityhxUPp3y8 
Instruction:
There are two options on the extension's interface to either discard tabs or release discarding (the "x" buttons)
The features of "Auto Tab Discard" are:
 * Improves browser performance and reduces memory usage by automatically or manually discarding inactive, idle, or forgotten tabs.
 * Includes a list of hostnames or regular expressions that can be excluded from auto-discarding.
 * Preserves the discarded state of tabs when the browser is closed and reopened.
 * Indicates the discarded state of a tab through the favicon or title.
 * Restores the state of a tab, including scroll position and text box content, after it is released from being discarded.
 * Allows for the forced discarding of specified hostnames.
The options for configuring whether tabs should be discarded or not include:
 * Pinned tabs
 * Tabs that are playing media
 * The presence of a power source
 * Unsaved content or user input in a tab
The available plugins for "Auto Tab Discard" are:
 * Release the discarded state of the next or previous tab.
 * Release the discarded state of all tabs in the active window.
 * Automatically discard all newly opened inactive tabs.
 * Store YouTube's timestamp before a tab is discarded.
 * Permanently delete (remove) old discarded tabs that are inactive.
Notes:
 * Unlike the "The Great Suspender" extension, this extension uses the native method for discarding tabs, which means that even if the extension is removed or the browser crashes, your browser will automatically restore everything for you.
Privacy Policy:
 https://webextension.org/privacy-policy/extension/tab-discard.html

firefox-addons:2939723.description:
GuardRail Browser Security provides enterprise-grade protection against malicious websites, phishing attempts, and online threats using advanced AI technology.
KEY FEATURES:
✓ Real-time threat detection using local AI models
✓ Privacy-focused - minimal data transmission
✓ Instant blocking of detected threats
✓ Customizable whitelist for trusted sites
✓ Monitor mode for testing without blocking
✓ Lightweight and fast - minimal performance impact
✓ Enterprise deployment ready
HOW IT WORKS:
GuardRail uses a two-layer protection system. Initial AI detection happens locally in your browser, with cloud verification only for unknown threats. Like a highway guardrail that keeps you from going off the road, GuardRail keeps you from visiting dangerous sites.
PERFECT FOR:
• Businesses requiring secure browsing
• MSPs protecting multiple clients
• Privacy-conscious users
• IT departments managing endpoints
• Anyone wanting protection from phishing and malware
PRIVACY FIRST:
GuardRail minimizes data transmission. Only URLs are sent for verification when needed - never page content, passwords, or personal data. All initial threat detection happens locally.
MONITOR MODE:
Test GuardRail's protection without blocking. Monitor mode logs potential threats without interrupting your browsing, perfect for evaluation periods.

firefox-addons:2633704.name: Firefox Relay
firefox-addons:2633704.summary: Firefox Relay lets you generate email aliases that forward to your real inbox. Use it to hide your real email address and protect yourself from hackers and unwanted mail.
firefox-addons:2633704.description:
We all make many online accounts, but most of them are linked to just one or two email addresses. This means if just one account is hacked, every account using the same email address could also be at risk.
Firefox Relay helps you protect your real email address — the one most closely tied to your online identity. It lets you generate unique, random aliases you can use to sign up for accounts, apps, or newsletters, and forwards messages to your real address. If you find that an account is sending unwanted email or spam, you can block the alias and it will stop sending email to your inbox. Once you no longer want an account, you can delete the alias. 
Want more protection and convenience? With Firefox Relay Premium you can create unlimited aliases and send replies. Additionally, you can create a custom domain for your aliases that’s easier to remember and share. Need an alias for a restaurant reservation? Just say restaurantname@yourdomain.mozmail.com — no need to create the alias beforehand.
Permissions requested by this add-on and their purpose:
Access to All Websites (<all_urls>): Our add-on requests access to content from any website you visit. This helps us provide you with our service across the web, ensuring your online activities are safeguarded.
Storage: We request access to your browser's storage capabilities. This enables us to store and retrieve data, such as your preferences and settings, so you can enjoy a personalized experience every time you use Firefox Relay.
Context Menus: Our add-on adds items to your browser's context menu, which appears when you right-click on a webpage element. This allows us to offer you convenient options and actions for quick interactions.
Menus: We utilize the "menus" permission to create custom menus in your browser's interface. This feature lets us add user-friendly UI elements like buttons and dropdown menus, giving you easy access to our add-on's features.

bluejetty:00160961:ios.description:
Our smart prompter app makes it easy to read your script and record without ever looking away from the camera. With this teleprompter for videos and our cutting-edge autocue technology, you'll produce flawless videos every time, seamlessly integrating your script with smooth-scrolling text. Take benefit of our floating notes!
Transform your videos with the ultimate teleprompter for video recording! 
Teleprompter is a feature-rich app designed for entrepreneurs, vloggers, course instructors, presentations, video production work, and keynote addresses.
Teleprompter helps you to record professional and natural videos. Read your script from floating notes straight from your phone while recording video so that you're always looking towards the camera.
Script. Read. Record.
POWERFUL TELEPROMPTER FUNCTIONALITY
- Import scripts from various sources including PDF, TXT or Word files
- Customize your script display with over 20 font options for text while scrolling, allowing you to match the look and feel of your video.
- Tired of hard-to-read text? Adjust both foreground and background colors for clear script teleprompter visibility, even in challenging lighting.
- Mirror teleprompter functionality allows for horizontal and vertical text mirroring to match any video setup.
- Support for RTL layout means scripts in languages like Arabic or Hebrew will scroll naturally, keeping you focused on delivering your best.
- Use script scroll speed controls for a tailored reading experience, ensuring you never miss a word.
- Countdown timer allows you to get into position before recording with the teleprompter.
- Script margin adjustment helps create the ideal teleprompter captions for your video.
VIDEO RECORDING
- Capture video in full HD, whether in portrait or landscape mode.
- Perfect for vlog scripts, presentations, and more.
- Present or conduct interviews by switching between front and back cameras.
REMOTE CONTROL
- Use your Bluetooth keyboard or handheld presentation as a remote to control the autocue
- Customize keyboard shortcuts
CLOUD SYNCHRONIZATION
- Sync your scripts to the cloud with unlimited storage
- Auto-synchronize the data when you log in on another device.
OTHER FEATURES
- Manage scripts with folders, move, rename, or delete scripts in folders easily. It's all about making sure you have everything in one place for fast, efficient video production.
- Clean UI to help you focus on reading the script, and make the perfect video.
- Our autocue ensures that the floating notes and text scroller remain perfectly aligned, so you never miss a beat while recording.
Perfect for all your video needs! Whether you're recording a vlog, preparing for a presentation, or conducting a professional interview, this app delivers a flawless video teleprompter experience. 
Just choose your ideal script display, and you're ready to start filming. The text prompter also supports floating notes, enabling you to deliver your message while staying connected to your content at all times.
Download our app now and elevate your video production with the most advanced autocue features available! Add words to video, enhance your vlog scripts, or seamlessly integrate floating notes while you record - Our teleprompter app has everything you need!

bluejetty:00065885:ios.description:
Play classic solitaire games in one app!
Including FreeCell, Spider, Klondike, TriPeaks, Pyramid and Golf.
Solitaire games are loved by players all over the world because of its simple rules.
FreeCell:
Clear cards from table by building suits from Ace to King in each Foundation piles, use the free cells to store any single card temporarily.
Random deal and Classic deal
Play the specified numbered deal
Klondike:
Clear cards from table by building suits from Ace to King in the Foundation piles.
Draw 1 or 3 cards
3 scoring type: Standard, Las Vegas, Cumulative Vegas
Spider:
Clear all 8 suits from table by build suits from King to Ace.
3 game difficulties: 1 suit, 2 suits, 4 suits
TriPeaks:
clear the board by tapping face-up cards that are either one above or one below the top card in the waste pile.
Pyramid:
clear the board by tapping any two cards that add up to 13.
King can be cleared individually
Golf:
clear the board by tapping face-up cards that are either one above or one below the top card in the waste pile.
You can put any card on the golf card.
Highlighted Features in this app:
fast loading, seamlessly switch games
Play in landscape and portrait
2 layout styles in landscape
auto hint for possible moves
Auto save game progress
Various themes
Customizable background using your own photo
Cool animations
Rich statistics
FreeCell supports input game number
Auto move card to foundation piles
Auto complete game if possible
Unlimited undo
Leaderboards for each game mode

HEAL.

What was not possible years ago is possible NOW!

bluejetty:00169231:ios.summary: Read, listen to and explore the Holy Quran with this highly optimized, feature packed and searchable Quran application that comes with complete Quranic Recitations from 50+ reciters, 100+ Translations, 60+ Tafsirs / Commentaries in multiple
bluejetty:00169231:ios.description:
Read, listen to and explore the Holy Quran with this highly optimized, feature packed and searchable Quran application that comes with complete Quranic Recitations from 50+ reciters, 100+ Translations, 60+ Tafsirs / Commentaries in multiple languages, word by word meaning, an amazing user interface design and the best set of features! This most authentic Quran app offers beautiful rendering of Quran in Mushaf al-Madina, Uthmanic & IndoPak fonts.
• Mesmerizing recitations of the Holy Quran by 50+ world famous reciters
• 'Follow Reciter' feature to listen to the Quran Arabic recitation followed by the Translation recitation
• 15 English translations and 43 other languages translations of the Holy Quran
• 60+ most authentic Quranic Tafsirs from renowned scholars in English, Arabic & Urdu languages. Tafsir view is displayed at bottom separated from the Quran in upper area by an adjustable divider. Tapping on any Ayah brings the tafsir of that Ayah
• Transliterations in English & Turkish languages
• Meaning, Pronunciation, Quranic Grammar, Syntax & Morphology for every word of every Ayah
• Choose from 4 different Quran layouts to suit your preference of reading the Holy Quran. Full support for both portrait & landscape modes
• Quranic text is rendered using True Type Fonts which allows for crisp, unpixelated display of Quran even at maximum zoom-level / font-size. Supports convenient pinch/zoom gesture for changing font size. All text is adjusted within the horizontal screen size, eliminating any need for horizontal scrolling
• Auto-Scroll option allowing you to read the Quran without needing to manually scroll the content downwards. Adjust the auto-scroll speed to match your reading speed
• Advanced audio repeat options to help with memorization (repetition of Ayah, Surah, Juz, & number of repetitions). Complete Audio controls with Forward, Rewind & Pause/Play
• Instantly stream audio or Download recitations to listen offline. Download all Surahs or any individual Surahs
• Listen the audio recitation even when the app is in background or your device is locked
• Highly advanced "Search" feature that can help with searching any word in the Arabic text, Transliteration, Translation & Tafsir
• Bookmark & write Notes for any Ayah of the Quran
• Highlight any Ayah in any color for your future reference
• Markings for Juz, Hizbs, Rukus, Rubas, Sajdas & Manzils throughout the Quran. Explore Quran by directly accessing any of these from the Quran navigation screen
• Social media sharing. Ability to share any Ayah, Translation or Tafsir via Whatsapp, email, twitter, Facebook etc.
Bonus Features: 
- Accurate Prayer Timings calculated for your exact geographical location.
- Prayer notifications with several beautiful Adhans (Call to Prayer) to choose from. Listen to Full Adhan in the lock screen notification, even when the app is not running. 
- 'Hadith Collection' section, containing complete Arabic Hadiths text & their translations for the 13 major Hadith books. Hadith section also supports searching.
- Use Qibla Compass to orient your device towards Qibla & find its exact direction.
- View accurate Ramadan Suhoor & Iftar timings. Use Fasting Tracker to keep a track of your missed & observed fasts. Print hi-resolution Ramadan timetable.
- View Duas & Azkar from Hisnul Muslim, on every topic & for every occasion
- Watch Face Complication in the accompanying Apple Watch app. View the time remaining in the next Salah with a quick glance at your watch
The Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: "Whoever reads a letter from the Book of Allah, he receives the reward from it, and this reward will be multiplied by ten. I do not say that 'Alif Lam Mim' is a letter, rather Alif is a letter, Lam is a letter and Mim is a letter." [Tirmidhi]. We hope this app will help you with your recitation of the Quran and increase your blessings in this world and the hereafter. Please remember us in your prayers.
Support: salam@muslimandquran.com

bluejetty:00071363:ios.description:
Every walk, ride, or run tells a story. Map My Tracks helps you understand yours.
Whether you're walking the same route every day or training for your next challenge, Map My Tracks gives you insights that actually matter. Discover patterns you didn't know existed. Celebrate streaks that keep you motivated. Understand what your body is telling you. Join over a million people who've made Map My Tracks their go-to companion for outdoor activities.
=====
Featured in Apple's What's hot list
#1 iPhone app in Health & Fitness in Japan, France, Belgium, Iceland, Czech Republic
=====
YOUR PERSONAL ACTIVITY COACH
After every activity, get feedback that's tailored to you. Casual walkers learn about consistency and habit-building. Cyclists and runners get performance breakdowns and training insights. Everyone gets encouragement that keeps them moving.
See patterns like: "You tend to walk further on sunny days" or "Your Tuesday runs are consistently your strongest." Understand your training load before you overtrain. Celebrate when you hit a new streak. It's like having a coach who knows your history and adapts to your goals.
TRACK EVERYTHING, EVERYWHERE
Use Map My Tracks to record your activities, or connect your Garmin, Wahoo, Coros, HealthKit, and more, and automatically bring everything into one place. All your walks, rides, and runs—all your insights—in a single app.
Track the essentials: distance, pace, elevation, heart rate, calories. Or just press start and let the app do the work. Review your week at a glance or dive deep into detailed stats when you want them.
SHARE YOUR ADVENTURES
Broadcast live so friends and family can follow along. Add photos and create videos that capture the whole experience. Follow friends and keep each other motivated. Or keep it private—it's your choice.
SET YOUR OWN GOALS
Whether it's walking 10,000 steps, maintaining a streak, or beating your PR, set goals that matter to you. Track your progress with intelligent insights that help you get there.
UNLOCK EVERYTHING WITH PLUS
• AI-powered Activity Insights after every activity
• Live tracking so others can follow your progress
• Ad-free experience
• Advanced analysis tools on app and website
• Full access to all features
Subscriptions for Map My Tracks PLUS are $4.99 per month or $49.99 for a full year. Map My Tracks PLUS subscriptions will be charged to your iTunes account after your confirmation of purchase. Your monthly subscription will automatically renew each month and be charged through your iTunes account, yearly subscriptions will automatically renew each year. Subscriptions renew at $4.99 per month or $49.99 for a full year automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings. Cancellation of the current active subscription period is not allowed.
FEEDBACK 
If you're enjoying Map My Tracks leave us a good review in the App Store. If not, send your feedback to support@mapmytracks.com and let us fix it before you write a review. 
Map My Tracks uses HealthKit to export your Map My Tracks activities into the Health app and to read heart rate and biometric data. This service is optional.Please note that continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
Terms of service: https://www.mapmytracks.com/term-service
Privacy policy: https://www.mapmytracks.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00037919:ios.name: Geometrica
bluejetty:00037919:ios.summary: Geometrica is the first drawing app made for tattooers, by a tattooer. Second generation tattooer and geometric/dotwork pioneer, Cory Ferguson, has built on 30 years in the industry to create a way for tattooers to push their geometric draw
bluejetty:00037919:ios.description:
Geometrica is the first drawing app made for tattooers, by a tattooer. Second generation tattooer and geometric/dotwork pioneer, Cory Ferguson, has built on 30 years in the industry to create a way for tattooers to push their geometric drawing to the next level. Even though we're focused on the needs of tattoo artists and solving problems specific to their workflow, we have been pleasantly surprised to learn that artists from many different disciplines have become fans of Geometrica. From quilters, to illustrators, to tattoo veterans, the power of this fun to use app is undeniable.
[ SYMMETRY AND PATTERN MAKING FEATURES ]
Combine and use these simultaneously:
ROTATION EFFECT - AKA the mandala maker. Other apps may have this, but not like ours. With Geometrica your mandala can be a maximum of 200 mirrored segments (so technically 400 segments!).
REPEAT EFFECT - Multiplies your drawing and repeats it in a row formation to create a “band” of pattern either vertically or horizontally.
POLAR REPEAT - Combines with the rotation effect to repeat your drawing in rows of concentric circles that get smaller towards the center. Toggle on curve to draw in spirals. That’s right, your drawing curves out in any number of spirals!
WALLPAPER EFFECT - We took all known symmetry groups used to make full page patterns, and figured out a way to vastly expand them to make them customizable.
GRADIENT THICKNESS - Lines increase from thin to thick on the canvas in the direction that you choose, top to bottom, outward in a circular, left to right in multiple rows. There are dozens of options! Combine it with any of the above symmetry tools for a drawing experience you have to see to believe.
[ DRAWING TOOLS ]
Here’s just a couple of our favourites:
MARKER TOOL - The main drawing tool in the app can be customized in many ways, by turning various functions on. These include tapers, a whip shading option, and a “rope stabilizer” that helps draw the smoothest curves.
STRAIGHT LINE TOOL - Hold the Pencil on screen to draw straight lines. Works well with symmetry effects for sharp, industrial images and unexpected designs. Enable its "continuous" option for a unique drawing experience.
DOTWORK TOOL - We couldn’t release a Cory Ferguson app without a dotwork tool, so we made the most customizable version of pointillism shading we could think of. Change the dot size, density, the brush size, randomize the size of the dots. Personalize it to suit your taste.
[ FOR PROFESSIONAL TATTOOERS ]
- Keep your work organized with folders in the Gallery section. 
- Convert To Lines function turns any image into a line drawing with one click, then you can fine tune the image from there.
- Adjustable grids can be turned on in the background such as square, hexagon or isometric.
- Snap Menu allows the straight line tool to "snap" to points on the grid, or place your symmetry tool at the exact centre of your drawing after you’ve moved it. Rotate layers in 5 degree increments when transforming.
- Printing features that EVERY tattooer needs. Print drawings at ANY size! Want a tattoo to measure 28” tall? Enter those numbers into our print system and the app will break the image up into as many pages as needed, and you’re ready to stencil. No more resizing on the photocopier! Various image adjustment tools to make sure you get the cleanest, most accurate stencils.
- Monthly Patterns. Each month you get 6 patterns that show off the possibilities of what Geometrica can do. You are free to make use of them however you wish.
[ SUBSCRIPTION ]
Because Geometrica is focused on a small niche market of working tattoo professionals, it requires a subscription. After the 14 day free trial period ends, the subscription equals approximately 11.50 USD per month when you sign up for the full year. An investment in yourself that is certain to level up your geometric tattooing.
Privacy Policy: http://geometri.ca/privacy
Terms of Use: http://geometri.ca/tou

bluejetty:00119914:ios.description:
Educational kids games for preschoolers. The app has 80 activities for toddlers that will help your baby develop basic skills like hand eye coordination, fine motor, logical thinking and visual perception. These games are suitable for both girls and boys and can be a part of preschool education for kids.
Bimi Boo will visit 10 different locations such as space, sea, desert, Arctic, jungle, wild west, island and many others that contain 80 levels with the following types of activities: 
Size game: Understand differences in sizes by sorting items into correct slots. 
123 game: Counting for toddlers to learn numbers 1, 2 and 3. 
Puzzle game: A simple puzzle for kids to improve hand eye coordination. 
Logic game: Develop memory and logic. 
Shape games: Sort items by their shape to develop visual perception and hand eye coordination. 
Color games: Sort items by their color. 
Logic game: Develop visual perception by sorting items with different meaning. 
Memory game: Memorize and find items shown earlier.
All the activities were developed with participation of experts in the field of children education. Ages: 2, 3, 4 or 5 years old pre-kindergarten and kindergarten children.
Trusted by the largest teacher community in the USA: "We Are Teachers"!
You will never find annoying ads inside our app. We are always glad to receive your feedback and suggestions.

Camera-Based Estimation
Just point your camera, capture the item, and view the estimated result — no setup, no extra steps.
Multiple Units Supported

Measurement History

Place the item on a well-lit surface

View or save the estimated result
Perfect For

• Package preparation
• Crafting and DIY projects
• Jewelry and accessories
• Everyday curiosity
• Situations where you want a rough idea of weight and don’t have a physical scale nearby
Disclaimer & Accuracy
This app does not replace a physical scale and must not be used for trade, medical, safety-critical, or any scenario requiring certified or precise measurements.

Quitting any addiction — whether it’s smoking, alcohol, or unhealthy habits — is challenging, but tracking your progress makes it easier. The Sobriety Tracker Counter app helps you monitor how long you've been addiction-free, stay focused on your goals, and celebrate every sober milestone.
Looking for a simple and effective addiction recovery tracker? Need a reliable sobriety tracker to stay motivated? Want to build healthy habits and quit smoking, drinking, or other addictions? This is the app for you.
Track addictions easily:
Whether you're trying to quit smoking, stop drinking, or break other bad habits, this app helps you log your progress, track your sober days, and visualize your addiction-free timeline.
Daily milestone reminders & motivational messages:
Receive daily notifications to help you stay strong and focused on your addiction recovery journey. Celebrate each day you stay sober, and get encouragement right when you need it.
Plan your new routine:
Use the calendar and habit scheduler to plan healthy habits and stick to them. Replace old addictions with positive, healthy routines.
Sobriety Tracker Counter app features:
PROGRESS TRACKING & CUSTOMIZATION
- Track multiple addictions in one place
- Choose your addiction: quit smoking, quit drinking, stop gambling, break phone addiction and more
- Customize the tracker to your goals and monitor progress effortlessly
STAY MOTIVATED WITH MILESTONES
- Get daily motivational reminders to help you stay sober
- Visualize your progress with a sober day counter and timeline
- Set goals and see how far you’ve come with clear milestone tracking
BUILD HEALTHY HABITS
- Create and follow a custom plan for new routines
- Replace bad habits with positive ones
- Track every step of your habit-building journey
- The Sobriety Tracker Counter app is built for people on a quit addiction journey, providing the motivation, structure, and tracking you need to succeed. Whether you're focused on staying sober, quitting smoking, or simply wanting to build better habits, we’re here to help every day.
Start your addiction recovery and stay sober with the Sobriety Tracker Counter app — download now and begin your journey!

bluejetty:00185493:ios.name: FreeCell Solitaire Now
bluejetty:00185493:ios.summary: Welcome to the amazing world of solitaire! FreeCell is one of the most played patience games in the world. Now you can enjoy it anytime, and anywhere, on your mobile phone or tablet. Share your FreeCell scores with your friends on Facebook
bluejetty:00185493:ios.description:
Welcome to the amazing world of solitaire! FreeCell is one of the most played patience games in the world. Now you can enjoy it anytime, and anywhere, on your mobile phone or tablet. Share your FreeCell scores with your friends on Facebook and Twitter.
From Odesys, the makers of the best solitaire games for mobile.
FreeCell is an open solitaire, where all cards are dealt face up. The board consists of four free cells, four home cells and eight columns. The goal is to place all 52 cards in the home cells, forming four stacks, one for each suit, in ascending order from ace to king. Moves to a column must be made in descending order, alternating colors. Only the cards at the bottom of the columns or in the free cells can be moved. A free cell can contain no more than one card at a time.
Odesys FreeCell Features:
• Select any game from 1 to 1000000
• Landscape and portrait orientation
• Unlimited Undo and Redo
• Adjustable cards size (pinch-to-resize)
• Sound
• Hints
• Timer
• Auto save on exit
• Animations
• Auto collect
Follow us on Twitter: @OdesysSolitaire
Look for other great patience games by Odesys. If you like the classics, you would love Klondike Solitaire, FreeCell Solitaire, Spider Solitaire, or its lesser known variations, Black Widow Solitaire and Tarantula Solitaire. You might also like to try Pyramid Solitaire, or its somewhat easier variation, Seven Solitaire, or the completely open Giza Solitaire. No solitaire collection would be complete without the unique Golf Solitaire, the addictive Yukon Solitaire, or its almost impossible to solve cousin, Russian Solitaire.

Moves to a column must be made in descending order, alternating colors. Only the cards at the bottom of the columns or in the free cells can be moved. A free cell can contain no more than one card at a time.

Odesys FreeCell Features:
• Select any game from 1 to 1000000
• Landscape and portrait orientation
• Unlimited Undo and Redo
• Adjustable cards size (pinch-to-resize)
• Sound
• Hints
• Timer
• Auto save on exit
• Animations
• Auto collect

Follow us on Twitter: @OdesysSolitaire

Look for other great patience games by Odesys. If you like the classics, you would love Klondike Solitaire, FreeCell Solitaire, Spider Solitaire, or its lesser known variations, Black Widow Solitaire and Tarantula Solitaire. You might also like to try Pyramid Solitaire, or its somewhat easier variation, Seven Solitaire, or the completely open Giza Solitaire. No solitaire collection would be complete without the unique Golf Solitaire, the addictive Yukon Solitaire, or its almost impossible to solve cousin, Russian Solitaire.

bluejetty:00083295:ios.description:
Who's the Imposter? One secret word. One faker. Total chaos.
Forget boring party games. Picoboom is the vibe check your group needs: chaotic, hilarious, and completely unhinged. And now it's home to the game your group won't stop playing: hunt down the Imposter before they fool the whole room.
Color Hunt: the mode everyone's filming
Picoboom shows a color, the countdown starts, and everyone scatters to find something that matches. Snap your find in the app, Picoboom scores how close the color is, and the closest match takes the win. Fast, chaotic, and made for a crowd.
Imposter, two ways to play
- Imposter Online: create a room, share the code, and play with friends from anywhere, each on their own phone (3 to 20 players)
- Pass and play: one phone, passed around the room (3+ players)
Everyone gets the same secret word, except the Imposter. Drop one-word clues, spot the faker, and vote them out, or bluff your way to victory.
Plus the OG Picoboom modes
The chaos that started it all is still here:
- Pass the Bomb: beat the timer, and whoever's holding the phone when it explodes takes the penalty (customize them for maximum chaos)
- Name 3 Things, Act It Out, and more
2 people work, but a whole crowd works better.
Get ready to
- Bluff, accuse, and roast your friends like never before
- Act it out, sing, or make up raps
- Yell the first curse word that pops into your head
- Make fast rhymes and wild guesses
- Jump, laugh, and maybe even cartwheel across the room
Perfect for
- Parties, sleepovers, road trips, dorms, and family gatherings
- Friends who love to compete, lie, and call each other out
Loved by over 1 million players. From the creators of Truth or Dare and Never Have I Ever.

bluejetty:00171929:android.description:
Welcome to 3 Tiles, Matching Puzzle, the ultimate game for your match 3 puzzle and tile match solving skills! Immerse yourself in a world of vibrant tile and challenging puzzles, where your mission is to match and connect many kinds of wonderful Tiles. This addictive and visually captivating game will keep you entertained for hours on end.
This #1 Puzzle Game is relaxing, fun, and addictive. The match 3 game is simple but challenging when you climb to higher levels. The higher levels you climb, the more difficult you get. Can you match all the tiles in this tile match puzzle game? The only way to be the champion of this game is to play day by day to upgrade your brain IQ to win all puzzle game levels.
Key Features:
💸 It's totally FREE
🎮 Engaging Gameplay: Match and solve 1000+ puzzle game levels from easy ones to the most challenging levels to relax and train your brain IQ.
🎨 Mesmerizing Visuals: Enjoy the satisfying visual experience of watching tiles come to life as you match them into stunning arrangements. Unlock beautiful pictures as you beat levels
🧠 Brain-Boosting Fun: Exercise your brain and enhance your match 3 and connect tile abilities with each level you conquer.
🌈 Diversity Tile Sets to Play: You can open many tile sets, from fruit, flower, travel things, emoji, etc...
🌎 Chilling Background: Imagine match all the tile with a relaxing background. Various background themes to select
🆓 Free to Play: Tile Master, Matching Puzzle is completely free to play, with optional in-app purchases for added convenience.
How to play
️- Find and match 3 identical tiles to clear the board. Only 3 same tile can be matched.
️- Choose your tile sets for more fun gameplay
️- The row bellow the tile board could only hold a certain amount of tiles. If it’s full of different tile, you will lose the round
- Be careful as the game levels are harder as you advance and you will need match carefully
️- No timer, and you can always restart when you get stuck at any time.
- Master the game and win awesome rewards as you beat levels
- Use the boosters to help you win hard levels
️- No penalties. Take it easy and just relax!
Start playing 3 Tiles, Matching Puzzle today – tap, match and relax with modern mobile mahjong, tile match game. You can play it anywhere, anytime. Sharpen your brain and improve your IQ everyday

bluejetty:00016737:ios.description:
Get the latest Massachusetts lottery results within minutes of the draws taking place. This easy-to-use app includes the following lotteries:
- Powerball
- Mega Millions
- Megabucks
- Mass Cash
- Mass 3
- Mass 4
- Millionaire for Life
- Powerball Xs & Os
- The Numbers Game
- Wheel of Luck
- Keno
Powerball, Mega Millions, Megabucks, Mass Cash, Millionaire for Life, Powerball Xs & Os and The Numbers Game also include a full breakdown displaying the number of winners and amount paid out for each prize level.
The following features are also included:
Ticket Checker
----------------------------
Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket as well as calculating the total for each lottery. Only play lotteries on certain days of the week? Not a problem, you can exclude your checked tickets from draws you do not play.
Customizable Notifications
----------------------------
Get notified instantly when the latest lottery results and prize breakdowns become available. The App allows you to customise notifications for specific lottery games and you can also choose which days of the week you play. Want to know when the jackpot has rolled over or has reached a certain amount? Just head to the Notification section of the app to set up your alerts. There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.
Random Number Generator
-----------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on house numbers and anniversary dates!
Results Archive
----------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw of each lottery.
Settings
----------------------------
Customise which lotteries display in the app and in which order.
Support
----------------------------
If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve this app, please get in touch at contact@lottery.net.

bluejetty:00162028:ios.description:
■ TextMaker
► The only complete Office word processor for your Word files
► Work on your Word documents wherever and whenever you want.
► When working on the go, take advantage of a feature set that you would otherwise only know from your PC or Mac.
► Almost all features can be used permanently free of charge.
The complete set of features that you know from Microsoft Word or TextMaker on your Mac or PC is now offered by TextMaker on your iPhone and iPad.
Compatibility without compromise: TextMaker uses the Microsoft Office format DOCX as its native format. This guarantees seamless data exchange. You can open your documents directly in Microsoft Word without having to convert them.
Intuitive operation on iPhone and iPad: TextMaker always provides an ideal user experience, regardless of whether you're using it on your iPhone or an iPad. On an iPhone, you can use the practical toolbars with just one finger. On an iPad, you work with ribbons similar to those on your Mac or PC.
Save locally or in the cloud: TextMaker not only enables you to open and save documents stored on your device, but it also allows you to access your files in iCloud, Dropbox, OneDrive and all other cloud storage services.
The TextMaker user interface is available in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian and more than 20 other languages.
TextMaker brings the features of a desktop word processor to your iPhone and iPad. You shouldn't settle for less.
■ Working with files
► Documents can be losslessly exchanged with TextMaker for Windows, Mac and Linux.
► Open and save DOCX and DOC files with full fidelity from Microsoft Word 6.0 to 2021 and Word 365, also with password protection
► Open and save OpenDocument files (compatible with OpenOffice and LibreOffice), RTF and HTML
■ Editing and formatting
► Numerous templates enable you to rapidly create attractive Office documents.
► Insert fields such as date/time, page number, consecutive numbers, etc.
► Borders, shading, drop caps, paragraph control
► Paragraph and character styles
► Format painter for the rapid transfer of formatting
► Tables
► Calculations in text and tables
► Automatic numbering of lines, paragraphs, lists and headings
■ Comprehensive graphics functions
► Draw and design directly in the document
► Microsoft-Word-compatible AutoShapes
► Insert pictures in a range of file formats
► Crop pictures, change brightness, contrast and gamma
► TextArt function for striking font effects
■ Spell check
► Automatic spell checking in numerous languages
► You can add any Hunspell dictionary.
■ Features for complex documents
► Comments
► Cross references, footnotes, endnotes, indexes, tables of contents, bibliographies
► Forms with input fields, dropdown lists, calculations, etc.
■ Other features
Almost all features of TextMaker for iOS can be used free of charge. The following additional features are available to you via an inexpensive subscription:
► Printing
► Export to PDF, PDF/A and to the e-book format EPUB
► Sharing documents directly from TextMaker
► Outliner
► Multilingual thesaurus
► 2D and 3D charts
► Comments and tracked changes
► Free customer support
A single subscription unlocks these features simultaneously in TextMaker, PlanMaker and Presentations for iOS.
License agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00173076:ios.summary:

World War II was one of the most defining conflicts in history. Thousands of heroes clashed in epic battles involving aircraft, ships, infantry, and tanks. Their courage lives on in memorials, statues, maquettes, an
bluejetty:00173076:ios.description:
We need you, Commander!
World War II was one of the most defining conflicts in history. Thousands of heroes clashed in epic battles involving aircraft, ships, infantry, and tanks. Their courage lives on in memorials, statues, maquettes, and detailed dioramas.
As children, many of us imagined those miniature battlefields coming to life — now you can fight your way through them.
Inspired by these iconic moments, Armored Heroes brings legendary WWII tank battles to life in a unique diorama-style action experience.
Take command of powerful tanks, blast through enemy forces, and lead your armored units across multiple war fronts.
Key Features
• Fight through 230 action-packed campaign levels
• Command 22 historically inspired WWII tanks
• Battle across 5 major war campaigns
Western Front – Reach Paris in 50 intense levels
Eastern Front – Survive the brutal Russian winter campaign
North Africa – Wage desert warfare with the Afrika Korps
Operation Barbarossa – Lead the German advance east
Pacific Campaign – Conquer island strongholds under heavy fire
• Upgrade your tanks and increase their battlefield power
• Use different ammo types to destroy enemy armor
• Customize your tanks with unique paint and camouflage
• Earn achievements and medals for your victories
Commander, your service is needed!
Join the ranks, take command of legendary war machines, and fight your way to victory.
Honor the heroes of history — one battle at a time.
A WWII tank battle game like no other
Easy to pick up and packed with American, Soviet, and German tanks, Armored Heroes delivers exciting tank combat in beautifully crafted miniature battlefields.
This is the most epic tank game from 1DER Entertainment yet.
Tanks used as inspiration
USA:
M24 Chaffee, M4A1 Sherman, M10 Wolverine, M26 Pershing, LVT-1, LVT-4, M6A1
Soviet Union:
BT-7, T-34, KV-1, KV-2, JS-2
Germany:
Panzer III, Panzer IV, Panther, Tiger, King Tiger, Stug-3, Jagdpanther, King Tiger Porsche, Jagdtiger, Maus

bluejetty:00120789:ios.description:
iTrainer Dog whistle & Clicker is a simple and easy to use app that bundles a dog whistle (with e-collar mode), squeaky toy sounds, a training clicker, and 100+ animal sound effects to assist with training your dog or pet!
Main Features:
• High frequency dog whistle. Easily adjust frequency, modulation, and speed
• E-Collar mode that mimics tones used by popular E Collars
• Dog training clicker with 5 unique, original clicker sounds
• 20+ squeaker toy sounds
• 100+ animal sounds to entertain and engage your dog or pet (dogs, cats, birds, farm animals, & more!)
• Widgets (play the whistle, clicker and squeaker directly from your home screen, lock screen, and control center)
• Record and save your own custom sounds
• Reference guides for whistle training and positive-reinforcement obedience training
• Apple Watch App
• Works great on all iOS, iPadOS, and MacOS (with Apple silicon) devices
• Dark mode support
Whistle Training:
iTrainer leverages the power of high-frequency whistle training, a proven method for teaching recall and obedience. The sound can travel over long distances, making it ideal for outdoor training with working breeds like shepherds and hunting dogs.
Clicker Training:
Using positive reinforcement techniques, iTrainer’s clicker helps you clearly communicate with your pet. The consistent click sound paired with a reward encourages your dog to repeat desired behaviors, making training sessions more effective and enjoyable.
Squeakers & Animal Sounds:
iTrainer offers 20+ squeaker toy sounds and over 100 animal sounds to capture your pet’s attention and keep them entertained. Whether you’re engaging your dog during playtime or providing mental stimulation, these sounds mimic real-world stimuli that intrigue pets like dogs, cats, birds, and farm animals. This makes it a perfect tool for keeping your pet focused and engaged during training sessions or simply offering them a fun distraction.
Join over 3 million pet owners who have already downloaded iTrainer! Improve your training techniques and bond with your dog by downloading iTrainer today—completely free!

bluejetty:00122314:ios.description:
Full App Description:
This update introduces 18 brand-new prank call characters, each with amusing and fictional voice scenarios ranging from tech mix-ups to delivery confusion and mistaken identity. The content is lighthearted, family-friendly, and designed purely for entertainment.
New character highlights:
Abdo Confused – Calls the wrong number and gets flustered
Bradley Snaps – Misunderstands a situation and overreacts
Chainsaw Steve – Ready to chop the wrong tree
Dog Poop Neighbor – Extremely upset over a neighborhood mess
Turkey Complainer – Convinced the food isn’t safe
Flight Cancel Caller – Claims your flight is suddenly canceled
…and more!
With 9 customizable call screens, you can create the illusion of an incoming call from anyone. Upload your own images and audio clips for a realistic and fun prank experience. This app simulates incoming calls so convincingly, it’s perfect for laughter or creative use.
Use This App To:
Escape awkward situations
Get out of boring dates or meetings
Play pranks on friends or family
Simulate incoming calls creatively
Customize your own fake call scenarios
Included Characters:
A wise and peaceful guru
A friendly grandpa who’s a little confused
A mysterious voice with a secret
A delivery person in a rush
…and many more pre-loaded voices
Features:
Record your own audio for fake callers
Includes voice-acted characters
Choose from 9 realistic call screen styles
Pick from 99 different ringtones
Customize delay before the call rings
Add unlimited fake contacts
Search bar for easy character access
Easily delete or edit characters
Tips:
To delete a character, tap and hold until it wiggles, then tap cross
To ensure the delayed call works, set Auto-Lock to Never in device settings
Note:
This app is for entertainment purposes only. It does not place real calls or access your device’s actual ringtones.
*Internet required for searching images.
**Need a custom fake call setup for video production? Contact us.
