bluejetty:00186036:ios.description:
"Fantastic, customizable tracing practice with fun rewards." 5 Stars - Common Sense Media
470,000+ units sold (including 260,000 to schools) !
Writing Wizard is designed to help every child learn how to trace letters, numbers, and words through a fun system carefully designed to maintain motivation. 
• Show and enforce how to trace letters correctly
• 16 Fonts available (including 3 most popular USA fonts)
• Fun tracing using 50+ animated stickers, sound effects and interactive games that animate letters at the end of tracing
• Letter names and phonics 
• Uppercase & lowercase letters, numbers and words
• Ability to create your own word lists (and record audio for each word)
• Fully customizable to suit every child’s needs (letter size, difficulty,...)
• Check progress thanks to reports that display what the child has traced
• Shapes tracing activity for toddlers
• Create PDF Worksheets and print them to help your child to write on paper
• Use Apple pencil to write at very small size 
_______
ACCOLADES
• "Writing Wizard is the most complete and intelligent letter tracing app we’ve seen"" AppoLearning.com
• "This brand-new app should be the go-to for every parent, teacher and therapist to work on handwriting" - TOP PICKS - 5 stars - SmartAppsForKids.com
• "Writing Wizard by L’Escapadou is everything a parent wants in a handwriting app, and more." 5/5 - kids-app-reviews.com
• "L’Escapadou has made handwriting fun." AppyMall.com 5/5
• Listed in "20 best educational iPhone and iPad apps for kids of 2013" - appsplayground.com
• Editor's Choice Award for Excellence in Design - Children's Technology Review
_______
PERFECT FOR KIDS
Kids want to have fun, and Writing Wizard offers a lot of fun to keep them motivated in the learning process ! 
• They can trace using 50+ animated stickers and sound effects
• Once tracing is complete, they can interact with them on 4 games that animate letters
• They can trace any word - like their name - and record their voice for each word
• They can collect stars in 5-Stars play mode
_______
PERFECT FOR PARENTS & TEACHERS
• Ability to create your own word lists (and record audio for each word)
• Detailed reports provide information on what kids have done, including the ability to replay and export the tracings to view kids' progress
• Share word lists via iCloud drive or other cloud providers, adhoc network, or email
• Multiple parameters to customize the app according to the child’s current education level (e.g. letter size, difficulty, show/hide model, allow to stop between key points, etc.)
• 3 most popular fonts in the US (ZB, DN & HWT) and 13 international fonts (UK, Scandinavia,Australia, germany, France)
• Upper and lower case letters, numbers (and word lists)
• Letter names and phonics (which can be customized)
• A customizable 5-Stars play mode prompting the child to trace a letter or a word 5 times using different parameters (each step is more challenging)
• Create an unlimited number of users
• Many settings to customize the app (sound, game time limit, black background,...)
• In the A-Z section, special graphics available to match letters (e.g. ant graphic for A/a)
_______
Note that a free to try version is available (search for "Writing Wizard -Starter" on the App Store)
_______
Privacy Policy
KNOW WHAT'S INSIDE
As a Moms with Apps member, we follow the "Know what's inside" best practices for kids’ apps
L’Escapadou takes children’s privacy seriously. We believe you should not have to worry about your kids being tracked by apps or websites. This app:
• Does not collect any user information (we do not use data collection tools)
• Does not contain in-app purchases
• External Links: Protected parent sections are available where you can send us a mail and check out our others apps. Before accessing a parent section, an addition must be solved so that young kids cannot access it. *

bluejetty:00115368:ios.description:
Experience World War II like never before – from the skies to the battlefield.
Battlefront Europe: WW2 Heroes is a unique hybrid of real-time strategy (RTS) and first-person shooter (FPS) set in the heart of World War II. Command your troops from above, or jump into the boots of any soldier on the battlefield and fight on the front lines.
*** Dual Gameplay – Strategy Meets Action ***
- Take control of your army with intuitive RTS mechanics
- At any moment, possess a unit and fight from the first-person view
- Switch seamlessly between tactical oversight and direct combat
*** Campaign & Sandbox Modes ***
- Play through two immersive single-player campaigns as Allied Forces or Axis Forces
- Create your own battles in Sandbox Mode with full control over map editing, terrain sculpting, and unit placement
- Test your strategies on custom maps and refine your battlefield tactics
*** Authentic WW2 Units and Vehicles ***
- Infantry roles include: Rifleman, SMG Trooper, Sniper, Officer, and General
- Tanks: Sherman, M26 Pershing, Panzer III, and Tiger I
- Air units: Command the skies with WW2-era fighter planes
*** Powerful Map Editor ***
- Shape the terrain with built-in terrain tools
- Place buildings, obstacles, and units to build immersive battlefields
- Play your custom maps instantly and tweak them on the fly
*** Key Features: ***
- Unique blend of RTS and FPS gameplay
- Two full campaigns: Allied Forces & Axis Forces
- Fully interactive sandbox mode with a terrain and battle editor
- Realistic WW2 weapons, vehicles, and battle environments
- Smooth transition between commanding and fighting
Whether you're a tactical mastermind or a frontline warrior, Battlefront Europe: WW2 Heroes lets you live out both roles. Plan your attack. Lead your troops. Become a hero.

• Watch live and recorded video from your indoor or exterior cameras
• Distinguish important events from routine activity with enhanced video analytics
• Lock or unlock doors and manage user codes for access to your property
• Turn on or off lights remotely
• Control your thermostat to better manage energy costs
• Create scenes for a multi-device command that coordinates different smart devices to accomplish a complex task 
• And much more!
As a Vector Security or ADS Security customer, you can also receive real-time push notifications, text messages or emails alerting you of specific events that matter to you. Beyond important emergency-related events, you can also immediately know when:
• You leave and forgot to arm your system
• Your security system is disarmed (and who disarmed it)
• Someone attempts to log into your account
• The housekeeper or pet sitter arrives or leaves
• Employees open or close the store
• Your store is opened late or closed early
• Your kids get home from school
• The door or garage door is left open
• There's flooding or a water leak on your property
• Someone opens a secured location, medicine or liquor cabinet
• Someone changes the thermostat settings
• And much more!

Our interactive security, video surveillance, energy management, and smart automation solutions, including access control, give you instant awareness and remote control to help protect the things you care about the most.

Note: This app requires a compatible system and an interactive security & automation service plan. Features available vary based upon system, equipment, and service plan. Visit www.vectorsecurity.com for more information.

Remote features:
• Arm or disarm your security system
• Watch live and recorded video from your indoor or exterior cameras
• Distinguish important events from routine activity with enhanced video analytics
• Lock or unlock doors and manage user codes for access to your property
• Turn on or off lights remotely
• Control your thermostat to better manage energy costs
• Create scenes for a multi-device command that coordinates different smart devices to accomplish a complex task 
• And much more!

As a Vector Security or ADS Security customer, you can also receive real-time push notifications, text messages or emails alerting you of specific events that matter to you. Beyond important emergency-related events, you can also immediately know when:

• You leave and forgot to arm your system
• Your security system is disarmed (and who disarmed it)
• Someone attempts to log into your account
• The housekeeper or pet sitter arrives or leaves
• Employees open or close the store
• Your store is opened late or closed early
• Your kids get home from school
• The door or garage door is left open
• There's flooding or a water leak on your property
• Someone opens a secured location, medicine or liquor cabinet
• Someone changes the thermostat settings
• And much more!

bluejetty:00046427:ios.description:
Looking for a simpler way to log meals and track your nutrition? Lean is an AI-powered nutrition tracker designed to help you record meals, estimate calorie intake, and track macros. Whether your goal is weight management, muscle gain, or understanding your eating habits, Lean helps you keep track of your daily nutrition.
Track Your Meals with AI
Eating out or cooking at home? Lean uses AI to analyze food photos and provide estimated calorie information. Snap a photo, scan a barcode, or manually enter your meals to keep your food log in one place.
AI-Powered Features for Food Tracking
AI Meal Scanner – Take a photo of your meal to get estimated calorie and macro information.
Barcode Scanner – Scan packaged foods to look up available nutrition data.
Macro Tracking – Track your daily protein, carbohydrate, and fat intake.
Progress Tracking – View your logged calorie intake, weight changes, and macro trends over time.
Save & Edit Meals – Edit meal entries and save favorite meals for future logging.
Why Choose Lean App?
Lean brings AI-assisted food logging, barcode scanning, and manual entry together to help reduce manual food entry. Keep a record of meals and review your estimated nutritional intake, whether you're dining out, meal prepping, or eating on the go.
AI-Powered Calorie Counting Made Simple
Take a photo to get an AI-generated estimate of your meal’s nutritional content.
Log packaged foods using available barcode information.
Review your calorie and macro intake over time.
Edit meal entries to reflect what you ate.
Set calorie and macro goals for your tracking.
Follow Your Nutrition Trends
Detailed Reports – Review your daily, weekly, and monthly food logs.
Weight Tracking – Record weight changes alongside your nutrition history.
Goal Tracking – Compare your logged intake with your calorie and macro goals.
Food Tracking That Fits Your Routine
Use AI, barcode scanning, or manual entry to log meals throughout the day. Review estimated calorie and macro breakdowns, update your entries, and follow your nutrition trends over time.
AI-generated nutrition information is an estimate and may not reflect exact ingredients, preparation methods, or portion sizes. Review and edit entries as needed.
IMPORTANT NOTICE: We do not provide medical advice. All nutrition and diet recommendations should be considered general guidance and not a substitute for professional consultation. Always consult with a healthcare provider or a certified nutritionist before making significant dietary changes.
Subscriptions are offered as auto-renewable plans on a weekly, monthly, or yearly basis (pricing may vary by country). Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time through your Apple Account Settings after purchase. If a free trial is offered, any unused portion of the trial period will be forfeited upon purchasing a subscription.
Terms of Use: https://get-lean.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://get-lean.app/privacy
If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to reach out to us at support@get-lean.app.

bluejetty:00133543:ios.description:
Available exclusively for Netflix members.
Revitalize a barren wasteland. Plant sprawling forests, purify soil and clean polluted oceans to turn a ravaged environment into an ecological paradise.
Transform a lifeless landscape into a thriving, vibrant ecosystem. Turn dead soil into fertile grassland and create the ideal habitat for animals to call home. Then recycle your buildings and leave no trace that you were there. 
Features:

bluejetty:00187963:ios.description:
Bria Enterprise for iOS is a VoIP softphone explicitly tied to CounterPath's Stretto Platform™ and requires an administrator generated account for login. If you do not have an account given to you by your company, operator or CounterPath, you will not be able to use the softphone client.
Bria Enterprise for iOS is based on CounterPath’s award-winning Bria softphone clients and is provisioned by a module of the Stretto Platform. The Stretto Platform’s Provisioning Module is a powerful way for enterprises and operators to distribute, configure and manage Bria softphones and enables users to store their softphone related settings a single, convenient location. With the Provisioning Module, customers can fully provision their Bria softphones for use with their enterprise, SMB, ITSP, or operator VoIP solution. 
For more information on Bria for iOS, please visit: http://www.counterpath.com/ios-sip-softphone/
For more information on CounterPath’s Provisioning Module, please visit: http://www.counterpath.com/stretto/
IMPORTANT NOTE: This version of Bria is tied to CounterPath's hosted Provisioning Module and requires an account set up by your operator or enterprise. Without an account, the client will not work. Please contact CounterPath or your operator/company for more information.
Emergency Calls
CounterPath's Bria mobile products provide handling designed to redirect emergency calls to the Native Cellular dialer when possible on a best reasonable commercial efforts basis, however this functionality is also dependent on the operating system of the mobile phone which is outside of our control and subject to change at any time. As a result, the official position of CounterPath is that CounterPath's Bria product is not intended, designed, or fit for placing, carrying or supporting Emergency Calls. CounterPath will not be liable for any costs or damages arising either directly nor indirectly from the use of the software for Emergency Calls. Using Bria as a default dialer may interfere with dialing emergency services.

bluejetty:00169624:ios.description:
Dive into the mystical world of "Heroes & Dragons," an enthralling and new RPG where fantasy meets strategy in a quest for glory. With hundreds of heroes to guide you, experience a game that blends enchanting adventures with a touch of humor and tactical depth.
Amazing Campaign:
Embark on a gripping journey through a beautifully crafted world. Each chapter unfolds new challenges and spectacular scenes, pushing you to strategize and conquer. Discover ancient secrets and meet allies who will join in your epic quest.
Funny Story:
Amidst the battles and quests, "Heroes & Dragons" offers a lighthearted and engaging storyline. Enjoy witty dialogues, humorous twists, and delightful characters that keep the adventure enjoyable and refreshing. It's not just about fighting; it's about laughing along the way!
Deep Tactical Battle:
Prepare for combat that challenges your strategic thinking. Each battle requires careful planning as you manage resources, position your heroes, and exploit enemy weaknesses. With a variety of hero abilities, enemy types, and environmental factors, no two battles are the same.
Arena - PvP: 
Test your skills against other players in the thrilling Arena mode. Build your team, refine your tactics, and climb the leaderboards in intense player-versus-player battles. Show off your strategic prowess and earn exclusive rewards as you duel your way to the top.
Heroes & Dragons is not just a game, but a journey of courage, humor, and strategy. Are you ready to become a hero in a world of dragons and laughter? Download now and forge your path to glory!

bluejetty:00066189:ios.summary:
Explore a beautiful island in multiple different cars! Strap yourself in, sit behind the wheel of a dune buggy and start your adventure now!
FEATURES:
▶ 13 UNIQUE CARS: Dune buggy, food truck, circus truck and more!
▶ MULTIPLE EXCITING CHA
bluejetty:00066189:ios.description:
Explore a beautiful island in multiple different cars! Strap yourself in, sit behind the wheel of a dune buggy and start your adventure now!
FEATURES:
▶ 13 UNIQUE CARS: Dune buggy, food truck, circus truck and more!
▶ MULTIPLE EXCITING CHALLENGES: Pass all of the missions in style!
▶ FREE ROAMING MODE: Explore the area at your own pace
▶ REALISTIC TRAFFIC: Find your rhythm around narrow, overcrowded passes
▶ BEAUTIFUL OUTDOOR LOCATION: Climb uphill roads, drift on sandy beaches
▶ CONTROLS: Buttons, Wheel, Tilt & MFi Game Controller Support
Start your driving adventure on a beautiful island! When you feel warmed up, mix things up and hop into a sports car, quad bike or even a massive bus. This is a racing game that will bring the sun into your life! Drive through narrow mountain roads, drift across sandy beaches and venture offroad as you try to beat your high score. Become the fastest driver around, but remember – when you’re so close to the sky, even one mistake can be fatal!
The game features a wide and varied selection of cars. You start out in a fast and maneuverable dune buggy, but during the course of the game you will also drive bigger and more demanding vehicles (a food truck will not be the biggest of your problems!). By the time you reach a whole circus truck, you should be well enough versed in the intricacies of the gameplay to effectively react to every surprise the tracks may throw at you!
Narrow mountain roads are problematic in and of themselves, even without the traffic. Well, we’ve got traffic too, so be prepared to turn your driving skills up to 11! Not only you will have to overtake vehicles left on the side of the road. You will also have to find your rhythm around narrow, overcrowded passess, where even a small mistake may end up being fatal.
You will drive around a tropical island where the mountains meet the sea. Regardless of where you take your car you can be sure the view will be worth it!
The Main Game Mode is 100% FREE to play, all the way through, no strings attached! Extra Game Modes which alter the rules slightly to make the game easier are available through optional In-App Purchases.

bluejetty:00164489:ios.name: Reins: for Ollama & LM Studio
bluejetty:00164489:ios.summary:
Take the Reins of your AI.
Reins connects to your Ollama, LM Studio or any OpenAI-compatible server and runs local AI models directly on-device. It brings powerful AI models like Gemma, Qwen, Llama and more to your iPhone and iPad — with t
bluejetty:00164489:ios.description:
Take the Reins of your AI.
Reins connects to your Ollama, LM Studio or any OpenAI-compatible server and runs local AI models directly on-device. It brings powerful AI models like Gemma, Qwen, Llama and more to your iPhone and iPad — with tools, web search, and full control over every conversation. No login. No data collection.
PLUG-n-PLAY
Either connect to your Ollama, LM Studio or OpenAI-compatible server, or run models on-device. Reins just works, keeps everything private, every chat stays yours.
TOOLS & WEB SEARCH
Go beyond chat. Reins gives models the ability to search the web, fetch pages, calculate and reason across multiple steps — no API key required for web search.
FULL MODEL CONTROL
Download, switch and manage your models directly from the app. Connect multiple servers, configure API keys and custom headers and switch between them instantly. Access Ollama Cloud when you need it.
POWERFUL CHAT
Attach images, PDFs, CSVs and text files to any conversation. Enable thinking mode for deeper reasoning when you need it. Branch chats to explore different paths without losing your original thread. Never lose a cut-off response, pick up exactly where it stopped. Export or back up your conversations anytime.
FINE-GRAINED CONTROL
Set a different system prompt for every conversation. Dial in temperature, context size, max tokens and more for precise control over model behavior.
ON DEVICE MODELS
Run AI models directly on your iPhone and iPad without any setup. It's powered by MLX to achieve the best performance on Apple Silicon. You can download any MLX model even if it's not listed in the library. Reins also works with Apple Intelligence's on-device Foundation Models.
BACKGROUND PROCESSING
No need to wait around for complex reasoning, long responses or model downloads. Switch apps or lock your screen and Reins keeps generating in the background. Come back and it'll be waiting for you. (Requires iOS or iPadOS 26.0+)
Reins works with your Ollama, LM Studio or OpenAI-compatible server, or runs AI models on-device with no server required. Self-hosted or Ollama Cloud both work too.
Privacy Policy: https://getreins.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://getreins.app/terms

Homeland Community Bank Mobile Banking App is a secure mobile banking solution that enables customers to use their iPhone to initiate routine transactions and conduct research anytime, from anywhere. *Branch and ATM Locations
Homeland Community Bank Mobile App provides a FREE service that allows you to access your accounts anytime, from anywhere, using your iPhone. There is no fee from Homeland Community Bank. 
Connectivity and usage rates may apply. Contact your wireless service provider for more details.

Privacy Protection: We respect your privacy and ensure data security.
Reliable & Secure: Trusted by thousands for phone number identification.
Never get caught off guard by unknown calls again! Stay informed, stay secure, and take control of your incoming calls with Phone Number Locator & Finder.

The Magic 8-bit 8 Ball — the ultimate fortune teller. Shake for instant yes or no answers to any question.
In 1983 a potent mixture of dark magic, sorcery, voodoo, and star anise was all captured in an 8-ball which then gained the power to grant answers to questions that were stated in a very specific way. ...until now (obviously)! Luckily for you, we've captured all the dark energy from the original artefact, and have injected it into the app you are now downloading.
Typical valid questions include:
- Does [person x] love me?
- Will time travel be possible one day?
- Should I go out for pizza tonight?
- Should I download this app?
Typical invalid questions include:
- How dangerous are bears?
- How can I fly this helicopter?

bluejetty:00127064:ios.name: Singularity by Vaonis
bluejetty:00127064:ios.summary:
Singularity by Vaonis is the control center for your Stellina and Vespera observation stations. This intuitive mobile application allows you to explore the Cosmos with ease. 
Receive personalized recommendations on which objects to observe
bluejetty:00127064:ios.description:
Singularity by Vaonis is the control center for your Stellina and Vespera observation stations. This intuitive mobile application allows you to explore the Cosmos with ease. 
Receive personalized recommendations on which objects to observe according to your geolocation and the astronomical calendar. 
Learn more about the history of the Universe and immortalize your trip by photographing galaxies, nebulae and star clusters.
AUTOMATIC SETUP
Just press the button, and let Stellina and Vespera do the rest. Your new companion will use your GPS to find its position on Earth, adjust its focus and be ready to take you anywhere you want in less than 5 minutes.
AUTOMATIC ALIGNEMENT AND TRACKING
Choose your destination in the Singularity object catalog or enter the celestial coordinates of the object. 
Your station will automatically point to the selected area, and track it to maintain optimal viewing conditions.
IMAGE PROCESSING
It only takes a few seconds for Stellina and Vespera to deliver the first image of your destination before compiling dozens, hundreds or even thousands of other images in real time, progressively revealing ever greater details and colors. 
SPACE CENTER
Take control of your station from the Space Center: prepare your observation evening by checking the weather forecast, create and manage your observation locations, check the parameters of Stellina/Vespera... You can also read the astronomical news or our advice on Stellina and Vespera on our blog while waiting for nightfall.
MOSAIC MODE
CovalENS is the first automated “panorama mode” ever embedded into a telescope.
This unique patented technology, developed by Vaonis, allows you to take several photos of a same stellar region and then automatically stitch them together, thus offering users a larger view (field) of the universe.
SOLAR MODE
Observe easily and safely the closest star to Earth during the day with the Vaonis solar filters. The Solar Mode allows you to observe and capture sunspots that show the intensity of the Sun’s activity.
EXPERT MODE
Access an unlimited number of objects with coordinate pointing. Customize your camera's exposure time and gain to generate initial files for manual processing using image editing software.
PLAN MY NIGHT
Program your observation station for the night and let it explore the Universe on its own. After a good night's sleep, recover your photos on a USB key (Stellina) or via Wi-FI FTP protocol (Vespera).
SHARE YOUR JOURNEY ON SOCIAL NETWORKS
Your trip is over, share it! Show the world your photos on social networks and join our community of explorers, using the hashtags #myStellina or #myVespera.

EXPERT MODE
Access an unlimited number of objects with coordinate pointing. Customize your camera's exposure time and gain to generate initial files for manual processing using image editing software.

PLAN MY NIGHT
Program your observation station for the night and let it explore the Universe on its own. After a good night's sleep, recover your photos on a USB key (Stellina) or via Wi-FI FTP protocol (Vespera).

SHARE YOUR JOURNEY ON SOCIAL NETWORKS
Your trip is over, share it! Show the world your photos on social networks and join our community of explorers, using the hashtags #myStellina or #myVespera.

bluejetty:00185467:ios.description:
GHIN is the app built for golfers by the USGA — post scores, track your Handicap Index®, play with GPS, and see the stats that show how your game is trending. 
WHAT YOU CAN DO 
• Post scores and track stats — Update your Handicap Index by posting total or hole-by-hole scores, with the option to track fairways, greens in regulation, and putts. 
• Play a round with GPS: simplified setup, richer course graphics, one-handed scoring, or switch to a simple digital Scorecard if you'd rather skip GPS 
• See your game in the new Stats section: recent trends, score history, hole-by-hole, advanced stats, and course-specific performance 
• Set up and play fair matches against other golfers with a Handicap Index — including front nine / back nine / overall results 
• Compete on virtual leaderboards through Challenges, at select courses through your Allied Golf Association 
• Play hands-free — track your whole round right from your Apple Watch
GETTING STARTED & UPGRADES 
• Start with a Free Trial: post 3 scores to get an Estimated Handicap Range, and continue posting for 30 days after that 
• Enhanced GPS is available as a premium upgrade — Green Maps and front/back yardages on your phone, plus hazard and layup yardages on Apple Watch. 
• Membership through an Allied Golf Association is required for full app functionality

Know before you go. Empower others as you roll.
Roll Mobility makes it easier for wheelchair users, caregivers, and allies to navigate public spaces with confidence. Whether you’re going to a coffee shop, hotel, campus, or event venue, Rol
bluejetty:00030309:ios.description:
Know before you go. Empower others as you roll.
Roll Mobility makes it easier for wheelchair users, caregivers, and allies to navigate public spaces with confidence. Whether you’re going to a coffee shop, hotel, campus, or event venue, Roll helps you discover how accessible it really is before you get there.
We believe accessibility shouldn't be hidden or hard to find. That’s why we’re building the world’s most helpful database of real, crowdsourced accessibility reviews, photos, videos, and first-hand experiences from people who’ve actually been there.
Features That Matter:
Search With Purpose
• Find accessible spots nearby or explore cities before you visit.
Share What You See
• Leave quick reviews, mark accessible features, and add your own photos and videos.
• Use emojis and comments to react to others’ reviews—because accessibility is personal.
Join Teams & Make Impact
• Create or join local teams to map neighborhoods, campuses, or event spaces.
• Earn points for your contributions and compete on fun leaderboards.
Built With and For the Community
• Roll is co-created with feedback from wheelchair users, disability advocates, caregivers, and access-minded allies.
• Partnered with community organizations to map cities ahead of major events like the Super Bowl.
Your Voice Helps Build a More Accessible World
Every review you leave helps someone else roll into a space with more confidence. Whether you’re traveling, planning an outing, or advocating for better inclusion, Roll Mobility gives you the tools to make a difference.
Start today. Map your world. Help others roll freely.

listings.name: Roll Mobility
listings.description:
Roll Mobility shows you what a place is like before you get there. Is there a step at the entrance? Does the restroom fit a wheelchair? How loud, bright and crowded does it get?

The answers come from people who get around on wheels, with a cane, with a stroller or with sensory needs. They know what to look for, so the details in their reviews are the ones you need.

THE MAP
See the places around you, with pins colored by restroom rating. Filter by sound, light, smell and crowd levels, by rating, or by who added the review. Tap a pin for the place's accessibility features, photos and reviews.

WRITE A REVIEW
A review has three short sections: Venue, Restroom and Sensory. Each one takes a few minutes and asks what the next visitor will want to know. Confirm the features you saw, like automatic doors, accessible parking or an adult changing station, and add photos.

EARN POINTS
Reviews, photos, videos and snapshots all earn points. Move up from New to Reputable, Established and Expert, and see where you rank worldwide.

SNAPSHOTS
Pin a quick photo or video to the map to show a ramp, a broken elevator or a blocked sidewalk.

THE FEED
Reviews, posts and news from people near you and people you follow. Follow anyone whose needs are like yours, and join groups for your city or for the things you care about.

BUILT FOR MORE PEOPLE
Roll Mobility is available in 16 languages. Map pins have a color-blind friendly option. Browse the map without an account, and sign in with Apple, Google, email or a phone number when you want to post.

If a place has no reviews yet, you can write the first one.

Introducing Chemistry Solver: AI Scanner – the ultimate app for solving chemistry problems with the power of AI! Designed specifically for students, professionals, and chemistry enthusiasts, this app makes tackling chemistry problems easier than ever. Whether you’re dealing with complex chemical equations, looking for detailed step-by-step solutions, or need a quick reference tool, Chemistry Solver has you covered.
Key Features:
 • AI-Powered Chemistry Problem Solving
Simply scan a chemistry problem using your iPhone, crop the relevant part, and let the AI solver handle the rest. Get instant, accurate solutions with detailed explanations.
 • Follow-up Questions
Don’t stop at one problem! Ask follow-up questions to dive deeper into any concept or formula related to the problem. The AI is ready to help you fully understand.
 • Comprehensive Chemistry Tools
Access built-in chemistry tools like the Periodic Table and Chemistry Formulas that are readily available to assist you in solving any problem.
 • AI Chemistry Tutor
Have your own personal AI tutor with in-depth knowledge of chemistry and other subjects like math, physics, and biology. Get answers to all your questions, from simple concepts to advanced topics.
 • Step-by-Step Solutions
Understand the “why” behind each answer! The app provides clear, step-by-step solutions for each chemistry problem, helping you learn and master difficult concepts.
 • History Tracking
Never lose track of a solved problem! The app saves all past problems and solutions, making it easy to revisit previous answers whenever you need.
 • Multidisciplinary AI
While Chemistry Solver specializes in chemistry, the AI is versatile and can also help with a wide range of subjects such as mathematics, physics, biology, and history.
Solve chemistry problems faster, learn better, and enjoy a complete chemistry learning experience with Chemistry Solver: AI Scanner! Whether you’re in a classroom, studying at home, or prepping for exams, this app is your go-to chemistry assistant.
Download now and start mastering chemistry today!

bluejetty:00019470:ios.description:
Enjoy Sudoku, with thousands of free Sudoku puzzles on one of the best Sudoku games in the app store. If you like logic, number-based puzzles, you will love these classic Sudoku puzzles!
About Sudoku Puzzle Game:
Every Sudoku puzzle has a unique solution that can be reached logically without guessing. Fill in the grid such that every row, column and 3x3 box contains all of the numbers from 1 to 9. While solving it’s good to keep in mind that a number cannot appear more than once in a given row, column or 3x3 box. Challenge your Sudoku solving skills with our hard Sudoku puzzles!
This Sudoku game offers numerous features to help you solve the puzzles including cell candidate tracking, unlimited undo moves and a “check” feature that lets you know how you’re doing. Our Sudoku game also saves your uncompleted puzzles so you can come back and finish them whenever you want! Work your way up through four levels of difficulty: easy, normal, hard and expert Sudoku.
Track your best and average solve times over history with our stats tracker.
You can play Sudoku by Razzle Puzzles on your phone and tablet. Enjoy Sudoku online or in offline mode!
For support please contact us at support@razzlepuzzles.com or visit RazzlePuzzles.com

bluejetty:00015428:ios.description:
Create whatever you can imagine in 3D. Design solutions to real-world problems. Unlock more features and tools as you level up. Share your 3D designs with 2.2+ million makers in 50 countries.
APP FEATURES
Learn how to design in 3D with basic, pro and video tutorials in the Training Lab.
Create 3D designs using Shaper, a traditional free-form 3D modelling module, or Blocker, a voxel editor.
Create a unique avatar to represent you in the Makers Empire world.
Share your designs in the Gallery, alongside 100,000+ other new designs every single day, so fellow designers can like and comment on your designs.
Test your skills by completing daily Design Challenges and entering monthly Design Thinking competitions.
Build and play 3D mazes with your friends in Maze Mania.
Level up as you design and unlock new design tools.
MAKERS EMPIRE FOR TEACHERS
Makers Empire helps primary, elementary and middle school educators cover international Design & Technology curriculum, teach Design Thinking and STEM and embrace maker pedagogy using 3D design and 3D printing. 
Makers Empire is backed by Macquarie University research, certified by Education Alliance Finland for pedagogical quality, and endorsed by Common Sense Education. 
Makers Empire’s subscriptions for schools include Makers Empire 3D software, in-app, curriculum-aligned challenge courses, 150+ curriculum-aligned lesson plans, professional development, class management tools, student assessment tools, resources, training, ongoing support and analytics.
MAKERS EMPIRE FOR PARENTS & GUARDIANS
Encourage your child’s creativity and help them develop important Design Thinking, critical thinking and problem-solving skills with Makers Empire 3D. Makers Empire is certified by the Education Alliance Finland for pedagogical quality, backed by Macquarie University research and endorsed by Common Sense Education.

bluejetty:00079232:ios.name: AudioCardio Hearing & Tinnitus
bluejetty:00079232:ios.summary:
AudioCardio: Clinically proven hearing and sound therapy. Designed to strengthen your hearing and provide relief from tinnitus.
Simply take a hearing test and generate a personalized 60-minute sound therapy session, tailored to each ear.
bluejetty:00079232:ios.description:
AudioCardio: Clinically proven hearing and sound therapy. Designed to strengthen your hearing and provide relief from tinnitus.
Simply take a hearing test and generate a personalized 60-minute sound therapy session, tailored to each ear. 
It’s one session per day and you can listen to it while doing other activities like exercising or even listening to music. 
AS SEEN ON: Fast Company’s World Changing Ideas Finalist., CNET, Yahoo!, Healthy Hearing, and more!
HIGHLIGHTS
• Sound therapy that aims to help maintain, protect and strengthen hearing
• Fast hearing check that creates a personalized sound therapy for your ears
• Generates hearing score, usage metrics and identifies targeted frequencies for each ear
• Integrates with your music, streaming services and other daily activities
CLINICALLY PROVEN 
Using Threshold Sound Conditioning™ technology (TSC), our sound therapy stimulates the inner ear cells to target damaged hearing for each ear.
TSC technology had been clinically proven with:
- Stanford Univ.
- Samsung Medical Center
- Palo Alto Medical Foundation
- Nanjing Univ.
- Chung Ang Univ.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
AudioCardio offers 4 auto-renewing subscription options:
Basic Monthly - $ 9.99 / mo 
Pro+ Monthly - $12.99 /mo
Pro+ Semi-Annual - $64.99 every 6 months
Pro+ Annual - $99.99 every 12 months
Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
This price is for the United States. Pricing in other countries vary and may be converted to your local currency depending on your country of residence.

Privacy Policy

Terms & Conditions

Privacy Policy

DISCLAIMER 
This isn’t a clinical hearing test. This should be considered a hearing check or screening and cannot be used to prescribe a hearing aid. It should only be used as a method to see if you may have hearing loss since it is not a clinical hearing test.
This isn’t a medical device and hasn’t been reviewed by the FDA as a hearing loss solution. It’s not intended to self-diagnose any disease, injury or disability like tinnitus or hearing loss. If you believe you have hearing loss or tinnitus, please consult your doctor, or other qualified healthcare professional before using this app. Use this app at your own risk. AudioCardio™ does not take responsibility for direct or indirect damage that could result from its use.

bluejetty:00032517:ios.description:
Unleash Your Creativity with "DALI":
Welcome to DALI, where your imagination leaps beyond boundaries through the power of artificial intelligence. Our cutting-edge app transforms your words into stunning visual masterpieces, offering an unparalleled experience in digital art creation.
Why Choose DALI?
Diverse Styles at Your Fingertips: From the gritty streets of a cyberpunk city to the eerie allure of macabre scenes, DALI's vast array of styles, including cybernetic enhancements, photorealism, and more, ensures your artwork is as unique as your imagination.
Customizable Tags for Infinite Possibilities: Spice up your prompts with a rich selection of tags. Whether you're envisioning a mythical creature lurking in an enchanted forest or a futuristic cityscape at dusk, our app brings your most intricate ideas to life.
Seamless Integration: Once your artwork is created, the possibilities are endless. Download your creations for personal use, add them to your collection to admire later, or share them publicly on the app’s feed. Let the world see your vision and inspire others in the DALI's community.
Empower Your Artistic Journey
DALI's is more than an app; it's a gateway to exploring uncharted territories of your creativity. Whether you're a professional artist seeking inspiration, a hobbyist exploring new realms, or simply someone who loves to experiment with art, DALI is your perfect companion.

---

***************************
Kannada balasi, Kannada ulisi
***************************
◉ Best Kannada Keyboard Ever for Kannadigas
◉ Type the English word, Get the Kannada Meaning Instantly Offline
◉ Easy Letter Suggestions - Offline
◉ 50% More Faster than normal keyboards 
◉ Easily differentiate the Letters On Keyboard
◉ Get suggestions for the letters Typed on Keyboard
◉ Help Grow Our Kannada Community
◉ Please Support Development By sharing with others
◉ Whatever you type from this is keyboard is safe and secure, you don't have to give "Allow full access" on settings to use this App
-------------------------------------
HOW TO INSTALL KANNADA KEYBOARD
-------------------------------------
Once you downloaded the app from Appstore.
Step 1: Go to iPhone settings.
Step 2: Find General And Click on it.
Step 3:Scroll Down to bottom and see Keyboard option, Click on it.
Step 4: Click on the Keyboards Row.
Step 5: Scroll Down bottom of the screen and find "Add New Keyboard" Option and tap on it.
Step 6: Scroll down and find the Namma Kannada Keyboard Option And tap on it, Thats it you are done.
Now finally open any of the WhatsApp,Facebook,Email,Notes,Twitter, sms app, and long press the Globe icon from the default keyboard, now choose the Namma Kannada Keyboard Option.
And Start Typing In Kannada.
**************************
ಕನ್ನಡ Keyboard — The #1 Kanglish Typing App for iPhone & iPad
Type Kannada the way you speak it — just type in English (Roman) letters and instantly get beautiful Kannada script. No learning. No stickers. No switching. Just type.
◆ WHY 1 MILLION+ INDIAN LANGUAGE USERS CHOOSE US
Stop struggling with complex Kannada keyboards. With our smart Kanglish-to-Kannada transliteration engine, you just type "namma" and get ನಮ್ಮ. Type "kannada" and get ಕನ್ನಡ. It's that simple.
◆ KEY FEATURES
→ Kanglish Transliteration — Type in English, get Kannada instantly. Zero learning curve for Kannada speakers worldwide.
→ Massive Word Database — 650,000+ Kannada words with smart autocomplete. The largest Kannada word suggestion library on the App Store.
→ Next Word Prediction — Our AI-powered bigram engine predicts your next word so you type faster than ever.
→ Lightning Fast — Optimized for iOS. Zero lag, zero crashes. Engineered for iPhone 15 and all modern iPads.
→ Smart Word Suggestions — 3 intelligent suggestions on every keystroke. Always finds the right Kannada word.
→ Full Emoji & Symbol Support — Express yourself with emojis alongside Kannada text seamlessly.
→ Switch Modes Instantly — Flip between Kannada, English, and Numbers with one tap.
→ 100% Privacy — We never read, store, or share anything you type. Ever. No internet required for typing.
→ Works Everywhere — WhatsApp, Instagram, iMessage, Gmail, Twitter/X, Snapchat, Notes — every app on your iPhone.
◆ PERFECT FOR
→ Kannadigas living abroad who want to message in ಕನ್ನಡ
→ Students learning Kannada script
→ Professionals writing Kannada emails and documents
→ Anyone who thinks in Kannada but types in English
◆ HOW KANGLISH WORKS
You type: namaskara → You get: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ
You type: bengaluru → You get: ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು
You type: kannada → You get: ಕನ್ನಡ
You type: hudugaru → You get: ಹುಡುಗರು
No memorizing Unicode. No copy-pasting from websites. Just type naturally.
◆ LOVED BY THE KANNADA COMMUNITY
From Bengaluru to Toronto, from Mysuru to Sydney — Kannadigas around the world use this keyboard to stay connected to their language and culture.

Além disso, a nossa calculadora automática de preços garante que você nunca mais fique no prejuízo. Defina as suas próprias regras de preços e o aplicativo fará o resto, mantendo um equilíbrio financeiro saudável.

Não há mais necessidade de lidar com papéis e canetas para gerar recibos e orçamentos.
E tem mais! O nosso aplicativo conta com um controle de agenda que ajuda você a gerenciar seus compromissos e serviços com eficiência. 
Você pode acompanhar quais serviços precisam ser realizados, quais clientes precisam ser atendidos e quais serviços já foram concluídos, tudo em uma única plataforma. 
Com isso, você terá total controle sobre o seu negócio, podendo se dedicar a outras atividades e aumentar ainda mais o seu sucesso.
Mas o sucesso não vem sem esforço. É necessário ter a coragem e a determinação de dar o primeiro passo e se dedicar ao seu negócio.

Então, o que está esperando? O sucesso espera por você! Experimente agora mesmo o nosso aplicativo Meu Ajudante de orçamento de serviços e produtos e veja como o seu negócio pode crescer e prosperar com rapidez e facilidade.

bluejetty:00146375:ios.name: Jane for Clients
bluejetty:00146375:ios.summary: Managing your health just got a lot easier! With one secure login, you can rebook, manage, and join virtual appointments from all your favourite Jane clinics, plus send and receive secure messages and files with your practitioners — all in
bluejetty:00146375:ios.description:
Managing your health just got a lot easier! With one secure login, you can rebook, manage, and join virtual appointments from all your favourite Jane clinics, plus send and receive secure messages and files with your practitioners — all in one place.
Jane’s mobile app is a secure place for clients to manage appointments. If you’re a clinic owner or practitioner, this app isn’t for managing your business—Jane’s web version (Jane.app) is still the best place for you! 
What can this app do? 
- Connect any of your existing Jane clinics to one secure ID and login
- View all your upcoming appointment details at a glance
- Easily rebook, reschedule or cancel appointments—for yourself or a group
- Join secure online appointments (telehealth) from anywhere
- Send and receive secure messages and files with your clinic
- Save time logging in using your phone's biometrics (like Face ID)
This app is not a directory and does not allow you to browse or find new practitioners or new clinics. Instead, it’s designed for patients and clients who have already visited and/or have accounts with clinics using Jane.
If you’re already a patient or client of a clinic, practice, or studio (who uses Jane to run their business)—perfect! Just download the app, create a new login, start connecting your accounts, and book your next massage before you have time to reach for an ice pack.
If you have never created an account with a Jane clinic, you’ll need to do that first. Start by clicking the [Sign In or Sign Up] button on the clinics or practice website/online booking site, complete your intake form, then you’ll be able to add them in the app.

bluejetty:00027582:ios.description:
Claria combines hypnosis with cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) to equip you with 12 essential skills for effectively managing your mental wellness.
Developed with Dr. Michael Yapko, this program is based on substantial clinical research that shows people feel better and do better when equipped with the necessary skills to cope well with life challenges.
The 12 skills within this program can help you manage emotional distress, increase positivity, and enhance your quality of life. As you master each skill, you’re adding another tool to your mental health toolkit.
Learn by listening:
Listen to daily audio sessions that combine key lessons for better mental well-being. Delivered via hypnosis, these 15-minute sessions are a time to relax, reflect, and learn.
Learn by doing:
Reflect on the skills you are building and learn to apply them in your everyday life. Through practice you will learn to master these new approaches to reduce emotional distress,
Created with Dr. Michael Yapko:
Claria was created alongside Dr. Michael Yapko, a clinical psychologist internationally recognized for his work in advancing clinical hypnosis and outcome-focused psychotherapy. Dr. Yapko’s approach puts to work well established research that shows the addition of hypnosis to CBT raises its overall effectiveness.
Real-life skills:
Using practical, science-backed techniques, this breakthrough program combines insightful hypnotherapy sessions with practical exercises. You’ll be guided to apply your new skills to your everyday experiences, empowering you to manage life’s challenges.
What you get:
- 12 essential skills to promote mental well-being
- Insightful audio sessions that combine CBT and hypnosis
- Practical Learn by Doing exercises to apply these new skills to your life
- Daily Pause and Reflect moments to consider your learnings
- Practical lessons to help self-manage feelings of stress, anxiety, and depression in your daily life.
Medical disclaimer:
This program is designed to complement therapy or be used on its own. Regardless, it’s always important to check with your doctor before making any medical decisions, like self-diagnosing mental health concerns.
There are other health issues which have similar symptoms, and our program may mask the symptoms of these issues as well.
This program is a self-management tool but doesn’t replace any other medical or professional care, diagnosis, or treatment.
Claria uses digital hypnosis-based CBT techniques and is based on established clinical guidelines: https://www.ranzcp.org/getmedia/5456b019-e2dd-4d7a-91d3-ca0ca8b356e3/anxiety-disorders-cpg.pdf
If you subscribe through iTunes, the credit card associated with your iTunes account will be charged at the end of the 7-day trial period, and your subscription will automatically renew every 12 months thereafter unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current payment period. If you do not cancel, your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. If you purchase a subscription during the free trial period, any unused portion of the trial period will be forfeited.
To manage your Claria subscription from iTunes:
1) On your iOS device, go to your device Settings and the ‘iTunes & App Stores’.
2) Tap on your Apple ID.
3) Tap to ‘View Apple ID’. (You may need to sign in or use Touch ID.)
4) Tap on ‘Subscriptions’.
5) Choose ‘Claria Subscription.
6) Tap ‘Cancel Subscription’.
For more information, please see our Terms and Conditions of Use: https://www.mindsethealth.com/legal/terms-conditions-claria

bluejetty:00127827:ios.description:
ABC is the complete contact manager! With ABC, you can easily create, edit, and delete contacts & groups. Send mass texts and group emails. View recently created contacts. Share or print your contacts. Create backups. Get birthday notifications. And so much more:
CONTACTS: 
• View all of your contacts organized by account or group
• Easily find a contact with ABC's powerful search tool
• Select multiple contacts and perform a number of actions including text, email, share, and delete
• Quickly perform a number of functions with one touch directly from the contact card
GROUPS: 
• Create groups of contacts from any account including iCloud, Google, Exchange or Outlook
• Filter contacts by one or more groups at the same time
• Add & remove contacts from a particular group
• Add & remove groups from a particular contact
FAVORITES: 
• Create a list of favorites allowing you to quickly call/message/email those contacts
GROUP EMAILS & MESSAGES: 
• Send messages to groups via iMessage, SMS, & WhatsApp
• Send emails to groups via Mail App or Gmail App
• Attach photos & documents, including from Dropbox
• Assign the to/cc/bcc email field to each contact individually
• Give your message a personal touch - Automatically refer to each contact by name
COMPANIES, BIRTHDAYS, ANNIVERSARIES, MOST VIEWED, RECENTLY CREATED/MODIFIED/DELETED:
• Sort your contacts by company name
• View upcoming birthdays & anniversaries
• View your most frequently viewed contacts
• View recently created & modified contacts
• View & restore your recently deleted contacts
SHARE CONTACTS:
• Share one or more contacts via text message, email, or various other services
• Export contacts in the CSV or vCard format
DELETE CONTACTS & GROUPS:
• Quickly delete contacts & groups
BACKUP:
• Create a backup of any contact account
• Restore your backup to any contact account
CLONE CONTACTS & GROUPS:
• Clone a contact from the contact card screen including all contact fields & groups
• Clone a group so you don't have to add all of the group members manually
START SCREEN:
• Specify whether the app should load the contacts, groups, or favorites screen at startup
SHORTCUTS:
• Press & hold a contact or group to conveniently perform a number of common functions
SYNC CONTACTS WITH GOOGLE:
• Fully compatible with the "Contacts Sync For Google Gmail" app so that you can sync your iPhone/iPad contact changes to Gmail
WORKS WELL WITH OTHER CONTACT APPS:
• Any contact changes you make with this app will be reflected in any other contact app that queries the iPhone address book (including the standard Contacts & Phone app)
COMPATIBILITY: 
• Compatible with iPhone, iPad, iPod, iOS 15, iOS 16, iOS 17, iOS 18, iOS 26
LANGUAGES:
• Translated into English, Spanish, French, German, & Italian
SUBSCRIPTIONS:
• ABC offers a "Premium" subscription which removes advertisements.
• The "Premium" subscription is priced at $0.99 USD and the subscription length is 1 year
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, at a cost of $0.99 USD
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
• Terms of use: https://playaapps.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360003030954
• Privacy Policy: https://playaapps.zendesk.com/hc/articles/229824667

bluejetty:00175048:ios.name: Bark - Parental Controls
bluejetty:00175048:ios.summary:
Bark provides families with all the tools they need to raise kids in the digital age. Our comprehensive service lets you monitor content, manage screen time, and filter websites so you can get peace of mind while your child is online.
CONT
bluejetty:00175048:ios.description:
Bark provides families with all the tools they need to raise kids in the digital age. Our comprehensive service lets you monitor content, manage screen time, and filter websites so you can get peace of mind while your child is online.
CONTENT MONITORING
Bark monitors your child’s texts, email, YouTube, and 30+ apps and social media platforms for issues like cyberbullying, adult content, sexual predators, profanity, suicidal ideation, threats of violence, and more. Parents receive alerts only when something potentially problematic occurs online. You won’t have full access to everything on your child’s phone — just the things you might need to know about.
SCREEN TIME MANAGEMENT
Families can set healthy time limits and create schedules for when their children’s devices can connect to the internet (through both cell service and Wi-Fi).
WEB FILTERING
Our web filter lets you select which websites your child can access on their devices. You can allow or block specific sites — or even whole categories like streaming services, online gaming, sexual content, and more.
BARK TESTIMONIALS
• "My wife and I LOVE Bark. We've had some tough but productive conversations with our 13-year-old son. It's proving to be extremely valuable." — Josh L.
• “It’s just another set of protections we as parents give our kids for the digital environment (or as my 10-year-old calls it, a “cell phone seat belt”). My oldest is a 9th grader, and while I trust her, I’ve come to realize through the alerts that some of her friends aren’t truly her friends. It’s led to some amazing conversations about choosing friends wisely and recognizing toxic people. While she wasn’t for Bark at first, she’s since said she’s grateful that I saw those messages because it reaffirmed what she was feeling but didn’t know how to verbalize without sounding sensitive.” — Bark Parent
• "Bark notified me that my young daughter had unknowingly revealed her phone number to strangers on Twitter. The fact that Bark notified me was impressive and led to an informative discussion with her the same day." — Jon B.
• “Since Bark alerted us to the suicidal language used in the Google doc that was being used in a chat document with a friend, we have seen both a pediatrician and a licensed counselor. We are hopeful for a positive outcome. Thanks to Bark for letting us peek into our child’s mind!” — Bark Parent
• “This app is a lifesaver! It has allowed us to catch so many “red flags” in the content my kids have accessed on their devices and in their interactions with friends and other people online that I wouldn’t have ever known about otherwise. The big difference between Bark and other “Parental Control” software is that Bark allows your kids to have so much more privacy. It doesn’t show you everything they do, but sends an instant alert regarding any activity that might be concerning. Highly recommended!” — Bark Parent
With Bark, you can help keep your kids safe both online and in real life. Try it out for seven days absolutely free!
Our Family Online Safety Specialists are standing by to help answer any questions you may have. Email help@bark.us or visit help.bark.us to get answers and advice from the Bark Team. 
Terms of Use
https://www.bark.us/terms

Smart Keys makes writing easier and more enjoyable. As bilinguals passionate about languages, we created this smart keyboard to help anyone communicate fluently and effortlessly. Whether it’s polishing grammar, adding style, or translating instantly, Smart Keys simplifies your writing experience. It’s a game-changer for ESL users and those balancing multilingual conversations, bringing natural flow to every message.
Smart Keys is designed to help you communicate naturally, without losing your unique style. From keeping in touch with loved ones to managing multilingual conversations at work, Smart Keys, as your go-to writing tools, make switching between languages a breeze.
NOW A SCREEN TRANSLATOR AND SMART REPLY
- On-the-Fly Translation: Instantly translate incoming messages, screenshots, or entire conversation threads, perfect for TikTok refugees on RedNote 小红书 (Xiaohongshu).
- Smart Reply Suggestions: Get quick, context-aware responses in any language.

bluejetty:00023197:ios.description:
Welcome to the island!
The secrets of an ancient civilization, family drama, an intricately designed story, and landscapes straight from paradise await you!
Emily sailed to the island to find her brother, only to then get tangled in an exhilarating whirl of activity. In this exploring game, you help her as she develops her family estate, makes friends with locals, and traverses picturesque ruins!
If stories are to be believed, a prominent civilization once lived on this island, known for its cutting-edge technological advancements. For reasons unknown, it fell into ruin. Now is the time to find out what fate befell the ancient people and discover their legendary treasures.
Cultivate valuable resources, join exciting expeditions, and travel through the jungle to uncover the secrets of this treasure island and save Emily's brother!
Features:
● An intricate story
Throughout Emily's adventures on the island, danger and surprises are always just around the corner. You never know what will happen next!
● The family estate
A large estate on the ocean shore is yours to manage. Furnish and decorate it as you progress. Remember that a bountiful harvest and a high income grant you more resources for exploring the island.
● Mental exercises
All the minigames the island has to offer assure you’ll never get bored!
● Secrets of the island
What happened in this secret paradise eons ago? Why did an entire civilization meet its demise? What lurks in the ruins? It's up to you to uncover answers to all these questions!
● Expeditions
These are not your average camping trips! Enjoy an exciting adventure in the heart of the jungle.
● Treasure hunt
Become an avid treasure hunter and add valuable finds to your collection.
● Eye-pleasing design
Colorful and captivating graphics with attention paid to every detail brighten up the game, making it stand out from the crowd.
Let this exhilarating adventure distract you from the everyday fusses and bustle of life! Emily, our brave hero, hopes that you will join her on the lost island.
Farewell!
Enjoy Island Hoppers? Follow our Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/IslandHoppersGame

bluejetty:00186114:ios.description:
Welcome to SKIDOS!
With our unique learning games, make learning fun for your 2-11-year-olds. SKIDOS games help kids practice math & develop an interest in coding. You can get a new SKIDOS Pass or log in with an existing one from within this app. All SKIDOS Passes are auto-renewable with monthly, quarterly, bi-annual & annual Passes for up to six kids. With one SKIDOS Pass, you can add up to 6 profiles. Each profile can be customized according to the grade (Preschool, Kindergarten, 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th grade) & the learning style of your kids.
_____
TRAIN
Have fun driving the train in a super cool 3D game!
Help the train to collect the scattered wagons of different colors. Three wagons of the same color in a row will remove all the wagons of that color off the train. Dropping bonuses bring more fun to the game. Get coins for the collected wagons, complete various tasks, buy new locomotives.
Besides wagons and bonuses there are puzzle pieces appearing on the area. Collect them by the train and compose pictures. Get unique locomotives for the puzzles composed.
 Features:
 - Four playing areas of different sizes and configurations
 - Four difficulty modes
 - Three pictures-puzzle
 - Bonuses on the game area
 - Numerous tasks completed will give you more coins
 - Seven gorgeous locomotives 
 The game for all ages!
_____
DEAR PARENTS & TEACHERS,
Get Your SKIDOS Pass to all of our apps! Our apps are primarily designed as super fun games that children LOVE playing. We then integrate interactive learning content into them to make it a seamless & enjoyable experience for kids all over the globe.
ENCOURAGE YOUR KIDS TO LEARN MATH & CODING 
All SKIDOS games turn classroom lessons into fun challenges, especially for kids in the 1st,2nd,3rd,4th,5th grades. In this updated version, we added more interactive ways for your kids to strengthen their math skills! Our math problems are now more visual & dynamic, for an engaging & fun experience.
40+ GAMES WITH A SINGLE SKIDOS PASS 
Why pay for each game individually when you can get all of them at once! 40+ games included in one SKIDOS Pass. Get game recommendations from within the app & track progress across all of our games in a single dashboard.
CUSTOMIZED LEARNING & PRACTICE 
Kids have different learning styles. All SKIDOS games give children the option to pick subjects (math or coding), grade (1st,2nd,3rd,4th,5th grade) & topic, & progress with problem-solving.
START CRACKING CODING & LOVING MATH
All learning content in SKIDOS games is aligned to the Common Core State Standards for Mathematics & covers a comprehensive list of topics. These include number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, & division as well as fractions, decimals, geometry & many more!
For kids who are interested in coding, SKIDOS has developed a unique curriculum that teaches them concepts around basic programming & computational thinking.
All SKIDOS games are COPPA & GDPR compliant & have no third-party advertising.
Get your SKIDOS Pass today! 
- SKIDOS has monthly, quarterly, bi-annual, & annual Passes. 
- Add up to six kids, play 40+ games with one Pass.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple Account after any free trial period if applicable. 
- Passes renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- The SKIDOS Pass may be managed by the user & any auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings.
- Cancellation will not go into effect until the end of the billing cycle.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a Pass, where applicable.
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
For support, write to us at support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00088431:ios.description:
Welcome survivor!
Get ready to enter to this thrilling surprise and exploring science fiction world？This is a world about alien invasion and then tracking aliens to fight on different planets.
Space Survival , a monster-infested world system, crawling with all kinds of vicious creatures. Basically, the perfect venue for a twisted spectating alien sports tournament to the death.
Are you a fan of survival games or warrior games? No matter what kind of fan you are, you will love Space Survival’s world stopping survival craft features! From a complete noob to warrior, combine the best skills to destroy enemies and become the conqueror! You can create thousands of unique skill combinations to overcome the challenges and survive each wave of enemies’ attacks.
The only survivors of mankind call you to go to different planets to clear the invading aliens and monsters, learn various skills, and find precious magic treasures, so as to realize the mission of rescuing your companions and saving mankind.
You can gain experience through hard fought battles, and decide which skills it learns.
The rules are simple: you must survive the treacherous dungeons, filled with hordes of nasty monsters. If you reach the end, you will face an even more powerful monster. The reward for defeating the boss? A huge loot pile and… another dungeon, of course, this is how sinister this competition is!

bluejetty:00040858:ios.description:
Stronger, Healthier, Happier – All in One App!
Get the tools you need to transform with custom meal plans, quick & effective workouts, expert coaching, and a supportive community. Enjoy fresh weekly recipes, workouts from strength to HIIT to yoga, and monthly Challenge Sprints to keep you motivated. Stay on track with the Strong Woman Success Toolkit, including hormone & thyroid health plans, stress management, and a clinically proven supplement guide for energy, sleep, and menopause support. Plus, live weekly coaching calls with Melissa and top experts ensure you never go it alone!
Features:
• Customizable meal plans with fresh weekly recipes
• Flexible workouts for gym, home, or follow-along in 20 minutes
• Expert coaching & live weekly calls with Melissa & health pros
• Challenge Sprints to keep you motivated every month
• Strong Woman Success Toolkit with hormone, thyroid, and gut health plans
• Proven supplement guide for strength, energy, and menopause support
• Private community for accountability and motivation
INFORMATION ABOUT THE APP AND PURCHASE OPTIONS
By signing up, you will get access to subscription(s) that include features such as progress tracking, and offline sync.
The download of BodyByBikini is free of charge. Should you use BodyByBikini to access in-app content, we offer one of the following options:
Subscription based plan(s) - a recurring payment will be charged to your credit card after the trial period ends and when a subscription renews. A subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. There is no increase in price when renewing.
Subscription(s) can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in Account Settings in the App Store after purchase.
One-time purchase based plan(s) - a payment will be charged to your credit card only once.

bluejetty:00015324:ios.description:
3400+ Dream Interpretations by Muhammad Ibn Sirin
Muhammad Ibn Sirin (born in Basra) was a Muslim interpreter of dreams who lived in the 8th century
According to Yehia Gouda's most authoritative encyclopedic reference book on Muslim oneiromancy
He was particularly renowned for his extraordinary skill in interpreting dreams as attested by the Arabs' greatest intellectuals, such as Al-Gaheth, Ibn Qutaybah and Ibn Khaldoun, who considered his work as crucial in this field.
The most notable of the books attributed to him is Dreams and Interpretations. Ibn Al-Nadim says that he was the author of Taabirul Ro'oya (What Dreams Express), which is different from or an abridged version of Muntakhabul Kalam Fi Tafsir El Ahlam (A Concise Guide for the Interpretation of Dreams) first printed in Bulaq, Egypt, in 1284 AH, in Lucknow in AD 1874 and in Bombay in 1296 AH.
Muhammad Ibn Sirin he was known for correctly interpreting dreams

bluejetty:00168815:ios.summary: Word Salad is an original and challenging daily word game that fits perfectly into your morning routine. Swipe the grid to reveal the words hidden in each themed puzzle, and watch as the letters fall away. You’ll need both logic and general
bluejetty:00168815:ios.description:
Word Salad is an original and challenging daily word game that fits perfectly into your morning routine. Swipe the grid to reveal the words hidden in each themed puzzle, and watch as the letters fall away. You’ll need both logic and general knowledge to solve your daily Word Salad, making it the perfect puzzle to keep your brain sharp and focused. 
"The game of the moment" - The Sunday Times
A completely new game 
The most advanced word search ever. Word Salad is an innovative word game that uses unique mechanics to bring you a brand new challenge daily. Are you up to it?
By humans for humans
Word Salad puzzles are all written by a person, no Gen AI involved. Each puzzle has been written, edited and furiously argued over by our small team of writers - who sign their names to every daily puzzle. 
Test your brain
Uncover the words hidden in the grid, and test your knowledge of topics - from US states to Greek gods, car manufacturers to famous TV couples. Much like a real salad, Word Salad is great for your brain. 
Themed puzzles
Fruits, gemstones, European cities, presidents, queens, pizza toppings, currencies, mammals… New themed puzzles will test your wits every day. 
Extra-challenging puzzles
Once you’ve mastered the daily puzzles check out our packs of ‘extreme’ puzzles, which will test you in wholly unpredictable ways. Think you’ve figured us out? Just wait and see what the extreme packs have in store for you. 
An innovative hint system 
Stuck on a puzzle? Word Salad’s clever clues will nod you in the right direction without ruining the fun of the game.
Thousands of puzzles 
Hungry for more salad? Word Salad contains thousands of additional puzzles to fill downtime. 
Compete with friends
Word wizards will enjoy the race against the clock - compete with your friends over who can solve each puzzle fastest.
Great for content
Share your word salad daily on social media and join the many creators who have had 1 million view+ videos on social platforms.

A unique blend of match-3, sorting mechanics, and relaxing gameplay
Smooth animations with soft, tactile textures
Perfect for quick breaks or longer unwinding sessions

Combines the charm of crafting with smart puzzle design
Relaxing, cozy gameplay for fans of brain teasers and creative puzzles
Hundreds of handcrafted levels offering endless fun
Family-friendly: simple for beginners, engaging for puzzle lovers
Whether you want to unwind, sharpen your mind, or simply enjoy the cozy satisfaction of untangling puzzles, Threadventure is the perfect escape.
 Download now and begin your thread-filled adventure!

bluejetty:00144830:ios.description:
Application Description:
ChefGenie is an online ordering app for unmanned retail devices. This includes receiving meal orders, booking meal orders, coupons, gift cards, order progress inquiries, and meal pickup notifications.
Function Introduction:
1. Online ordering: The user card can select a nearby location, select the corresponding product or package to place an order, and after payment, the order will be sent to the unmanned frying device at the location for frying.
2. Appointment for meal ordering: Users can choose their own suitable time to pick up meals, and can pick up meals at a certain time period in the next 12 hours.
3. Coupons: ChefGenie often sends coupons and gift cards for unmanned retail locations. After receiving, the order amount can be deducted.
4. Order progress query: On the app, you can check the progress of product preparation on the point device at any time and arrange the time for meal pickup based on the progress.
5. Dining notification: Obtain notification of the order's start and completion of cooking through the app's message.

bluejetty:00013466:android.description:
Welcome to Just Survive: Survival Island, a hardcore survival RPG where your only goal is to endure. Stranded deep in a hostile wilderness, you must explore, hunt, and craft to stay alive. This is the ultimate simulator for players who want a true solo challenge with deep progression.
🌴 SURVIVE THE WILDERNESS
The island is beautiful but deadly. You must manage your hunger, thirst, and health. Scavenge for food in the dense forest, find fresh water, and avoid eating poisonous plants. The weather is unpredictable—prepare for storms that will test your shelter's durability.
🐺 NATURAL PREDATORS
The island is teeming with wildlife. From small animals to massive bears and wolves, you are part of the food chain. Craft spears, bows, and traps to hunt for meat and leather. But be careful—at night, the forest comes alive with dangerous predators that hunt you down.
🔨 BUILD YOUR FORTRESS
Gather wood, stone, and metal to build your home. From a simple thatch hut to a multi-story stone fortress, the building system gives you total freedom. Construct crafting stations, storage chests, and defenses to protect your loot from the wild.
🛶 EXPLORATION & SECRETS
The ocean is vast. Explore the coastline and discover hidden caves, ruins, and secrets left behind by previous survivors. Master your surroundings to find rare resources and high-tier loot.
📜 RPG PROGRESSION & QUESTS
Level up your survivor to unlock new blueprints and skills. Complete daily quests and story missions to earn rare rewards. Your progress is saved to the cloud, so you never lose your progress.
⭐ KEY FEATURES
• Solo Survival: A true PvE experience focused on you vs. the environment.
• Advanced Crafting: Create hundreds of items, weapons, and tools.
• Base Building: Fortify your shelter against the elements and wild beasts.
• Open World: Explore a massive island, dark caves, and the deep ocean.
• Hunting System: Track wild animals and defend against deadly predators.
• Live Events: Regular updates with new challenges and rewards.
Download Just Survive: Survival Island now and begin your adventure!

The island is beautiful but deadly. You must manage your hunger, thirst, and health. Scavenge for food in the dense forest, find fresh water, and avoid eating poisonous plants. The weather is unpredictable—prepare for storms that will test your shelter's durability.

🐺 NATURAL PREDATORS
The island is teeming with wildlife. From small animals to massive bears and wolves, you are part of the food chain. Craft spears, bows, and traps to hunt for meat and leather. But be careful—at night, the forest comes alive with dangerous predators that hunt you down.

🔨 BUILD YOUR FORTRESS
Gather wood, stone, and metal to build your home. From a simple thatch hut to a multi-story stone fortress, the building system gives you total freedom. Construct crafting stations, storage chests, and defenses to protect your loot from the wild.

🛶 EXPLORATION & SECRETS
The ocean is vast. Explore the coastline and discover hidden caves, ruins, and secrets left behind by previous survivors. Master your surroundings to find rare resources and high-tier loot.

📜 RPG PROGRESSION & QUESTS
Level up your survivor to unlock new blueprints and skills. Complete daily quests and story missions to earn rare rewards. Your progress is saved to the cloud, so you never lose your progress.

⭐ KEY FEATURES
• Solo Survival: A true PvE experience focused on you vs. the environment.
• Advanced Crafting: Create hundreds of items, weapons, and tools.
• Base Building: Fortify your shelter against the elements and wild beasts.
• Open World: Explore a massive island, dark caves, and the deep ocean.
• Hunting System: Track wild animals and defend against deadly predators.
• Live Events: Regular updates with new challenges and rewards.

Download Just Survive: Survival Island now and begin your adventure!

Doctors, nurses, and healthcare professionals: a click away! 
Consult+ for Canada Life members is a virtual healthcare clinic that gives you access to healthcare professionals for non-urgent medical issues and health concerns. - Minor or known headaches
- Allergies, colds, flu and nasal congestion
- Painless eye issues (eye stye, pink eye,…)
- Infection of the upper respiratory tract (sinusitis, rhinitis,…)
- Mild or known gastric issues
- Mild infection of the digestive system
- Asymptomatic sexual health
- Genito-urinary infection in women
- Breastfeeding support and related infections
- Dermatologic infections and eruptions (rash, hives, eczema,…)
- Minor cuts or bites
- Thyroid issues
- Medical prescriptions or renewals
As an Apple HealthKit or CareKit user, you may optionally integrate your step tracking data to enhance your experience related to wellness goals and challenges.
Consult+ is provided by Dialogue.
