bluejetty:00136850:ios.description:
For the Girls is a fun card game game meant for girls. Because, WHY should boys have all the FUN?
Whether it’s a girl’s sleep over, pajama party, or even a bachelorette. For the Girls is a card game that’ll turn your boring night out into a wild party. 
Do you end up spending huge on purchasing physical card games and end up playing the same old cards again? Don’t worry, install “For the girls” now and get access to a collection of more than 700+ handpicked situations, dares, truths, etc. Not only that, also, regularly update the app to get newly picked content.
Like mentioned above, this card game can be played anywhere, be it on a girl’s road trip, a party at a club, house party, girls night out, or even at a bachelorette! Whether you’re a college girl or a group of married women who want to make kitty parties wilder.
Features:
‣ 700+ Cards.
‣ 10 Categories for All moods.
‣ Scoreboard (for competitive women!)
‣ Favorite Cards
Rules
Spin the roulette, depending on the card color the roulette lands, you get the card. If it lands on green, you get a situation that’s on the green card.
1. Green card: The card is to be given to a player who it describes best.
2. Blue Card: This card is to be given to a player who would totally do that thing. For instance, “Who is most likely to cut her own bangs?” and if you guys decide on a friend who can do it, give that card to her.
3. Pink Card: This card is to be given if the person performs the dare or situation.
4. Purple Card: It’s for Never Have I Ever, if a person whose turn comes has done what’s mentioned in the card, they can keep this card. For instance: “Have you ever flirted with your ex?”, if you’ve done, you get to keep the card.
5. Orange card: Name something in the category the card has, and the person at the left should also name and pass it to other people on the left, the one who fails to say something within 10 seconds, gets this negative card.
What are you waiting for? Install the app now and convert a boring party into a wild one!
Privacy Policy :https://sites.google.com/view/boltq-media-app/privacy-policy
Terms of Use : https://sites.google.com/view/boltq-media-app/terms-conditions

bluejetty:00061766:ios.description:
An invoice creation, sending, and tracking tool. Tiny Invoice helps you stay on top of your business.
“Now it takes me under a minute to create and send an invoice, before I would still be looking for a pen.”
Serving various industries for years, Tiny Invoice is ready for yours.
PROFESSIONAL INVOICE
- 5 customizable professional invoice templates;
- Add your company logo and place it anywhere;
- A wide range of invoice colors to match your brand theme;
- Supports adding detailed business information, including address, contact details, etc.
EASY INVOICES & ESTIMATES
- Anyone can create and send an invoice in under one minute;
- Add clients from your contact list with email, phone number, shipping address, etc;
- You can customize by adding or removing modules to make the invoice fit your business needs;
- Create estimates for a project and convert them to an invoice with one tap.
ADD ITEMS & AUTO CALCULATE TOTALS
- Add items manually or by scanning, and it automatically calculates the total based on quantity and unit price;
- Supports adding taxes, discounts, shipping, and other fee details, and automatically calculates the final total with one tap;
- Supports adding payments and tracking payment status.
SMART BUSINESS ACCOUNTING
- Record sales reports by day, month, quarter, or year;
- Supports recording purchase orders, credit memos, and expenses;
- View sales by individual item, profit and loss, and expenses by category.
KEEP EVERYTHING ORGANIZED
- Track delivery and open status after sending.
- Get reminders before the invoice due date and see payment status at a glance.
- Enable online payment directly through the invoice for faster collection.
- Auto sync invoices and estimates across all your devices with one account.
- Share Invoices: Export as PDF or print directly. Share via email, link, iMessage, or fax.
WHY TINY INVOICE?
RAPID
With lots of templates, creating invoices and estimates is far rapid than before.
CUSTOMIZABLE
On every invoice and estimate you created, all details are customizable. You can even add a signature and company logo onto it.
ORGANIZED
All created invoices and estimates are well organized and ready for you to check and mark paid.
TRUSTWORTHY
Tiny Invoice is used by millions of small businesses and organizations for over 13 years.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
• Weekly and annual subscriptions are available.
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
• Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is disabled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
• Automatic renewals will be charged at the same price you were originally charged for the subscription.
• Subscriptions can be managed by going to Account Settings on the App Store after purchase.

Survival Fishing Game of a "Casting away"
island with beautiful scenery.
◎ The Story of Casting Away
You are a successful movie star, on a private jet flying to a vacation destination. Suddenly, the jet was struck by lightning.
You crash-landed onto an uninhabited island that isn't even on the map.
You wake up on a beach alone.
You find a bizarre altar, strange gems from dead fish, and feel a strange aura spread across the whole island…
Is this really an ordinary deserted island?
Start fishing to survive on a lonely, desolate island.
◎ Features
-Customize your own island!
Construct buildings by collecting materials from the sea, and you'll be able to do various things by yourself.
-You can catch lots of types of fish from the sea!
Beautiful, mysterious fish to be caught. If you get lucky, you can find some floating chests!
-More than just fish!
You can cook and eat food made from various ingredients you get from your animals.
-You can go out to the sea on a boat!
You'll find even more variety of fish.
-Enjoy the beautiful sunsets and moonlight over the sea.
Offers a beautiful scenery where the sun rises and moon sets based on real-time.
-The sound of waves to relax to
For those who are tired, the natural ASMR of waves will take you to the peaceful sea.
-Raise various fish in your own fish tank!
You can open treasure chests by collecting Hearts from the fish.
-The longer the fishing line, the deeper you can fish!
You'll be able to catch bigger fish in the deep sea. However, you can only reach it if you can avoid small fry.

bluejetty:00079712:ios.description:
Streamline your tax refund tracking with IRS2go: Where's My Tax Refund?, a user-friendly app designed to simplify and expedite the process of checking your IRS tax refund status. Leveraging information directly from the official IRS website, this app aims to demystify the tax refund process and provide you with easy access to essential details about your refund.
IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER: This app gathers and simplifies information available on irs.gov but is not an official IRS entity. We do not own or are responsible for the shared information, and no personal user data is collected by the app.
Understanding Your IRS Refund:
Refunds are generally issued within 21 days for electronically filed returns and within 42 days for paper returns. However, delays can occur due to several reasons such as further review needs, incomplete details, identity theft or fraud, claims for credits, or Form 8379 processing.
How to Check Your Refund Status:
Within 24 hours after e-filing a 2021 return.
3 to 4 days after e-filing a 2019 or 2020 return.
4 weeks after mailing a paper return.
Methods to Check:
Electronically: Utilize the "Where’s My Refund" tool for immediate access to your refund status, requiring your Social Security Number, filing status, and exact refund amount.
By Phone: Contact an IRS Taxpayer Assistance Center if it’s been over 21 days (e-file) or 42 days (mail) or if the online tool directs you for more information.
Lost, Stolen, or Destroyed Refunds:
File a claim online if your refund check hasn't arrived 28 days after the IRS mailing date, using the "Where’s My Refund" tool for guidance.
Tax Transcripts:
For access to tax return information up to 3 years old, the app guides you through requesting a tax transcript from the IRS in three main ways.
Download IRS2go: Where's My Tax Refund? now for a hassle-free way to stay updated on your tax refund status and navigate the complexities of tax information access.

Leveraging information directly from the official IRS website, this app aims to demystify the tax refund process and provide you with easy access to essential details about your refund.

IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER: This app gathers and simplifies information available on irs.gov but is not an official IRS entity. We do not own or are responsible for the shared information, and no personal user data is collected by the app.

Understanding Your IRS Refund:
Refunds are generally issued within 21 days for electronically filed returns and within 42 days for paper returns. However, delays can occur due to several reasons such as further review needs, incomplete details, identity theft or fraud, claims for credits, or Form 8379 processing.

How to Check Your Refund Status:
Within 24 hours after e-filing a 2021 return.
3 to 4 days after e-filing a 2019 or 2020 return.
4 weeks after mailing a paper return.

Methods to Check:
Electronically: Utilize the "Where’s My Refund" tool for immediate access to your refund status, requiring your Social Security Number, filing status, and exact refund amount.
By Phone: Contact an IRS Taxpayer Assistance Center if it’s been over 21 days (e-file) or 42 days (mail) or if the online tool directs you for more information.

Lost, Stolen, or Destroyed Refunds:
File a claim online if your refund check hasn't arrived 28 days after the IRS mailing date, using the "Where’s My Refund" tool for guidance.

Tax Transcripts:
For access to tax return information up to 3 years old, the app guides you through requesting a tax transcript from the IRS in three main ways.

Download IRS2go: Where's My Tax Refund? now for a hassle-free way to stay updated on your tax refund status and navigate the complexities of tax information access.

bluejetty:00082515:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00082515:ios.description:
Welcome to Ayla World: Avatar Life — a world filled with style, exploration, and open-ended freedom!
Dive into the interactive world of Ayla World: Avatar Life, where you can join Ayla in a lively avatar-life experience. Unlock various locations, towns, and cities, customize characters with different styles and appearances, and interact with countless items, furniture, and characters. Step into this dynamic world and craft your own unique story!
Open Town Life
Immerse yourself in a vast and mysterious world full of interactive locations and everyday scenes. Experience the joys of city life! Cook and relax in your own apartment, shop at glamorous clothing stores, enjoy dorm-style living spaces, or have a picnic in the park. In Ayla World: Avatar Life, you can explore freely, create your own scenes, and shape every story your way.
Customize Avatars
We offer a wide range of customization options where you can create any character you desire. Choose from hundreds of faces, outfits, hairstyles, accessories, makeover items, and jewelry to create your own unique avatar. They can be charming, stylish, elegant, bold, or quirky — it's all up to you. Dress them up your way!
And of course, the avatars you create can experience all activities in Ayla World: Avatar Life too. They can interact with items and visit every location, just like everyone else in town.
Explore Everything
Create your own interactive stories. Unlock a dessert shop near the park, take the subway to a cozy countryside house, tend to a garden, prepare fresh ingredients, or design a relaxing day in the city. A wide range of story possibilities awaits your direction.
You can interact with items, uncover hidden details, and discover surprises throughout the world. What is hiding near that small mound of dirt? Enter the game and find out!
Anything you can hold can be taken home. Go shopping, tend to your garden, bake a celebration cake, or buy fresh ingredients at the supermarket.
And what else is special? That is for you to discover when you enter Ayla World: Avatar Life yourself!
Ayla World: Avatar Life is a casual avatar simulation game for players who enjoy character customization, fashion styling, interactive locations, room decoration, and open-ended story creation.
Download Ayla World: Avatar Life now, design your favorite characters, explore a rich virtual world, and create unique stories where the adventure never ends!

bluejetty:00121389:ios.description:
The golf course is calling! Tee-off and become the ultimate golf champion in Golf Rival!
Golf Rival is a free-to-play real time PVP golf game where real golf skills need infinite creativity. Show off your golf genius like never before! Collect powerful golf clubs and balls and play across 600+ courses in more than 21+ themes! Satisfy your golf dreams of hitting incredible shots, dueling your rivals, climbing the leaderboards and becoming a true golf master. Let's go for the perfect swing, a hole-in-one and prove you're a golf pro!
We’re adding a new layer of depth in Golf Rival! With focus on golf clubs players already love, and a new fun world to prove them in! With Course Conditions in play, every hole feels unique. Wind zones and gravity shifts force you to read the course fresh, every single time. And Club Mods help in countering whatever the golf course throws at you. Players dust off clubs they already own, slot in new mod upgrades, and tune their golf clubs to personalized strategies.
This exciting free golf game has many modes to play and master. From 1v1 golf shootout duels, to golf championship Tournaments against a global community of golfers, to playing golf with rivals and friends. In Golf Rival, scoring a birdie is only the start of the competitive fun! Outwit rivals with powerful golf balls and clubs, because no two online golf matches are ever the same.
Grab your clubs, and enjoy the golfing fun, whether you're a golfing newbie or an ultimate sports game expert!
PLAY EXCITING GOLF GAMES
-Unlock incredible golf challenges and conquer them by winning real time golf clashes and shootouts
-Master your golf swing with precision and creativity and watch your skills grow
-Compete in both 9-hole and 18-hole golf championship Tournaments every exciting season
-Multiplayer golf mode and daily challenges await - play golf now every single day!
-Beautiful 3D golf courses across different themes and difficulties always deliver an ultimate golf challenge
GROW YOUR GOLF SKILLS
-Golf Rival is unlike any free golf game you've tried - a true golfing simulator with creative and fantastical clubs and balls
-Win real golf duels to unlock amazing rewards for your golf bag and take your golf pro skills to the next level
-With every real time golf clash, you'll sharpen your genius swing and pull off incredible golf shots!
INFINITE GOLF FUN
-Every Golf Rival season is fun and fresh, with new courses, golf balls and rewards all the time!
-Skill games like Kingdom, Ace Open and Brink events put a unique spin on classic golf - putting, chipping and more
-Add your friends and see who has the golf genius to become the #1 golfer!
-Connect with players from the Golf Rival community on Facebook and join the conversation
Join golf fans around the world and download Golf Rival now to start your journey to becoming an ultimate golf champion!
Golf Rival is available in 13 languages. Join the Golf Rival community on Facebook!
Golf Rival is FREE to download and includes optional in-game purchases (including random items). If you wish to disable in-game purchases, please turn off the in-app purchases in your phone or tablet’s Settings.

bluejetty:00147378:ios.description:
Going Merry is a free app that helps you get money to pay for college. We match you to scholarships, grants, and financial aid–all for free. Each year, we help students get about $500 million in free money.
Going Merry is already used by 2 million students and trusted by over 20,000 registered high school counselors.
What makes Going Merry different?
1. Personalized scholarship matching
Get applying faster. Less browsing and sifting through scholarships that aren’t applicable to you.
2. Easy, auto-filled scholarship applications
Apply directly to many of the listed scholarships, right from the Going Merry website or app. We’ll even pre-fill the application form with the information in your profile. 
3. Bundled scholarships
We’ve combined scholarships with similar essay prompts, so you can apply to multiple scholarships with one form.
4. Your personas data is secure
We fully encrypt your data, and we never sell it to third parties. 
5. Grants and financial aid too
Get matched to state grants you’re eligible for. And apply for financial aid using our FAFSA® Made Easier, a simplified version of the government form. Finally, compare your college financial aid offers using our analysis tool, to make the right financial choice. 
But don’t take our word for it.
Students from 1 in 2 high schools in America already use Going Merry to help them win scholarship award money. Join them today!

Say goodbye to post-it notes and lost passwords. Keep your passwords and personal information safe and secure with ID Lock®.

bluejetty:00016993:ios.description:
Welcome to Prize Claw, from the makers of the smash-hit free casual game Coin Dozer!
For years, you've been going to the arcade, carnival, or theme park, trading cash for the chance to grab toys and candy with a motorized claw. Claw games are filled with tense moments of maneuvering the crane into place, wondering if you’re lucky enough to get that toy, coupled with the triumph of your prize dropping through the slot! Prize Claw recreates that happy experience for women and men of all ages – no trip to the casino to play the slots needed – on your iPhone while adding many exciting new features! 
Step up to the machine and maneuver the claw to grab coins, gems, a stuffed animal, cars, dolls, and much more! This game is much more than the standard grabbing you get from arcade crane machines, however: Prize Claw is filled with all sorts of unique items, powerful effects and challenging missions. Special gems grant an effect to enhance your collection power, and you can trade the prizes you collect for extra special bonuses. Prizes aren't the only thing you can trade in: the coins you collect can be spent to upgrade your claw, activate new powers, and even customize your machine! If you run out of grabs, don't fret! It won't take long before you receive more. Keep checking back to complete your collection, increase your skill with the grabber, reach a higher level, and unlock more stuff! 
Features:
• More than 60 prizes to collect – toy cars, a stuffed mouse, and much more!
• Multiple machines to play on with different prizes, powers and looks!
• A special puzzle to complete for each machine!
• New 3D graphics with customizable machines, claws, and joysticks!
• Simple to play, but with tons of challenging missions to earn a bonus prize!
• Earn extra bonuses for playing every day!
• Huge variety of bonuses and effects!
Stay tuned for future updates!
Also try out the other Game Circus titles like COIN DOZER and PAPLINKO!
Prize Claw is a free game that is supported by the ads we and others display. To do this, we work with a variety of online advertising partners who collect data from users of our games and other games to show you ads that are relevant to your interests. Do not install or launch our games unless you consent to this use and sharing of data, as further explained in our Privacy Policy (http://gamecircus.com/privacy-policy/).

bluejetty:00021206:ios.name: Geo Measure Area Calculator
bluejetty:00021206:ios.summary: Geo Measure is the best free tool for field measurement when you want to purchase some property, and want to calculate the area of that property. Geo Measure will help you like your best friends and will give you exact calculated area. App
bluejetty:00021206:ios.description:
Geo Measure is the best free tool for field measurement when you want to purchase some property, and want to calculate the area of that property. Geo Measure will help you like your best friends and will give you exact calculated area. App is useful to calculate GPS area or GPS distance with great accuracy. There two ways to measure any GPS area or distance.
1)Manual measurement
Click on PLUS button on right-bottom, select Distance/Area. Choose the appropriate option and you will get options (i) Manual measurement (ii) GPS measurement. Choose first option (i) Manual measurement, put markers on MAP.
With Manual measurement you can put multiple markers on MAP by just one click or once touch. There are always possibility that you have added wrong marker on MAP and either you want to delete that marker or wants to adjust that marker position. To delete marker, just click once on that existing marker and that wrong maker will be removed. And if you want to just adjust that marker position here we provides great feature that is Drag and Drop particular marker. Simple hold any particular marker for a second and drag maker to position where you want to put. And you will be able to adjust that marker position without deleting existing marker or adding new marker.
2) GPS measurement
Open app Geo Measure Area calculator FREE click on PLUS button on right-bottom, you will find tow option there i.e. Distance and Area. Choose appropriate option and you will get tow new options to choose i.e. (i) Manual measurement (ii) GPS measurement. Choose first option (ii) GPS measurement. and app will give you option to record your current GPS position. You can find that option Start recording on TOP of MAP. Once you will click on Start recording application will start recording your current position. Now you simply needs to move around at your location of which you want to calculate area or distance. You can click on Stop recording once you complete your measurement. . Hence application is recording your location based on your GPS position and you don’t need to specify location manually, that’s why we called this feature as GPS measurement
Geo Measure Area calculator FREE useful for whom ?
This application is useful for variety of users and yes even we are not sure about number users, as anyone can optimize use of this app on their own way. As per our knowledge we have made list of user’s for whom this app can be very useful.
Map Measure, Outdoor measurement, Roofing, Real estate, Run, Walk, building buildings and roads,Jog tracking, Sports, Road repairing, Range finder, Concrete, Underground, Paving, Construction, Agricultural measure, Solar panel installation, Roof area estimation, golf fields, spraying, fertilizing, seeding, harvesting, tilling, biking, traveling, planing trips, gardens and paddock, grass, lawn,fence measuring and planning, farmers.
Features
- Add Delete, Drag and Drop marker to place marker at perfect place.
- Instant measurement / instant calculation.
- Save again any calculate area so don't need to do same job again.
- Load / Delete already measured / calculated area.
- Select diff type of MAP view.
- Share with friends.
- Share your suggestion to improve or add new feature.
- Calculate Distance and Area both.
- Now you can save calculated distances and area list.
- Updated new UI easy to use.
- Facility to export KML file and share.
Payment & Subscription:
- You can choose our plans and get unlimited access to all the features of the App. 
Unlock All Features for a month USD 1.99
Unlock All Features for a year USD 19.99
You can cancel your subscription anytime. To cancel your subscription, follow these steps
on your iPhone/iPad Go to Settings > click on Your Name > Subscriptions > In Active section > Geomeasure > Cancel Subscription > Confirm Cancellation

bluejetty:00026027:ios.description:
Bring a Trailer Auctions are the best way to discover, discuss, and buy classic, collector, and enthusiast vehicles.
We curate vehicles submitted by our users and craft transparent auction listings that present the vehicles as they are—without superlatives or dubious used-car-lot language. BaT’s knowledgeable community of more than 900,000 users and over 400,000 registered bidders help vet each listing so potential buyers can bid with confidence.
The BaT app now makes it easy to browse and bid on vehicles anywhere, anytime–with streamlined vehicle submission functionality coming soon for sellers.
DISCOVER AND BROWSE
Find out what’s trending, see what’s ending soon, and watch the latest bids roll in on the Discover page. Know what you’re looking for? Search and filter in the Auctions tab to narrow down hundreds of listings.
VARIETY OF VEHICLES
BaT’s curation mirrors our eclectic taste: off-roaders are mixed with track cars, domestic makes with foreign brands, motorcycles with vintage RVs, parts with projects. We even auction re-creations, kit cars, boats, and automobilia!
COMMENT THREADS
We’re known for our knowledgeable and active community of enthusiasts. Easily tag other users in the app to keep the conversation going.
TRANSPARENT BIDDING
Place bids quickly and easily, with no surprise fees. The BaT buyer fee is 5% of the final bid price on top of the winning bid, with a minimum of $250 and a maximum of $7,500. Any additional dealer fees required by the seller will be clearly stated in the listing when applicable.
SNIPING PROTECTION
Each time a bid is placed at the end of an auction, the clock is extended by two minutes–giving everyone a fair chance to place their maximum bid.
CUSTOM ALERTS AND NOTIFICATIONS
Push notifications and the Activity Feed keep you up to date on your favorite topics, so you can stay on top of the action in real time. We can let you know when a seller adds more photos to a listing, when your favorite models go live, and when you’ve been outbid, among other things. Update settings for these events, as well as emails and sounds for bids and comments, in the More tab.
NEW ENDING SOON EXPERIENCE
Now you can keep an eye on multiple auctions simultaneously as they count down in the final minutes. In the new Ending Soon section, watch the comments and bids roll in for all auctions ending in the next 24 hours.
EXPLORE RESULTS WITH INTERACTIVE CHARTS
See the big picture or focus on what matters to you. Easily find results by adjusting the bid amount, timeframe, or vehicle year, or by making a selection right on a results chart.
WATCHLIST
The watchlist is home base for all of your favorite auctions, makes, models, categories, eras, and origins–just hit the bell or star to save items. We’ll even let you know when you’ve been outbid on a watched auction so you can quickly place another bid! 
SELLER TOOLS
Quickly upload photos, reply to bidders, adjust your reserve, and see stats for your live listings. Submissions and more seller features are coming to the app soon!

bluejetty:00058135:android.description:
Net Blocker - Net Guard is a smart app that lets users disable internet access for apps. Call Activity- Net Blocker is armed with a Caller ID feature which will identify the true callers name before you receive unknown phone calls using this internet blocker or net usage identifying app. This lets users save and reduce data usage, stop an app from downloading background data and improve privacy. It lets you block access to WiFi or mobile data with one tap. No root required!👍
Features
Block🛑 Internet Access
The Net Blocker - Net Guard app uses a local VPN to disable the internet for selected apps. You can either block access to WiFi or Mobile Data or both at the same time using this internet blocker.
Get Daily Data Usage
Net Blocker - Block Internet also shows the data consumed by any app in a day. This will help users manage their internet activity using this net blocker.
Highly Secure🔒
This Net Blocker - Block Internet app does not send any data to remote VPN servers and adds to the privacy & security of users.
Net Blocker - Block Internet Permits you to intercept apps from accessing the internet without the root condition.
Please read the points below carefully - 
There are plenty of games that may,
• Access the internet only to portray ads or steal your data
• Access the internet in the background services of unblocked apps.
Benefits of using Net Blocker- Block Internet
★ Reduce your data usage
★ Increase your privacy
★ Get True Caller Info
★ Better Efficiency 
Features of Net Blocker- Block Internet
★ Easy to use
★ No root required
★ No dangerous permissions
PLEASE Note that-
• Net Blocker - Block Internet app only sets up a local VPN interface to be able to block the network traffic of apps without root. And it does not request dangerous permissions such as Location, Contacts, SMS, Storage.
• Even when apps and games are blocked from accessing the internet, they can still display ads loaded from cache memory. So, please clear their cache to hide their ads using Net Blocker - Block Internet.
Please feel free to reach us via email if you have any suggestions or concerns. You can write us an email at support@q4umobileapps.com. Thank you.

[シャドテンの３つの特徴]
1. プロの添削
シャドテンでは、英語学習のプロフェッショナルがあなたのシャドーイング音声を添削し、具体的なフィードバックを提供します。これにより、自分の弱点を的確に把握し、あなたの英語リスニング力を効率的に改善できます。
2. 豊富な教材
シャドテンには、1,000以上の教材があります。著名人のスピーチなどのネイティブ音源は、ビジネスの現場で実際にビジネス英語をリスニングできるようになるための教材です。さらに、TOEIC®や英検®など、資格試験の対策向けの教材も豊富で、あなたの目的やレベルに必ず合う幅広いジャンルの教材が揃っています。
3. 手厚い学習サポート
登録時に実施する「カウンセリング」に基づいて、あなたのレベルや目的に合った教材を提案します。教材選びに迷うことなく、効果的に学習を進められます。
さらに、LINEサポートの体制も充実しており、学習における不明点があれば、人が直接対応するので、効率的に英語リスニング学習を進めることができます。
[こんな方におすすめ]
1. ネイティブ英語がリスニングできるようになりたい方
シャドテンは、ネイティブスピーカーの音源で練習ができます。教材英語だけで実践で使える英語はなかなか身につきませんが、シャドテンなら本番で通用する英語リスニング力が身につきます。
2. 多忙なビジネスパーソン
シャドテンはスマホ一つでいつでもどこでもシャドーイング学習ができる、リスニング力向上に特化した英語学習アプリです。
また英語学習のプロが365日サポートしてくれるので、短時間でも効率的にリスニング力が伸びます。
さらに、ビジネス英語の教材も豊富で、現場で実際に使用できるビジネス英語を聞き取ることができるようになります。
3. リスニング力に課題がある方
シャドーイングは通訳者が認めた、リスニング力強化に最適な学習法です。
ただ、シャドーイングは独学では難易度が高く、正しいシャドーイングを継続して行うことは困難です。
シャドテンはスマホ一つで正しい方法で効果的なシャドーイングをいつでも実践できる英語学習アプリなので、リスニング力向上に効果的です。

シャドテンはTOEIC®やTOEFL®、英検など資格試験対策用教材も充実しています。TOEIC®や英検®のリスニング試験対策にも、シャドーイングが最適です。シャドテンでシャドーイングをして、リスニング力を強化し、TOEIC®、英検®のリスニング試験に臨みましょう。

ビジネス英語のプロフェッショナルがあなたのシャドーイングを毎日フィードバックし、英語リスニング力向上をサポートします。シャドテンを通じて、効率的かつ効果的に英語を学びましょう。

[シャドテンの３つの特徴]

1. プロの添削
シャドテンでは、英語学習のプロフェッショナルがあなたのシャドーイング音声を添削し、具体的なフィードバックを提供します。これにより、自分の弱点を的確に把握し、あなたの英語リスニング力を効率的に改善できます。

2. 豊富な教材
シャドテンには、1,000以上の教材があります。著名人のスピーチなどのネイティブ音源は、ビジネスの現場で実際にビジネス英語をリスニングできるようになるための教材です。さらに、TOEIC®や英検®など、資格試験の対策向けの教材も豊富で、あなたの目的やレベルに必ず合う幅広いジャンルの教材が揃っています。

3. 手厚い学習サポート
登録時に実施する「カウンセリング」に基づいて、あなたのレベルや目的に合った教材を提案します。教材選びに迷うことなく、効果的に学習を進められます。
さらに、LINEサポートの体制も充実しており、学習における不明点があれば、人が直接対応するので、効率的に英語リスニング学習を進めることができます。

[こんな方におすすめ]

1. ネイティブ英語がリスニングできるようになりたい方
シャドテンは、ネイティブスピーカーの音源で練習ができます。教材英語だけで実践で使える英語はなかなか身につきませんが、シャドテンなら本番で通用する英語リスニング力が身につきます。

2. 多忙なビジネスパーソン
シャドテンはスマホ一つでいつでもどこでもシャドーイング学習ができる、リスニング力向上に特化した英語学習アプリです。
また英語学習のプロが365日サポートしてくれるので、短時間でも効率的にリスニング力が伸びます。
さらに、ビジネス英語の教材も豊富で、現場で実際に使用できるビジネス英語を聞き取ることができるようになります。

3. リスニング力に課題がある方
シャドーイングは通訳者が認めた、リスニング力強化に最適な学習法です。
ただ、シャドーイングは独学では難易度が高く、正しいシャドーイングを継続して行うことは困難です。
シャドテンはスマホ一つで正しい方法で効果的なシャドーイングをいつでも実践できる英語学習アプリなので、リスニング力向上に効果的です。

4. 英語学習が継続できない方
シャドテンでは、365日毎日プロがあなたのシャドーイングを添削します。あなたの習慣化を支援する機能がたくさんあり、学習サポートも豊富なため、継続が苦手な方でも、学習を続けられるので、リスニング力が着実に向上します。

5. TOEIC®やTOEFL®、英検®を受講予定の方
シャドテンはTOEIC®やTOEFL®、英検など資格試験対策用教材も充実しています。TOEIC®や英検®のリスニング試験対策にも、シャドーイングが最適です。シャドテンでシャドーイングをして、リスニング力を強化し、TOEIC®、英検®のリスニング試験に臨みましょう。

[サービスの詳細]
シャドテンは、プログリットが運営するシャドーイング特化型の添削サービスです。教材は1000以上あります。初級者から上級者まで様々なレベルの方々へ、またビジネス英語を学びたい方へは、ビジネス英語教材を、TOEIC®の点数をアップしたい方へは、TOEIC®用の教材をご用意しており、あなたの目的に応じたコンテンツが揃っています。

シャドテンは有料サービスです。
7日間まで無料でご利用いただけますが、7日以降本契約をする場合は、月額料金が発生します。

bluejetty:00120621:ios.description:
Train to be the best Supermarket Cashier in this job simulator game! Recommended for ages 8+, requires basic math skills. 
▼FEATURES
-Be fast with your calculator skills and money handling skills. 
-Enter the prices or scan the barcodes of the groceries into the cash register. 
-Count the number of grocery items.
-Add customer payment and give right amount of change.
-Break bills and coins.
-Tap, swipe, or insert credit card.
-Manage time as customers shopping will get impatient if you take too long.
-Earn reward coins and unlock new items and backgrounds.
Use this game for your first job training or just exercise your brain to get fast at math and with time management. Calculate the change and make that grocery money. See if you can finish all the levels of Supermarket Cashier. Both kids and adults will find this cash register game fun and challenging. This is a cozy and relaxing game and cash register simulator.
You can play in Timed Mode where you challenge your brain and time management to complete the levels. Or you can play in Untimed Mode so you can play in a leisurely manner with rhythm and flow. Choose from USD ($), Euro(€), British Pounds(£), or Canadian Dollars (C$) to challenge your brain even more. This is the most realistic cash register game on the market.

bluejetty:00015699:ios.description:
Simple Notes is an easy-to-use notes app that leaves out the extras, so writing, organizing, and finding notes stay simple.
Notes go into color-coded folders, and you can find them using the calendar or photo album. No account or setup is required, and the app works offline.
Core features are free. Keep everything in one place, from class notes and work memos to a diary or baby journal.
[Features]
■ Add Photos to Notes
- Attach images to any note
- Insert pictures from your photo library, or take a photo on the spot
■ Folder Organization
- Create folders to keep your notes organized
- Choose from 24 folder colors to tell categories apart at a glance
■ Calendar View
- View notes by date using the built-in calendar
- Tap any date to see notes for that date — perfect for locating past entries
■ Photo Album
- Browse all images added to notes in one place
- Tap a photo to jump to its note
■ Home Screen & Lock Screen Widgets
- Keep a note on your Home Screen like a sticky note — no need to open the app
- Lock Screen widgets let you see a note without unlocking your iPhone
- Choose which note to display and its text size
*Widgets are part of the Premium Service*
■ Sort Notes & Bullet Lists
- Sort by note date, date edited, date created, or title, ascending or descending
- Bullet lists make it easy to write shopping and packing lists
■ Passcode Lock
- Protect your notes with a passcode
- Supports Face ID and Touch ID for quick and secure access
■ Font Styles
- Choose from 12 font styles

bluejetty:00144613:ios.summary:

FEA
bluejetty:00144613:ios.description:
Help when you need it – SeizAlarm detects irregular movements. 
SeizAlarm is a user-friendly iPhone and Apple Watch app that allows those with irregular movements and other disorders to alert emergency contacts when they need help*. 
FEATURES:
- Detect abnormal or irregular movements via the motion sensors on the iPhone and/or motion sensors or heart rate sensor on the Apple Watch. Sensitivity controls allow you to set customized settings specific to you. When irregular movement is detected, emergency contacts will automatically be contacted via multiple channels (phone call, text message, and email). 
- Send immediate help requests manually to emergency contacts. 
- Also available is a manually activated time delayed help request feature (via the "Time Delayed Help" button) that can be helpful. You are able to custom set the delay time in the settings. When an irregular movement warning is initiated you will see a countdown which can be extended via the press of a button. If you end up becoming unresponsive during irregular movement then once the timer ends then a help request will be sent.
- When a help request is sent, your contacts will be contacted with GPS coordinates (if available), so they know exactly where you are. 
- You are also able to track your irregular movements with robust logging features. A log dashboard gives you a high-level view of past events. You can also export log reports. 
- SeizAlarm also supports multiple emergency contact support, so more than one person can be contacted when you need help. 
- Optional audible siren and/or custom voice message that plays if a help request is sent.
- International phone number support for emergency contact(s).
- Now supporting "Family Setup" watches! 
Help is just a button press away. Start taking back your independence today. Carpe diem–seize the day!
For questions or feedback, contact us at contact@seizalarm.com. Your input is vital in improving future versions' detection accuracy and reducing false alarms.
NOTES:
*New accounts receive a 2-week commitment free trial of the help request service which allows the user to manually or automatically (via irregular movement) request help from emergency contacts. Once the trial ends, the user must subscribe to the help request service to continue to have the ability to request help. The help request service is an auto-renewing cost of $17.99/month or $179.99/year. 
* SeizAlarm is NOT an FDA approved medical device. SeizAlarm does not prevent seizures, should not be used for diagnosis, treatment, mitigation or cure of any disease and is not a substitute for medical care.
* Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
* Recommended placement of the iPhone for irregular movement detection is on the arm using an armband.
* Longer sessions of Watch based irregular movement detection and heart rate detection may dramatically decrease watch battery life.
* Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
* The payment will be charged to the user's iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. 
* Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. 
* No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication. The robust irregular movement log features require no subscription.
Terms of Service: https://seizalarm.com/terms/
Privacy policy: http://www.seizalarm.com/seizalarm_app-privacy-policy.pdf

bluejetty:00121937:ios.summary:
Turn any two devices into a wireless remote camera system — no internet, no router, no account needed. Just connect and shoot.
Remote Shutter uses peer-to-peer technology to link two devices directly. One becomes the camera, the other beco
bluejetty:00121937:ios.description:
Turn any two devices into a wireless remote camera system — no internet, no router, no account needed. Just connect and shoot.
Remote Shutter uses peer-to-peer technology to link two devices directly. One becomes the camera, the other becomes your remote control with a live monitor. Perfect for group photos, selfies, tripod shots, creative angles, and hands-free photography.
NEW — MULTICAM: UP TO FOUR CAMERAS, ONE DIRECTOR
- Connect up to four iPhones as cameras and see every angle live in a grid
- One synced shutter fires photos or video on every camera at the same instant
- Footage collects automatically to the director, time-aligned for editing
- Set frame rate, resolution, aspect ratio, HDR and focus for every camera from the director
- Interviews, music, sports, dance, unboxings — shoot every angle at once
FULL MAC SUPPORT
- Use your Mac as the camera: built-in, USB and pro webcams, even your iPhone via Continuity Camera
- Switch between every camera connected to your Mac, live from your iPhone
- Or flip it: use your Mac's big screen as a director's monitor for your iPhone camera
FEATURES
- Control your camera from your Apple Watch — trigger the shutter from your wrist
- Selfies and group shots on the sharp rear camera — frame yourself from the remote's live preview
- Wireless remote shutter from up to 50 feet away
- Live camera preview on your remote device
- Switch cameras remotely — front/back on iPhone, any connected camera on Mac
- Camera flash control
- Adjustable photo timer
- Record video remotely — choose 24/30/60 fps, 1080p or 4K, aspect ratio and HDR from the remote
- Tap to focus on the remote's live preview (Pro)
- Works with iPhone, iPad, and Mac
- No internet or Wi-Fi network required — direct device-to-device connection (just keep Wi-Fi and Bluetooth turned on)
HOW TO USE
1. Open Remote Shutter on two devices
2. Devices connect automatically via peer-to-peer
3. Choose which device is the camera and which is the remote
4. Start shooting from anywhere in the room!
Whether you're directing four iPhones on a music video, shooting products with a pro camera on your Mac, directing from the big screen, or setting up a family photo, Remote Shutter gives you full wireless control of your camera from another device.

bluejetty:00128510:ios.name: Poplin: Laundry Service
bluejetty:00128510:ios.summary: Poplin is your personal laundry service platform — wash-dry-fold available in over 500 cities nationwide. Poplin Laundry Pros tame even your most unruly, rumpled piles into pristine stacks of perfectly folded laundry. All that’s left for yo
bluejetty:00128510:ios.description:
Poplin is your personal laundry service platform — wash-dry-fold available in over 500 cities nationwide. Poplin Laundry Pros tame even your most unruly, rumpled piles into pristine stacks of perfectly folded laundry. All that’s left for you to do is get dressed.
JUST TAP AND YOU’RE DONE
With Poplin, laundry is handled with a single tap. Arrange pickup, leave instructions, track your order, message your Laundry Pro, and relax. You’re free. We take it from here.
THE POPLIN PRICE
Next-day laundry service is $1/LB in most cities (slightly more in some). Same-day service is available for a premium. Pricing is simple and includes wash, dry, fold, with free pickup and delivery. No memberships. No contracts.
HOW IT WORKS
Order. Download the app and place your order.
Prepare. Set your laundry out for pickup (machine-dry in one bag, hang-dry in another).
Finished. We return everything the next day—fresh, folded, beautifully done.
PEACE OF MIND
With Poplin you can relax because you’re a patron of one of the nation's top hospitality brands. 
Support daily from 8–8.
150,000+ Laundry Pros across the nation.
Serving 500+ markets.
40,000+ five-star reviews.
$1000 Garment Protection Plan.
Backed by leading investors.
WHO DOES MY LAUNDRY?
Your laundry is handled by Laundry Pros—experienced, background-checked locals who treat your clothes with care and attention.
MINIMUM ORDER
The minimum charge is $30. Put out as little or as much laundry as you want—if the total comes to less than $30, the charge is $30.
LAUNDRY IS OUR LOVE LANGUAGE
Our Laundry Pros are care-obsessed craftspeople—gentle with delicates, precise with folding, never rushed. Hand over your laundry and we won’t just wash your clothes—we’ll pamper them.
WHAT’S INCLUDED
Poplin’s wash-dry-fold laundry service finishes your laundry to perfection.
Professional wash
Flawless dry
Expert fold
Plus free pickup and delivery, hang-dry options, and our Protection Plan.
DO YOU SEPARATE LIGHTS AND DARKS?
Yes. You tap. We handle the rest.
DETERGENT OPTIONS
Choose from:
Premium scented
Hypoallergenic (unscented/sensitive skin)
Provide your own, and your Laundry Pro will return what’s unused.
DO I NEED SPECIAL BAGS?
Use any bags you like when you put out your laundry—even your hamper. Most customers use disposable bags. We transfer items as needed. Your clean laundry always returns in Poplin’s clear protective bags.
THE POPLIN PLEDGE
A portion of every order helps provide laundry services for families in need.
Poplin cares for laundry; together we care for people.

bluejetty:00018529:ios.description:
3Rivers Mobile Banking
The 3Rivers Mobile Banking App is an easy-to-use banking solution that puts the credit union and our services in the palm of your hand 24/7—allowing you to manage your money anytime, anywhere. 
The ability to use the same username and password tied to your 3Rivers Online Account Access allows for a streamlined banking experience, no matter when or where you choose to log-in!
With our mobile banking app, you can:
• Deposit check(s)*.
• See account balances in real-time.
• Transfer money and make payments on loans and credit cards.
• Pay your bills using Bill Pay.
• Make quick and easy person-to-person payments.
• Utilize budgeting tools to keep better track of your spending.
• Set card control options, like spending limits and turning cards on and off, to protect against fraud.
• Search for nearby branches and ATMs.
In order to use our mobile banking app, you need to be enrolled in 3Rivers Online Account Access. If you don’t already have an online account, signing up is easy and takes just a few moments! Visit 3riversfcu.org/enroll on your computer, mobile device, or tablet to get started.
To learn more, visit www.3riversfcu.org/mobile or email trfcuservice@trfcu.org 
*Remote deposits are only compatible with devices that have auto-focus cameras. They are not compatible with fixed-focus cameras. 
Note: Electronic mail (email) is not secure. Any confidential or sensitive personal/business information should not be communicated in this manner. 
3Rivers is federally insured by the NCUA.

bluejetty:00030651:ios.description:
Introducing the Firefighter Radio App - your one-stop solution for staying connected to real-time firefighting activities in your community. This app opens a new window into the world of our brave first responders, letting you listen in on the radio communications of firefighters from various local departments. 
Key Features:
**Real-Time Firefighter Radio**: This app allows you to listen in on live radio transmissions from firefighters. Be privy to the up-to-the-minute details of their operations as they fight against the destructive force of fire. Stay informed and engaged with the heroic efforts happening in your community. 
**User-Friendly Interface**: We believe that user experience is paramount. Hence, we've ensured that our app is easy to navigate and use, even for the most non-tech-savvy users. Its intuitive layout and simple controls make it a breeze to tune in and stay updated.
**Local Fire Department Activities**: This feature provides unique insights into the operations of your local fire department. Gain a newfound appreciation for their unyielding dedication and commitment to ensuring our safety.
**Live Updates**: The app keeps you informed about all the recent firefighting activities in your area. Our streaming service is incredibly reliable, making sure you never miss out on any critical updates.
Our Firefighter Radio App serves to bridge the gap between the general public and our firefighting heroes. By giving you a rare insight into the real-time communications of firefighting operations, we hope to foster a greater sense of community and admiration for these brave individuals. Moreover, by staying informed about these emergency situations, you can ensure the safety of your loved ones and help create a safer community.
Please note that this app does not provide emergency alert services and is intended to be used for informational purposes only. Always call your local emergency services in the event of a fire or any other emergency. 
We are always striving to enhance your experience. If you have any suggestions, queries, or would like to provide feedback, please feel free to reach out to us.
Join us in our journey to provide transparency and promote the invaluable work done by our firefighters. Download the Firefighter Radio App today!

Evidence-based medical AI for clinicians. Get fast, cited clinical answers you can trust at the point of care. Free for healthcare professionals, works in every language, and is HIPAA compliant. Trusted by 250,000+ healthcare professionals across the globe.
CLINICAL ANSWERS IN SECONDS
Vera Health gives you clear, practical clinical answers right when you need them, so you can move from question to decision in seconds.
• Ask clinical questions about diagnosis, management, or follow-up and get concise, structured answers.
• Get support for differential diagnosis, workup, and treatment options for real-world patient scenarios.
• See key points highlighted so you can scan quickly on rounds or between visits.
ALWAYS GROUNDED IN EVIDENCE
Every answer is built on trusted medical literature and guidelines, so you can stay confident in your decisions.
• Answers backed by 60M+ peer-reviewed papers and clinical guidelines.
• Inline citations and references so you can quickly verify primary sources.
• Evidence summaries designed to be easy to review on mobile, tablet, or desktop.
BUILT FOR REAL-WORLD CARE
Vera Health is designed for busy clinicians at the point of care, with tools that fit directly into your workflow.
• Check meds and dosing fast, with interaction checks, contraindications, and safety alerts in one place.
• Access 900+ medical calculators for common scores, risk tools, and dosing calculations.
• Use Vera Health in every language, with region-aware results where available.
• HIPAA compliant and designed specifically for use in clinical settings.
STAY CURRENT WITHOUT EXTRA TABS
Keep up with the latest evidence and guidelines without spending hours searching.
• Get specialty-relevant guideline and research updates tailored to your clinical focus.
• See what has changed in the literature and how it may affect your practice.
• Stay informed between visits, on call, or during downtime, without juggling multiple apps and websites.
EARN CME AS YOU WORK
Turn your everyday clinical questions into ongoing professional education.
• Earn +0.5 CME credits with every search.
• Generate CME certificates instantly for completed activity.
• Track your CME progress automatically in one place.
WHY CLINICIANS CHOOSE VERA HEALTH
• Evidence-first answers you can verify in seconds.
• Built for speed and clarity at the point of care.
• Designed for real-world clinical workflows, from outpatient to hospital settings.
• HIPAA compliant and free for all healthcare professionals.
IMPORTANT NOTE

bluejetty:00095725:ios.description:
Master your peptide protocols with Peptide Calculator: PepCalc, the essential tool for accurate dosage and reconstitution. Stop the guesswork, avoid costly errors, and dose with confidence every time.
Tired of confusing math, online calculators with ads, or complex spreadsheets? PepCalc is a dedicated, professional-grade calculator designed for one purpose: to give you fast and accurate results for your peptide mixing and injection needs. Whether you are in a lab or managing your own wellness, this is the simple, reliable tool you've been waiting for.
KEY FEATURES:
• ACCURATE DOSAGE CALCULATOR: Instantly determine the precise injection volume. Simply input your desired dose (in mcg or mg), the total peptide amount in the vial, and the reconstitution volume. PepCalc does the math for you.

bluejetty:00130411:android.description:
Welcome to ARCHER, the gay dating app where every profile shows a face. Whether you're looking for a date, something casual, a friend, or all of the above, you’ll find guys ready to connect.
Aim high, shoot higher with ARCHER, the community for gay dating & social networking! By gay men, for gay men, ARCHER helps you discover just what you're looking for—from friends to finding your husband. Our app celebrates the diversity of the gay community, providing a welcoming space for everyone, including gay couples. ARCHER offers unique chat and discovery experiences, like profile tags for finding people with common interests. Chat and go on fun dates with cute guys in your area!
ARCHER is an inclusive gay dating app where you can enjoy chatting with other gay men and meeting everyone from bears to twinks, couples to singles, and everything in between. Discover a vibrant gay community on our gay app where gay chatting is not just a feature, but a celebration of connections, friendships, and maybe something more – join the conversation and make meaningful connections today! Whether it’s your last first date, a flirty new fave, or your next brunch bestie, he’s just a tap away.
Informed by a community of gay men, from employees to LGBTQ+ orgs, from our community advocates to speaking with thousands of gay and queer men, ARCHER sets a new gay dating standard.
Whether you're looking for new friends, a long-term relationship, or anything in between, ARCHER is the only gay dating app you'll ever need!
What sets ARCHER apart:
Looking For Modes to help you find a date, a friend, or something casual, when and how you want 
Real-time GPS-enabled maps that turn digital cruising into instant connection by showing who’s nearby, what they’re into, and letting you shoot your shot straight from the map.
Selfie-verified profiles so you know who you're talking to
Profile tags that help you find guys into what you’re into, from fitness to food, travel to position
Messaging to make your move, your way
Private albums for sharing a little more, when you’re ready
Communities so you can join conversations that go beyond dating, from gaming to movies
Add your status and see who’s ready to chat & connect right now
Search Without Secrecy
With engaging ways to discover, safe ways to verify, and new ways to come together, the ARCHER gay dating app is your place to search without secrecy. Anonymous torsos are out, your gorgeous self - IN! ARCHER helps you meet real people and go on the best gay dates.
New Ways to Connect
Share more photos of yourself and what you're into on your profile. Plus, join community group gay chats where you can talk about your favorite topics all in your gay app.
Next-Level Safety and Security
With a focus on creating a safe and inclusive environment for the queer community, ARCHER caters to men of all backgrounds and preferences and was created to serve the community's unique needs. Short-term or long-term relationships can both be found on ARCHER, and whether you're a gym rat or a fabulous queen, this gay dating app is for you!
At ARCHER, we take the safety and security of our users seriously. That's why we use the latest technology to protect your data and privacy. Our platform is encrypted, and we have a dedicated team of moderators who work around the clock to help keep our community safe and respectful.
We also require all users to take our ARCHER pledge to treat everyone respectfully and abide by our guidelines that do not tolerate harassment, hate speech, scamming or spamming of any kind.
Join ARCHER's vibrant gay social network today!
All photos are of models and used for illustrative purposes only.
Privacy: https://www.archerapp.com/privacy
Terms: https://www.archerapp.com/terms

bluejetty:00171427:ios.description:
Divine W: Perfect Wonderland is an fantasy open-world MMORPG with oriental style. The game owns a massive map which is over 60,000 inch². Begins a thrilling journey in this Sword and magic world. Everything you choose affects the world and decides the world's future.
Make a dent and create your own legend! 
=====Features=====
【Paint the fantastic world】
An oriental fantastic new world that you can truly immerse in. Unlock the exclusive warlord to increase your power, and explore kinds of fantastic myths and legends. Come into Divine W, and make your fantasy dream come true.
【Massive Open World 】
Feast your eyes on the world around you, with a beautiful art style and excellent visual experience.
Lighting and weather all change naturally over time. The seasons, the weather and the vast world. Bringing every detail of this fantastic world to life.
【Most enjoyable fighting】
Freely combine your skills, and choose a weapon as you want. Also, a correct strategy is vital in a fight. That's why a wise choice is essential. This intense fighting is waiting for you.
【Be yourself】
A lovely outfit system. Hundreds of fashion outfits and accessories. Dress how you want!
Not to mention the cutest pet, mounts, and wings. Thus, in divine W, Everybody is made unique!
【Not only fight】
Deity also needs rest. There is much funny gameplay besides the fight. Fishing, Hunting, cooking... And more little fun is here for you.
For more info and rewards, please follow our official Facebook page:
https://www.facebook.com/DivineW.LN

bluejetty:00126140:ios.description:
Protect your photos and videos by hiding them in a secret folder!
Secret Album offers great features like:
– Secure cloud backup
– Unlimited storage
– Private browser with ad blocker
– Break-in alerts
– Fake PIN
Hide photos and videos in a secret vault and keep them away from nosy folks when they are using your device.
Secret Album will keep your files in the encrypted, PIN-protected storage that only you can access. Now you can be sure that your personal data is safely hidden. Additionally, the app features a private browser with a built-in ad blocker, ensuring a seamless, secure, and distraction-free browsing experience without leaving any traces behind.
Take pictures with the in-app Secret Album camera or import images from Photos to your secret space. Use encrypted cloud storage to access your private album from different devices. Your friends and family will only see what is in the easily accessible Photos app, not in your private photo vault.
Secret Album is a secure media storage that offers:
* PIN,Touch and Face ID access to your secure files
* Decoy PIN to hide real photos and videos
* Break-in alerts and security reports with intruders' photos
* Private browser to surf securely
* Ad blocker for an uninterrupted browsing experience
* Custom color themes and album covers
* App lock after 3 incorrect PINs to prevent password cracking
* Media player with full-screen support
* Separate PIN to protect selected albums
* Built-in camera to take pictures within the app
* App content cover for the multitasking mode
* Recovery of removed photos and videos
* Slideshow support
* Full support of iOS 15 and later versions
Secure Cloud Storage:
The Premium version offers unlimited cloud storage, allowing your device to access your photos and videos any time using your email. To sync photos and videos between devices and easily restore your data in case your device gets broken or lost, you'll register your email in the app Settings.
Information about the auto-renewal of subscription:
– Free trial period is provided
– Payment will be charged by Apple at confirmation of purchase
– Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
– Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. The cost depends on the selected plan
– Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
– Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription
By using Secret Album, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:

bluejetty:00038730:ios.description:
silBe by Silvy Araujo is a fitness and wellness app created for women who want to transform their body and mind through workouts and healthy eating.
Welcome to silBe, your go-to app for transforming your body and mind!
Discover guided workouts, goal-based programs, healthy recipes, and a community that keeps you going when you feel like giving up.
Why choose silBe
- Train wherever and whenever you want, with guided videos led by Silvy Araujo.
- Follow training programs built for every level: beginner, intermediate, and advanced.
- Enjoy complete routines that combine strength, endurance, mobility, and cardio.
- Connect your workouts to your lifestyle and progress at your own pace.
New: BePREGNANT, your pregnancy program
Pregnancy is one of the most transformative stages of your life, and you deserve to go through it supported and truly connected to your body. BePREGNANT is our all-in-one prenatal program: safe pregnancy exercises adapted to every trimester, designed to really prepare you, not just modified routines.
- Strength training adapted to every stage of your pregnancy.
- Pelvic floor work and 360 breathing to reconnect with your body.
- Nutrition and gynecological education backed by specialists.
- Birth prep and postpartum recovery, all in one experience.
- What makes it truly special: BePREGNANT was filmed while Silvy Araujo was going through her own pregnancy. Every session was lived before it was taught. - Real support, woman to woman.
Nutrition and healthy recipes
- Balanced meal plans created by the silBe nutrition team.
- Healthy, delicious, easy-to-make recipes adapted to your goals.
- Learn to eat better, without restrictive diets.
- Get inspired with wellness tips and healthy habits.
Community and motivation
- Train alongside thousands of women on silBe.
- Share your wins and challenges with the #NoMeRindo team.
- Take on our Challenges, with real winners and prizes.
- Stay motivated with messages from Silvy Araujo and her team in the community chats.
Your first week is FREE
Try silBe with no commitment and enjoy all Premium benefits for 7 days.
With your silBe subscription
- Unlimited access to all programs and routines.
- Train with no interruptions.
- Frequent updates with new programs and recipes.
- Save your workouts and track your progress.
- Join challenges and earn exclusive rewards.
Everything in one app
- Home or gym workouts.
- Programs tailored to your level and goals.
- A complete prenatal program with BePREGNANT.
- Integrated nutrition and wellness plans.
- New content every month.
- A global community of women supporting each other.
silBe by Silvy Araujo: so much more than fitness
silBe isn't just a workout app, it's your space to take care of yourself, stay motivated, and grow.
Every routine, recipe, and message is designed to help you become your best self.
Download silBe, train with Silvy Araujo, and join the #NoMeRindo team.
Your transformation starts today!

bluejetty:00078461:ios.description:
Die Tagesspiegel App verbindet digitale News und das E-Paper zu einer App. Freuen Sie sich auf Live-Nachrichten, spannende Reportagen, Interviews und Hintergrundberichte. 
Dazu lesen Sie mit dem digitalen Tagesspiegel als E-Paper zwei Zeitungen in Einer: Aus der Welt sowie aus der Weltstadt Berlin und seinen Kiezen. 
Laden Sie jetzt die kostenlose App herunter und genießen folgende VORTEILE in einer intuitiven App für Ihr Smartphone oder Tablet:
Alle Nachrichten von Tagesspiegel.de
● Wir liefern Ihnen sämtliche News und Hintergründe zu allen aktuellen Themen aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Kultur, Wissenschaft, Gesellschaft, Sport u.v.m. - aus Berlin und seinen Kiezen, Deutschland und der Welt.
● Rund um die Uhr bleiben Sie informiert mit Tagesspiegel Plus: Sie erhalten Zugriff auf über 1.000 exklusive Artikel pro Monat. 
● Bleiben Sie auf dem neuesten Stand und erfahren Sie, was in Berlin los ist. Unsere Autor:innen berichten jeden Tag direkt aus den Berliner Kiezen für Sie.
● Für Tagesspiegel-Abonnent:innen ist die App stark werbereduziert.
Der Tagesspiegel als digitale Zeitung
● Lesen Sie die größte Zeitung Berlins als E-Paper - täglich.
● Bleiben Sie außerdem bestens informiert mit Tagesspiegel Plus und dem Tagesspiegel Checkpoint, Berlins beliebtestem Newsletter.
● Greifen Sie bereits am Vorabend ab 19:30 Uhr auf die Tagesspiegel-Ausgabe zu.
● Schalten Sie die digitale Zeitung auf bis zu fünf Geräten frei und lesen Sie das E-Paper in der ganzen Familie.
● Speichern Sie wichtige Artikel und Ausgaben auf Ihrer persönlichen Merkliste.
● Finden Sie zudem alle Beilagen und Sonderausgaben zu Themenschwerpunkten im digitalen Format.
APP FEATURES
● Individuelle Push-Benachrichtigungen: Entscheiden Sie selbst, welche Nachrichten für Sie relevant sind.
● Intuitive Handhabung: Wechseln Sie mit nur einem Klick zwischen digitaler Zeitung und dem Nachrichtenportal.
● Kommentar-Funktion: Teilen Sie uns Ihre Meinung mit und diskutieren Sie mit anderen Leser:innen.
● Merklisten-Funktion: Speichern Sie Ihre Lieblingsartikel und Ausgaben.
● Änderung der Schriftgröße: Passen Sie die Artikel-Schriftgröße des E-Papers an Ihre Lesegewohnheiten an.
● Flexible Ansichten: Wechseln Sie zwischen Einzel- und Doppelseitenansicht, indem Sie das Gerät auf Hoch- oder Querformat drehen.
● Sharing-Funktion: Teilen Sie Artikel über Facebook, X, E-Mail oder WhatsApp.
● Tagesspiegel-Archiv: Recherchieren Sie in allen Zeitungsausgaben der letzten zwei Jahre.
● Integrierter Podcasts: Hören Sie die aktuellen Ausgaben unserer beliebten Podcasts, z.B. "Gyncast", "Tatort Berlin" und “Berliner und Pfannkuchen”.
TAGESSPIEGEL ABONNEMENTS
● Tagesspiegel Plus: Testen Sie Tagesspiegel Plus einen Monat kostenlos. Danach lesen Sie für 14,99 EUR pro Monat weiter.
● Tagesspiegel Digitale Zeitung: Testen Sie das E-Paper inklusive Tagesspiegel Plus einen Monat kostenlos. Danach lesen Sie für 38,99 EUR pro Monat weiter.
● Falls Sie Ihr Abonnement (Tagesspiegel Plus sowie die digitale Zeitung) über den App Store abschließen (In-App-Abonnement), verlängert sich dieses automatisch um die von Ihnen gewählte Laufzeit.
● Sie können die automatische Verlängerung von bezahlten In-App-Abonnements bis 24 Stunden vor Ablauf ausschalten. Melden Sie sich hierfür mit Ihrer Apple-ID an und gehen Sie bitte wie folgt vor: Einstellungen > Apple-ID, iCloud, Medien & Käufe > Abonnements. Wählen Sie hier das entsprechende Abonnement aus und bestätigen Sie die Kündigung.
FEEDBACK
Haben Sie Vorschläge zur Verbesserung der Tagesspiegel App? Schreiben Sie uns: apps@tagesspiegel.de. Wir freuen uns auf Ihr Feedback.
TECHNIK
Die Tagesspiegel App läuft ab iOS 15.5.
DATENSCHUTZ
Informationen zu unserer Datenschutzrichtlinie finden Sie unter: https://www.tagesspiegel.de/datenschutzerklaerung
NUTZUNGSBEDINGUNGEN
Informationen zu unseren Allgemeinen Geschäftsbedingungen erhalten Sie unter: https://abo.tagesspiegel.de/agb

bluejetty:00056489:android.summary: Dive into the world of bubble-popping fun with Bubble Shooter Panda: Blast & Pop, the ultimate bubble shooter game for all ages! Join our lovable panda hero in an exciting adventure filled with vibrant bubbles, cute animal friends, and endl
bluejetty:00056489:android.description:
Dive into the world of bubble-popping fun with Bubble Shooter Panda: Blast & Pop, the ultimate bubble shooter game for all ages! Join our lovable panda hero in an exciting adventure filled with vibrant bubbles, cute animal friends, and endless fun. Whether you're looking for a relaxing puzzle experience or an engaging challenge, this game has something for everyone. 🐼🎯
🌟 Why You'll Love Bubble Shooter Panda: Blast & Pop
 Simple and Addictive Gameplay
 Match 3 or more bubbles of the same color to pop them. Aim, shoot, and clear levels with satisfying precision! Easy to learn but challenging to master, this game offers the perfect mix of relaxation and excitement.
 Hundreds of Levels to Explore
 Embark on an epic journey through hundreds of carefully designed levels. Each level brings unique challenges, creative obstacles, and new strategies to keep you entertained.
 Special Boosters and Power-Ups
 Unlock and use powerful boosters to overcome tricky levels. Whether it's a fireball that clears a whole section or a rainbow bubble that matches any color, there's always a way to strategize your way to victory.
 Save Cute Animal Friends
 Help the adorable panda rescue its animal friends trapped in bubbles! Watch their joyful reactions as you clear each level.
 Daily Rewards and Events
 Log in daily to claim exciting rewards, participate in fun events, and earn valuable prizes that will boost your gameplay.
 Offline Gameplay
 No internet? No problem! Enjoy the game anytime, anywhere, even when you're offline. It's the perfect companion for your travels or downtime.
🎮 Game Features
 Vibrant Graphics and Engaging Effects
 Experience colorful visuals and delightful animations that bring the bubble-popping action to life. From the lively backgrounds to the cheerful characters, every detail has been crafted to enhance your gaming experience.
 Multiple Game Modes
 Classic Mode: Relax and pop bubbles at your own pace.
 Rescue Mode: Free the trapped animals to clear the level.
 Challenge Mode: Test your skills with timed levels and limited moves.
 Easy Controls for Everyone
 Tap to aim and release to shoot. The intuitive controls make the game accessible to players of all ages, whether you're a beginner or a seasoned bubble shooter enthusiast.
 Exciting Challenges and Obstacles
 Navigate through tricky puzzles, moving bubbles, and challenging blockers. Adapt your strategy to conquer every unique challenge.
 Compete with Friends
 Connect to your social media accounts to compare scores and challenge your friends. Who can become the ultimate bubble-popping master?
 Completely Free-to-Play
 Download and play for free! Optional in-app purchases are available for those who want to enhance their experience further.
Perfect for Everyone
Whether you're a casual gamer looking for a relaxing pastime or a puzzle enthusiast eager for a challenge, Bubble Shooter Panda: Blast & Pop has something for you. The game's family-friendly design makes it ideal for kids, adults, and everyone in between.
How to Play
 Aim and Shoot: Drag your finger to aim the bubble launcher, then release to shoot.
 Match and Pop: Create groups of three or more bubbles of the same color to pop them.
 Clear the Level: Achieve your target by clearing bubbles, freeing animals, or reaching a specific score.
 Strategize and Win: Use boosters and plan your shots carefully to overcome obstacles and tough challenges.
Download Now!
Ready to embark on a fun-filled bubble-popping journey? Download Bubble Shooter Panda: Blast & Pop on Google Play today! Relax, strategize, and experience the joy of bubble shooting at its best. 🌈🐼
Join millions of players worldwide and see why Bubble Shooter Panda: Blast & Pop is one of the most popular bubble shooter games on Google Play. The adventure awaits—get started now!

bluejetty:00088917:ios.description:
¡Mejoramos BanescoMóvil! Ahora podrás hacer tu PagoMóvil de siempre con cambio en tu Cuenta Verde de forma fácil y rápida. Al realizar tu PagoMóvil podrás seleccionar entre tu Cuenta en Bs o tu Cuenta Verde, y al seleccionar tu Cuenta Verde, a través del mecanismo de Menudeo, el beneficiario recibirá el pago en Bs.
Con BanescoMóvil podrás:
- Interactuar con el asistente virtual DANI, quien durante las 24h podrá responder a tus dudas e inquietudes, además te ofrecerá información o sugerencias sobre productos y servicios.
- Según corresponda, podrás ingresar con tu usuario principal de BanescOnline o tu usuario máster de BanescOnline Empresa.
- Incluir Beneficiarios en tu Directorio al momento de realizar una transacción. (Para usuarios máster de BanescOnline Empresa solo aplica en Operaciones de moneda extranjera).
- Consultar el saldo de tus productos en moneda nacional o extranjera.
- Realizar Transferencias de forma inmediata a terceros en Banesco y en otros bancos.****
- Realizar pagos de servicios: CORPOELEC, CANTV, Movistar, Movilnet, Digitel, Simpletv e Inter.
- Enviar pagos desde la opción PagoMóvil, con cargo en tu Cuenta en Bs o en tu Cuenta Verde.**
- Acceder a la opción Mi Qr, para recibir pagos.
- Incluir Beneficiarios en el directorio de Pagos Frecuentes para Pago Móvil.***
- Consultar el recibo de tus operaciones tanto de Banca Móvil como de Pago Móvil (por día o por mes)
- Visualizar, compartir y descargar recibos al realizar una transacción.
- Visualizar y exportar los últimos movimientos y las transacciones mensuales.
- Realizar Operaciones Rápidas (Consulta de Saldo y Envío de pagos -Pago Móvil-).
** Pago Móvil es un servicio disponible solo para usuarios de BanescOnline.
*** El Beneficiario de la transacción de PagoMóvil, debe estar afiliado al servicio.
**** También podrás seleccionar el método de transferencia: a través del número de cuenta o de teléfono.
Agregamos a BanescoMóvil, nuestra nueva Suite de BanescoPagos (sólo para clientes jurídicos). Es la app que integra y centraliza diversos servicios de cobros y pagos electrónicos en pro de facilitar la operativa diaria de tu negocio. Con la Suite de BanescoPagos podrás:
- Cobrar de forma presencial y a distancia a través de canales digitales que facilitarán la operativa diaria de tu negocio (ejemplo: para casos de delivery)

bluejetty:00047079:ios.summary: PrabhuPay consumer App allows its users to simplify the payment process. With this App, the consumers can easily make payments for the goods purchased and services rendered. Quick recharge and easy payment of various utility bills makes thi
bluejetty:00047079:ios.description:
PrabhuPay consumer App allows its users to simplify the payment process. With this App, the consumers can easily make payments for the goods purchased and services rendered. Quick recharge and easy payment of various utility bills makes this App more users friendly and on top of that consumers can also transfer the small value fund to the consumers within PrabhuPay network.
Newly added unique features such as Near-by-deals and Near-by-taxi make this App unique and multipurpose. Near-by deals is a geo location based customized automated notifications send to the users advising of nearby deals based on their current or last known locational proximity to the businesses. Similarly, near-by-taxi is a geo locational based feature through which the users can track the available taxis nearby them. They can easily book the taxi and even make payments by using our application.
What we offer?
• Fast, easy and a convenient way to make payment in the stores for the goods purchased or any services rendered.
• Send money instantly to the existing PrabhuPay users using their QR Code and Phone numbers.
• Skip line and make quick payments of electricity, cable TV, internet bills and phone bills such as postpaid and prepaid bills (NTC, Ncell, UTL, SmartCell).
• Notifications on personalized offers through Nearby Deals.
• Convenient way to track/ book Taxis nearby.
• Easy access to the records of your transactions.
• Get the locations of various ATM withdrawal centers to withdraw your PrabhuPay wallet fund.
• Top-up your PrabhuPay wallet easily through PrabhuPay registered Merchants.
• Link your bank account to make payment from your debit card.

bluejetty:00088174:ios.description:
Play mystery puzzles, riddles and brain teasers in this Domini Games adventure quest! Your goal is to find hidden objects needed to become a hero!
The famous detective of the magical world is back in business – together with the elvish friend Ymir! This time a vampire envoy comes to you, asking for help. A terrible tragedy has struck the vampire community. The creator of the artificial blood serum has disappeared. Now vampires can't peacefully exist in the world, not revealing their true nature without the serum. You and your assistant must find the famous alchemist to help the vampires prevent the irreversible consequences. Conduct your own investigation: look for objects and solve intriguing puzzles. Find the one responsible for wreaking havoc and save the world! Gather your wits for an unforgettable detective story in this pulse-pounded new Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure!
· FIND A MYSTERIOUS PERSON WHO'S TRYING TO GET RID OF ALL THE VAMPIRES IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Play more detective puzzles and riddles after you finish the main story! More collectibles are waiting for you in this unique chapter, where you can find items, clues and hidden pictures and unlock all new branches of the interactive story! Choose your story to play in!
· COLLECT ITEMS THAT WOULD HELP YOU LEARN MORE ABOUT THE WORLD OF VAMPIRES!
This hidden object quest is full of magic things. They can change their shape and have much information about vampires! Never stop during the adventure, finish the case and learn all secrets that are hidden from the first view.
 · ENJOY BONUS MATERIALS THAT INCLUDE CONCEPT ART, WALLPAPERS, MUSIC, AND MORE!
Play this puzzle quest and download great pictures, music for memory about the game!
· FIND OBJECTS, PLAY CHALLENGING PUZZLES AND MINI-GAMES, AND EARN ACHIEVEMENTS!
Visit as many places as you can! Find hidden objects there, as a real item finder, solve mysteries and meet many creatures!
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.

bluejetty:00022598:ios.summary: An all-in-one plumbing reference built for professionals who need fast, reliable code data on the job. Code Snap combines UPC & IPC tables, fitting take-offs, and water line sizing into a single streamlined app designed for real-world use i
bluejetty:00022598:ios.description:
An all-in-one plumbing reference built for professionals who need fast, reliable code data on the job. Code Snap combines UPC & IPC tables, fitting take-offs, and water line sizing into a single streamlined app designed for real-world use in the field.
Quickly access the plumbing data you rely on without digging through books or PDFs. Whether you’re sizing pipe, laying out a system, or verifying clearances, Code Snap provides practical, jobsite-ready reference you can trust.
Subscriptions
Code Snap offers multiple subscription options, including individual feature access or a single subscription that unlocks all tools.
Available options include:
• UPC & IPC – Core plumbing tables, data, and code references
• Main Line – UPC & IPC water line sizing calculator
• Fitting Take Off – DWV & H2O fitting take-off dimensions
• Unlock All – Access to all Code Snap features
A subscription is required to unlock full access to app content.
Features
• Quick access to core plumbing tables
• Toggle instantly between UPC & IPC
• Water main and branch sizing calculations
• DWV and H2O fitting take-offs
• Interactive instant results
• Color-coded per national standards
• Editable take-off values
• One-handed, field-optimized interface
• Share code and take off values
What’s Included
• Waste, water, and hot water tank sizing
• Grease interceptor sizing
• Meter, main, vent, and trap arm sizing
• Pipe bracing requirements
• Fuel gas BTU loads and pipe sizing
• Medical gas sizing, codes, and pressures (UPC only)
• Roof drain sizing (UPC only)
• ADA restroom diagrams and requirements
• Interactive wet venting diagrams (vertical and horizontal)
Fitting Libraries
• No-Hub Cast Iron
• ABS & PVC Plastic
• Pro-Press Copper
• DWV Sweat fittings
• H2O Sweat fittings
• 90s, 45s, tees, flanges, wyes, combination fittings, fixture crosses, and more
Important Note
Code Snap is an independent reference tool created for plumbers and plumbing professionals, based on publicly available data and established code principles. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by IAPMO, ICC, or any regulatory authority. Always verify requirements with the Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) for your project.
Terms of Use:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
