DOWNLOAD NOW AND START HAVING FUN! 100% FREE!
Check out the reviews - you're going to love Bubble Jewels 2!
••••• "I find this game interesting and challenging, since it is fun for me to figure out angles to "bank" my shooter bubble off the sides to get into tight places to pop more bubbles! I've about mastered that! Very enjoyable game!" --AntsAway
••••• "My go-to game. This is my choice for those times I just need a few minutes of down time. Enough of a challenge to keep me coming back, but tons of fun. Thanks!" --phillipsdo
EASY TO LEARN AND PLAY!
• Just touch the screen to launch a bubble exactly where you want it to go!
• Match 3 or more bubbles of the same color and they drop!
• Your goal is to clear all the bubbles from the board… You can do it!
NEW SPECIAL BUBBLES!
• The Rainbow Bubble matches every color!
• Rock Bubbles get in your way, so you'll have to knock down all the bubbles around them…
• Use the new Bomb Bubble to knock down every bubble that it touches!
• When the rare Magic Bubble lands, it magically removes every bubble on the board that have the same color as the bubbles it touches!
FIVE GAME MODES TO SUIT YOUR MOOD!
• Want classic Bubble Jewels color-matching fun, that's even better? Try Classic Mode!
• Do you love making it to high levels, but get frustrated when you have to start over? Try Endless Mode!
• Want a super-hard challenge that's not for the faint of heart? Try Challenge Mode and match 4 bubbles instead of 3! And then 5… And then 6...
• Feeling antsy - try Dizzy mode where the bubble launcher dances around the screen! Time your shots carefully...
• Or try Blitz Mode! You've got 60 seconds - how high can you score? Bet you can't just play it once!
RELAX WHILE YOU SHARPEN YOUR MIND!
• No timers (except in Blitz Mode), so take your time and relax
• Beautiful graphics and animation
• Relaxing sound effects
• Listen to your iPod music while playing
GOOD TIMES
• Simple and elegant gameplay
• Endless variety, never the same game twice
• Compare your scores with the world using Game Center (iOS4/5 devices)
• Magic auto-save - go ahead and quit the game, take a phone call, send a text - when you come back, your game will be waiting for you!
Get Bubble Jewels 2 now, and start the fun!

bluejetty:00142078:ios.description:
The world's finest architectural masterpieces in your pocket. A one-stop GPS-enabled guide to the worlds greatest architectural achievements from the 20th and 21st century.
Travel to any place in the world and this guide will tell you, where the most interesting buildings around you are located. It will tell the story behind the building and the architect, displays two pictures for every project and gives you walking or driving directions. 
No data connection is needed, because all information and pictures (except maps) are stored offline on your phone. So no expensive roaming cost when abroad!
You can even use it without GPS and in Flight Mode, because it allows you to browse cities and buildings manually. 
All projects have a full description, photos and additional details such as the name of the architect, the year it was built and the associated website. It also presents you with walking and driving directions. 
This carefull selection of the major wonders of 20th and 21st century architecture spans traditions throughout the world, from Le Corbusier to the latest Pritzker Prize winners. From the renowned, famous icons to the hidden architectural gems.
An indispensable tool for travellers and city dwellers, to discover great buildings worldwide.

bluejetty:00128736:ios.description:
SongPop Party by Gameloft — Step up and prove your music knowledge with this fast-paced, competitive music-based trivia game. SongPop Party is the latest addition in the biggest music trivia franchise in the world with a huge catalog from cult classics to today's top hits, and hundreds of thousands of unlockable songs curated by genre, artists, decade, topics and more. Bringing music fans together around the globe, players can pit their knowledge against opponents online in the Arena mode based on their skill level and music preferences. Or jump into the new local and online multiplayer party mode where players can link up and compete with their friends and family to determine who is the best. Can you guess the song?
Highlights
Party: Challenge up to 8 friends and family online or locally in a music trivia frenzy. Only one champion will prevail!
Arena: Test your music knowledge against other players. Who will be the winner?
Solo: Play against the game to discover new playlists and train to be the best.
For all generations: Looking for a blast from the past or today’s greatest hits? SongPop Party has it all, from the 1960s to yesterday, everyone can play!
Fun avatars to suit your music personality: Pop aficionado, EDM fan, or metalhead? Find your favorite avatar to tag along in all your challenges.
Not a sing along… Or is it?: You know it’s gonna to happen, you won’t be able to help yourself!
Dive into the world of Music Trivia with SongPop Party and become the ultimate music master!

bluejetty:00074005:ios.name: STS Cardiothoracic Surgery
bluejetty:00074005:ios.summary: STS Cardiothoracic Surgery Consult is the most complete and authoritative digital resource of cardiothoracic surgical information in the world. It provides a rich, multimedia educational experience that includes regularly updated content in
bluejetty:00074005:ios.description:
STS Cardiothoracic Surgery Consult is the most complete and authoritative digital resource of cardiothoracic surgical information in the world. It provides a rich, multimedia educational experience that includes regularly updated content in cardiac surgery (adult cardiac and congenital) and general thoracic surgery.
This comprehensive resource includes more than 500 high-quality, hand-drawn medical illustrations, plus over 2000 photographs, tables and surgical videos. It is accessible anytime, anywhere on your mobile devices.
STS Cardiothoracic Surgery Consult includes the following sections:
• Pearson’s General Thoracic Surgery
◦ Esophageal
◦ Thoracic
• Adult and Pediatric Cardiac Surgery
◦ Adult Cardiac
◦ Pediatric and Congenital (coming soon!)
FEATURES:
• The most current, continuously updated resource available in the specialty, authored and edited by the leading surgeons from around the world
• Rich, multimedia content with high-quality medical illustrations and surgical videos
• Online and mobile platforms offering home, office, or point-of-care reference 24/7/365
• Comprehensive collection of 330+ interactive chapters in all main cardiothoracic surgery domains
• Updated and expanded of the popular Pearson’s Thoracic textbook for general thoracic surgery
• Newly written content for adult cardiac and congenital
• Cornerstone of the CT surgery curriculum in training programs throughout the US (the curriculum includes additional educational activities, nationally benchmarked quizzes and self-assessment, progress reports)
• Much-needed resource outside of the US where no like product currently exists
Senior Editors: Jeffrey P. Jacobs, MD, University of Florida; Shari L. Meyerson, MD, MEd, University of Kentucky; Nanush A. Mokadam, MD, Ohio State University
PUBLISHER: The Society of Thoracic Surgeons
POWERED BY: Unbound Medicine, Inc.
How It Works:
---------------------
• Install the app on your device.
• Open the app, enter your Society of Thoracic Surgeons username and password, then tap “Login.”
• The latest content will be downloaded to your devices over your wireless connection.

bluejetty:00064960:ios.description:
WeXpense is a simple and powerful split expenses app that helps you track shared costs, split bills fairly, and settle balances without confusion. Whether you're traveling, going on a road trip, organizing a party, planning a picnic, or managing any group event, WeXpense keeps every shared expense organized in one place.
With WeXpense, you can record every expense, see how much each person has paid, and instantly know who owes money and who should receive it. No spreadsheets, manual calculations, or awkward conversations about money.
Why Choose WeXpense?
- Clean and user-friendly interface
- Fast and simple expense entry
- Automatic bill splitting
- Automatic balance updates
- Multi-currency support
- Works offline and syncs online
- Secure cloud backup
- Perfect for travelers, friends, families, roommates, and teams
Whether you need a group budget app for your next trip, WeXpense helps you stay organized while everyone contributes fairly. Stop worrying about who paid for what. Let us handle the calculations so you can focus on making memories with your group.
Download WeXpense today and enjoy the easiest way to split bills, track shared expenses, and settle balances with confidence.
How to Use WeXpense:
- Create a new group for your trip, vacation, party, event, office outing, or any shared activity.
- Share the group link or invite your friends, family, or teammates so everyone can join and contribute.
- Enter the expense amount, choose who paid, add a category or note if needed, and save it.
- Split the bill equally, by percentage, by shares, or enter custom amounts based on your group's needs.
- See a complete record of every payment, including who paid, when they paid, and how much they contributed.
- Instantly see who owes money, who should receive money, and the exact settlement amount.
- Pay the required amount and mark the transaction as settled to keep everyone's balance up to date.
- Review all expenses, payment history, and spending summaries anytime from your group dashboard.
WeXpense is ideal for:
- Student tours & group events
- Travel & vacations
- Camping & road trips
- Parties & celebrations
- Family trips
- Picnics & reunions
- Business travel
Whatever the occasion, WeXpense makes managing shared expenses simple, fair, and stress-free.
Key Features
- Split Expenses with Ease: Record shared expenses in seconds and let WeXpense automatically calculate everyone's share. Whether it's accommodation, transportation, food, or activities, every expense is split fairly and accurately.
- Powerful Travel Expense Tracker: Keep all your travel expenses organized in one place. Monitor your spending, stay within budget, and enjoy your trip without worrying about unexpected costs.
- Works Offline & Syncs Online: No internet connection? No problem. Add and manage expenses offline, then automatically sync your data across devices once you're back online.
- Accurate Balance Calculation: Instantly see who owes whom with automatic balance calculations. Settle expenses quickly without manual calculations or confusion.
- Complete Expense History: Access a detailed history of your expenses, payments, and settlements anytime. Keep every trip and group expense organized for future reference.
Unlock Pro Features:
- Access Control: Manage permissions with Admin, Editor, and Viewer roles.
- Private Groups: Share expenses securely with selected members only.
- Real-Time Notifications: Stay updated on every expense and payment.
- Custom Categories: Create categories that fit your needs.
- Invoice Upload: Attach bills and receipts to every expense.
- PDF Export: Download detailed expense reports in PDF format.
- Archive Groups: Keep completed groups without deleting data.
Terms of Use: https://www.expensecount.com/pages/termscondition

RPG and More
Embark on rich RPG adventures where you can develop your character, engage in intense quests, and interact with a dynamic community of players.

bluejetty:00177272:ios.description:
The Newcastle Transport On Demand app enables you to book a bus to and from anywhere within the “on demand” area. Newcastle Transport On Demand guarantees you a convenient and more personalised travel experience in and around your local community. With the app you will be able to select your pick up location, tell us where you want to go, and track your bus so you know when to head to the pick up location. Newcastle Transport On Demand is proudly operated by Keolis Downer and powered by Via. Is On Demand available in your area? Check the app to find out, or go to www.newcastletransport.info/on-demand.
A new way to travel
On Demand matches customers with others going in the same direction via a customised and flexible route. Sophisticated technology coordinates your trip, picking you up from near your home, or a convenient location nearby, and taking you to where you want to go within the “on demand” area.
Ride now or later
You can book rides on-demand or pre-schedule them up to three months in advance.
Minimal wait-times
On average, a bus will come in minutes, and you'll always get an estimate of your pickup ETA before booking. You can also track your bus in real-time in the app.
Try Newcastle Transport On Demand, a new way to travel.
Love our app? Please rate us! 
Questions? Email us at newway@newcastletransport.info.

A game of royal logic. One Queen per color. Zero shared lines. Absolute focus.
Looking for a pure logic puzzle that respects your intelligence—and your time? Welcome to Queens Master, a sleek, minimalist brain-teaser that combines the eleg
bluejetty:00157507:ios.description:
A game of royal logic. One Queen per color. Zero shared lines. Absolute focus.
Looking for a pure logic puzzle that respects your intelligence—and your time? Welcome to Queens Master, a sleek, minimalist brain-teaser that combines the elegant spatial deduction of Sudoku with the razor-sharp tactics of Chess.
The concept takes seconds to learn but hours to master. Your mission is simple: claim the grid. But a true monarch never shares power.
 Simple Rules. Absolute Strategy.
 • One Monarch Per Realm: The board is divided into distinct colored zones. You must place exactly one Queen in each colored zone.
 • The Royal Distance: Queens are fiercely independent. They cannot share a row, share a column, or touch each other—not even diagonally.
 • High-Stakes Deduction: Double-tap a tile to place your Queen. You have only three lives per match. Guessing will cost you; flawless logic will crown you.
Why Queens Master Earns Your Time
Zero Intrusive Ads
We believe a great puzzle requires uninterrupted focus. Queens Master features no mid-game forced ad breaks. Just pure, unadulterated logic.
Daily Trials & Global Ranks
Wake up to a brand-new, hand-crafted Daily Challenge every morning. Solve it flawlessly to maintain your streak and climb the global leaderboards against the sharpest minds in the world.
Minimalist Polish, Infinite Depth
Featuring an elegant, eye-straining-free dark mode, satisfying tactile haptics, and thousands of unique levels that scale from relaxing to mind-bending.
The Premium Puzzle Experience
Queens Master doesn’t hijack your attention with flashing lights, cheap gimmicks, or endless freemium grinds. It earns your time through flawless design and a deeply satisfying logic loop that stays with you long after you put your phone down.
Claim your throne. Download Queens Master today.

Bring your old memories back to life with Film Scanner, the all-in-one app to scan film negatives, slides, restore photos, animate memories, and even send physical postcards worldwide.
Turn 35mm film, old negatives, color slides, and printed photos into high-quality digital images directly from your phone. Whether you're preserving family memories, digitizing film archives, or restoring vintage photography, Film Scanner gives you professional tools in a simple workflow.
Scan Film Negatives & Slides
• Scan 35mm negatives and photo slides with your phone camera
• Support for color negatives, positive film, black & white film, and old slides
• Live negative inversion preview while scanning
• Automatic frame detection and auto-cropping for faster digitization
• Manual crop adjustment when needed
Restore & Enhance Old Photos
• AI photo restoration for damaged or faded images
• Colorize black & white photos
• Improve old family pictures and vintage film scans
• Remove imperfections and enhance image quality

• Apply film-inspired filters and creative effects
• Non-destructive editing so originals remain untouched
• Export high-quality images
Smart Capture Features
• Bluetooth remote shutter support
• Delayed shutter mode for shake-free scanning
• Optimized workflow for light boxes and film holders
• Easy scanning setup for home digitization
Bring Memories to Life
• Animate old photos using AI
• Transform still images into moving memories
• Share restorations instantly with family and friends
Print & Send Worldwide
• Turn restored memories into real physical postcards

• Vintage photo collectors

bluejetty:00030488:ios.description:
Period Tracker: Cycle Calendar helps you understand your cycle with simple period tracking, ovulation prediction, symptom logs, mood notes, BBT records and clear health trends.
Plan ahead with a clean calendar, record how you feel each day, and review your body’s patterns over time. Whether you are tracking your period, monitoring PMS, or learning more about your fertile window, everything stays organized in one private iOS app.
• Predict upcoming periods, fertile windows and ovulation days
• Log symptoms, moods, flow, cramps, weight, temperature and notes
• Review cycle history with diary-style daily records
• See charts for cycle length, temperature and weight trends
• Track recurring symptoms and mood patterns
• Choose soft themes and colors for a personal experience
• Protect private health notes with passcode lock
Period Tracker is easy and simple. 
Press a button at the start of your period every times. Period Tracker logs your dates and calculates the average of cycle standard or custom select menstrual cycles to predict the start date of your next period. 
Close prediction, remind menstrual period in time
The personal health steward for girls, records, forecasts, and reminders are all available, so you can avoid the embarrassment of forgetting your menstrual period, record your daily mood and health details, help you develop good living habits, and let you know your physical condition .Easy recording your period cycle, ovulation and fertile days, moods, dysmenorrhea, symptoms, weight, temp, habit, and notes in a main calendar view. 
View report for details
You can easily and intuitively view the diary and understand your physical condition.Show every detail you record.
Charts! Beautiful, comprehensive and handy. Charts show weight, temp, symptoms, period length, cycle length, and more.
Pregnancy mode can enable countdown function to calculate the baby’s due date.
Use TouchID or FaceID and password option to protect your privacy.
In the later stage, we will continue to improve the functions, adding practical functions such as synchronization, Apple health, custom symptoms and expressions, so stay tuned.

bluejetty:00018962:ios.name: Car Simulator OG
bluejetty:00018962:ios.summary:
You will really feel like you are behind the wheel of a car. Cruise around the city in your car with friends, and experience how cool and difficult it can be at the same time. 
Explore the city, and perhaps you will find something interesti
bluejetty:00018962:ios.description:
You will really feel like you are behind the wheel of a car. Cruise around the city in your car with friends, and experience how cool and difficult it can be at the same time. 
Explore the city, and perhaps you will find something interesting. 
You have a 360-degree view of the cabin. Fun companions are waiting for you to join them in the game.
Set up a race according to your own rules! Turn on the music and let's go!!!! 
The game offers online mission races (in multiplayer mode) where you can compete with real players, defeat them, and earn more money. 
Tips:
1. Do not speed. Drive carefully in order to avoid crashing or damaging your car. 
2. Beware of the traffic police. If you speed, then you will get a ticket. 
3. Pay attention to the interactive hints. 
4. Don't forget to fill up your car with gas at the gas station.
5. It is cheaper to pay a bribe than the official ticket. 
6. For your convenience, please keep the doors locked when driving. 
Please note: The input area for the interactive buttons is around the center of the screen. The side areas with the control buttons are inactive. 
To successfully activate the interactive parts of the game, you must first drag the component of interest to the center of the screen while in 360-degree mode. Press to confirm your selection. 
Game features: 
- Fun interactive game with endless replay value.
- Daily bonuses. 
- First-person mode. 
- Richly detailed car models.
- Many of the components inside the car are interactive.
- You can modify and tune your car in a large number of ways. 
- Interesting map of the city and its environs.
- Interactive gas station. 
- Fun quest- and arcade-style missions.
- Additional multiplayer-mode missions. 
Additional bonus! 
The game contains an additional 3 cars. One of the cars has a dead battery, the second lacks one entirely, 
and the third is missing a wheel. Find a way to get them going again, and they will be yours!!! 
Hint! 
There are 3 ways to acquire new cars: for free, at a discount, or by buying the car in the showroom. 
Bonus! 
Police cruiser.

海词词典是一款简洁、高效的英汉查词翻译应用。
海词从2003年创立以来，长期专注词典研究，十几年沉淀，累积用户上千万。“努力创造高品质的词典”是海词人奋斗的目标。

*** 名人推荐 ***
【《英汉大词典》主编复旦大学陆谷孙教授】
曾为海词题词：“深造为公，自然为至。”

【《牛津词典》（中国）主编于海江】
在海词9周年时贺词：“学海无涯，海词为舟。”

【《柯林斯词典》中国区总监陈文亮】
曾为海词题词：“网络词典，不单是查词解惑的工具，更应是学习表达的贴身助手，我推荐海词！”

【《创业家》杂志社社长牛文文】
曾为海词题词：“学好单词，用海词词典。”

*** 内容特色 ***
【收词全面】
词典种类全、词汇量大：收录词汇涵盖小学到高中、四六级和考研、雅思和托福、职场和商务等多种类型词汇书，满足您各阶段的英语学习需求。

【词汇精讲】
精心设计常考词组与短语、大量优质例句、词义辨析、近义词辨析与反义词、词源解说等栏目，帮助您进一步理解词汇及掌握词汇用法；额外为您提供单词的英英释义，助您掌握地道的英语使用方法。

【地道发音】
单词、例句提供英式、美式两种发音，助您学会地道口语。

【真题链接】
提供最经典的历届真题案例，助您轻松通过相关考试。

【考频统计】
大数据抓取词汇考频与考试形式，把握出题趋势，直击考试要点。

【名著阅读】
收录数十本经典外国名著，同步支持文字和语音版、支持点击查词及划线翻译，让您拥有更经典的英文原版书库、更便捷的英文名著阅读体验。

【视频微课】
特邀著名英语教师录制视频课程，精心打造四级写作课、词汇引爆营等课程，助您更快、更好地记忆单词、理解语法、学会表达。

【趣味学习】
每日“抖英”、每日辨析、每日一听、每日一练等学习专栏实时更新，更有阅读、听力、写作、语法等卡片化繁为简，每日十分钟，学习轻任务助您聚沙成塔。

*** 功能特色 ***
【单词使用频率视觉化】
单词释义太多，不知道应该使用哪一个？海词独家使用大数据抓取单词最常用的释义，以饼图的形式展示并降序排列，助您精准使用每一个单词。

【阶段专属词汇定制】
选择您目前的英语学习阶段，获取专属单词书，听说读写巩固单词记忆。

自定义生词本，您可标记单词熟练度，方便下次查找和使用，助您更高效地记忆单词。

【学习记录云端存储】
采用云端同步技术，为您提供生词同步学习服务，切换设备也不用担心丢失单词本，助您高效无缝学习。

【离线词典想查就查】
支持离线词典功能，随时随地，单词想查就查。

bluejetty:00179113:ios.description:
Sense Bank — an online bank that makes managing your finances simple.
Open a banking account in minutes, transfer money from card to card or via IBAN, make payments and pay utility bills, track your spending, and manage your business account — all in one app.
To open a card is easy:
• Complete identification through a video chat or the Diia app.
• Get a digital bank card instantly after opening an account, with free delivery of your physical card.
Sense Bank JSC is a state-owned bank of Ukraine and one of the largest banks in the country.
BANKING SERVICES
• Fast payments and transfers: card-to-card and via IBAN, QR payments.
• Utility payments and mobile top-ups with no fee.
• Money transfers to Ukrainian banks.
• International SWIFT transfers and currency exchange.
• Create templates for regular payments and transfers.
• “Drag & Drop” payments — send money even faster.
• “Collect Money” feature — split bills or gather funds for a group goal.
• Manage tokens and subscriptions.
• Financial Assistant — track spending by category and plan your budget.
• Account statements and receipts in a few taps.
• Apple Pay and Google Pay support.
• Intuitive, personalized banking interface.
• 24/7 customer support.
BANK CARDS
• Choose your card — debit, credit, premium, and business, as well as сo-brand cards “Vygoda” (Epicenter) and ATB
• Top up your card — easily, with no fees, via Sense Bank ATMs and terminals, or through EasyPay and City24 terminals
BANKING FOR FAMILIES
Sense Bank cards for your loved ones and kids — shared credit limit, family budget control, and more rewards.
CASHBACK
• Cash ’u Club bonus program, advanced cashback, and special cashback from our partners 
• Withdraw bonuses as real money (1 bonus = 1 UAH)
• Invite a friend to Sense SuperApp — you and the new client both get 100 UAH cash back directly to your accounts.
YOUR BUSINESS
• Entrepreneurs:
Open a sole proprietor account and a digital business card in just a few minutes in the app. Pay taxes, transfer funds to your personal card and to other banks, make payments, open a foreign currency account, sell currency 24/7, and more.
DEPOSITS
• “Fast” — daily interest accrual.
• “Profitable” — bonus for renewal.
• “Savings” — flexible term of your choice.
• Mortgage — consultation and online application.
CREDIT PROGRAMS*
• Cash Loan* — apply directly in the Sense Bank app and get a decision instantly.
*The actual annual interest rate depends on the loan amount and term and may range from 24.6% (calculated for the maximum loan amount of UAH 300,000 for 24 months) up to 411.3% (calculated for the minimum loan amount of UAH 1,000 for 24 months).
• Instant Installment* — pay for purchases in equal parts from your Sense Bank card.
*Maximum loan amount — up to UAH 200,000 for a term of up to 24 months. The actual annual interest rate is 27.9% for 6 months and 51.8% for 24 months, subject to compliance with the "Instant Installment Plan" program terms.
• Easy Installment* — split payments for goods and services at our partner stores.
*Maximum loan amount - up to UAH 200,000 for a term of up to 24 months. The actual annual interest rate under the "Easy Installment Plan" program terms is 0.01% (for 3–24 months).
Sense SuperApp — your all-in-one online banking solution.
Manage your accounts and cards, make payments and transfers, open deposits, and perform currency operations — everything you need for everyday banking in one simple and secure app.
Sense Bank JSC. Registered in the State Register of Banks No. 158. Banking License of the National Bank of Ukraine No. 61 dated 01.12.2022.

bluejetty:00087706:ios.description:
Did you know that 91% of people are stressed about managing their day-to-day tasks? Are you one of them? Then, you’re in the right place.
Juggling work, personal life, and various responsibilities can feel like an overwhelming task. Enter Kanbana, a powerful app designed to revolutionize the way you manage your life. 
Whether you’re a busy professional, a student, or a homemaker, Kanbana offers a fresh approach to task and time management, organization, and work-life balance.
With Kanbana, you can easily:
• Create new lists and tasks,
• Prioritize your tasks,
• Track your progress, and
• See and manage all your “to do’s” in one place 
Kanbana uses a very intuitive design:
• Start a new board for work, home, school, or a new project,
• Add task cards that look like “sticky notes,”
• Assign colors to those task cards, and
• Move task cards to different columns to track progress (or whatever way makes sense to you!)
What makes Kanbana different from other task management apps?
• See the flow of tasks at a glance. Identify bottlenecks and optimize your workflow.
• Easily drag tasks between your varied To Do lists to maximize your efficiency.
• Custom lists and color-coded cards that fit YOUR personal organizational style.
Kanbana is free to use across devices - on the iPhone or iPad apps or on the web at www.Kanbana.com. Kanbana allows users to create and manage up to 20 task cards with a single board.
You can upgrade to Kanbana Premium if you want to use more than 20 task cards or create multiple boards. Create multiple boards to separate your work life from your personal life or for different projects.
Download Kanbana now and simplify your life. With Kanbana, you can manage your tasks and to-do lists with colorful sticky notes and achieve clarity and control in one easy glance.
Good luck on your journey towards a calmer, more organized lifestyle. We’ll be cheering for you!
Learn more at: https://www.kanbana.com

bluejetty:00064111:ios.name: Solitaire by Staple Games
bluejetty:00064111:ios.summary: Train your brain with a daily dose of Solitaire! Crafted by our small team with a passion for timeless classics, this is the straightforward, no-nonsense version of the card game you know and love – keeping you sharp without any unnecessary
bluejetty:00064111:ios.description:
Train your brain with a daily dose of Solitaire! Crafted by our small team with a passion for timeless classics, this is the straightforward, no-nonsense version of the card game you know and love – keeping you sharp without any unnecessary fluff or distractions.
Simple and intuitive gameplay with a minimalistic design ensures nothing gets between you and the game. Exactly what you're looking for in a classic Solitaire app.
Try it out!
FEATURES:
-Draw 1 card
-Draw 3 cards
-Easy to read cards
-Intuitive tap to play
-Intelligent auto-complete
-Right or left handed play
-Auto-save, so you never lose your progress
-Unlimited undo
-Statistics
-Auto Helper
-Dark Mode
How to Win:
Move all 52 cards up to the four foundations in sequential order, Ace to King, for each suit
Klondike Rules:
There are 7 Tableau columns with the last card of each face-up. Any face-up card can be moved onto another card on the Tableaus if it is in descending order of alternating colors, e.g. 8 of Hearts on a 9 of clubs or Jack of spades on Q of Diamonds. You can also move multiple cards at a time if they are already in descending order of alternating colors. In addition to using cards from the Tableaus, you can also play cards out of the Stock/Deck. You can choose (in settings) if you would like to pull 3 cards or 1 card at a time from the Stock. When a Tableau column is completely empty, the available space can be filled with a King. As they become available, cards from Ace to King can be moved from the Stock or the Tableaus to the Foundations.
We are here to help:
You will learn quickly, we promise! If you get stuck, tap on any card and the app will automatically make a valid move if one exists.

Caroline is a beautiful, hardworking and confident girl. After graduating from college, Caroline and her good friends founded a decoration design studio. Caroline was shocked when she saw the house for the first time. The house is as if no one has lived in it for decades, and everything needs to be cleaned and renovated, which is out of Caroline expected,so Caroline decided to use her design talent and hands-on ability to renovate the house and give it a new look. Caroline's design journey began from then on.

On the road of starting a business, Caroline also had many ups and downs with her friends. Why did Ryan get into a car accident? Ryan's ex-girlfriend married? How many ups and downs are there on Carolyn's design journey?

Caroline also has a hobby of cooking. In Caroline's dessert diary, she can merge fruits and milk, etc., and use a juicer to upgrade fruit and milk into milkshakes. In the dessert diary, she can participate in the food contest Take a risk and compete.

bluejetty:00080134:ios.description:
Stop Starting Over.
Most fitness programs are built around short-term challenges.
30 days. 6 weeks. 12 weeks.
And when life changes, you start over again.
BBM Health & Fitness is different.
Built around The BBM Method, this platform helps women build strength, consistency, and confidence through a system designed to evolve with your life.
Because your life changes.
Your fitness should evolve with it.
The BBM Method
The BBM Method is a structured fitness framework that helps women build strength and sustainable habits through every season of life.
Instead of starting over when life shifts, the method adapts so you can continue progressing with clarity and confidence.
Whether you're rebuilding consistency, gaining strength, or navigating a new season of life, BBM provides a clear path forward.
Strength Training That Fits Real Life
BBM workouts are designed for busy schedules and real homes.
Most workouts are 20–30 minutes, requiring minimal equipment and no gym membership.
Programs focus on progressive strength training, helping you build muscle, improve mobility, and support long-term health.
No extremes.
No burnout cycles.
Just consistent progress.
Programs for Every Season
The platform includes guided programs and training blocks designed for women at different stages of their fitness journey.
Whether you're returning to exercise, building strength, or looking for structured training you can sustain long-term, BBM helps you move forward without restarting.
You’ll find:
• Strength training programs
• Full-body workouts
• Upper and lower body splits
• Progressive overload training blocks
• Core and mobility sessions
Everything is organized to help you stay consistent without overwhelm.
A Supportive Community
Inside the BBM community, women support one another through every step of their journey.
Share progress, celebrate wins, ask questions, and stay accountable alongside thousands of members around the world.
Fitness becomes easier when you're not doing it alone.
What You’ll Get
• Structured strength training programs
• Short, effective 20–30 minute workouts
• Programs for beginners through advanced levels
• Monthly training blocks and challenges
• A supportive global community
• New workouts and programs added regularly
Built for Long-Term Health
BBM isn’t about quick transformations.
It’s about building a strong foundation for long-term health, confidence, and consistency.
Because when your fitness evolves with your life…
You never have to start over again.
Download BBM Health & Fitness and begin building strength that lasts.
Already a Member? Sign-In to access your subscription.
New? Try it for free! Subscribe in the app to get instant access.
BBM Health & Fitness offers auto-renewing subscriptions.
You'll receive unlimited access to content on all your devices. Payment is charged to your Account at confirmation of purchase. Pricing varies by location and is confirmed prior to purchase. The subscription automatically renews each month unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period, or the trial period (when offered). Cancel anytime in Account Settings.

bluejetty:00168191:ios.description:
Curious whether that mushroom you found is edible or toxic? Wondering if it’s safe to eat or better left untouched? Mushroom Identifier Fungus ID has the answers you’re looking for!
Take or upload a photo, and our app will instantly identify the mushroom from a database of over 100,000 species. Whether you're dealing with an edible delicacy or a toxic danger, Mushroom Identifier Fungus ID provides fast, accurate, and reliable information to help you make the right decision.
But we don't stop at identification. Our app gives you detailed insights into each mushroom's name, habitat, and key identifying features. Plus, you’ll receive clear warnings about toxic mushrooms, ensuring you stay safe while foraging.
Packed with high-quality articles on mushroom identification, foraging tips, and the latest trends in mycology, Mushroom Identifier Fungus ID also lets you track your favorite foraging spots, get seasonal recommendations based on your location, and share your discoveries with others.
Whether you're a seasoned forager, a curious beginner, or just need to know what that mushroom is, Mushroom Identifier Fungus ID is your go-to tool for all things fungi.
Key Features:
- Accurate identification of over 100,000 species of mushrooms and fungi
- Clear guidance on whether a mushroom is edible or toxic
- Comprehensive mushroom encyclopedia with all the details you need
- Up-to-date articles on mushroom-related topics
- Easy tracking of your foraging sites for future reference
- Seasonal mushroom recommendations and distribution maps based on your location
- In-app collection feature to manage and share your identified mushrooms
- Subscription auto-renew at the end of the subscription period, unless canceled 24-hours in advance prior to the end of the current period. The subscription fee is charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Per Apple policy, no cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
Terms of use: https://sites.google.com/view/mushroom-id/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://sites.google.com/view/mushroom-id/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00030431:ios.description:
Hey guys! バイリンガールのちかです！
私はYouTubeで「バイリンガール英会話」というチャンネルを通して楽しく英語に触れられる動画を配信しています。
海外旅行で英語で話す時って「なんて言えばよいのか？」「発音合ってるかな…」など、ドキドキしますよね。そんな時に、テキストと音声で英語のフレーズを確認できるのが、このアプリ。
空港やホテル、レストランなど11つのシチュエーションごとに分類して、1000個以上の英会話フレーズを紹介しています！音声は、私・吉田ちかのの声で収録しているので、YouTubeで馴染みのある声で聴くことができてちょっと安心？！
音声は3段階のスピードで聴くことができます。ちなみに、機械的に3段階にしているのではなく、私が「Slow」「Normal」「Fast」をそれぞれ実際に言って録音しています。
音声はオフラインでも聴くことができるので、Wi-Fiなどの環境がなくても大丈夫！海外に行って使いたいのにWi-Fiがないからいざという時に使えない！なんてことはありません。
さらに、シチュエーションごとによくある会話のセリフを動画で確認ができるようにしています。
リアルな会話が繰り広げられる「バイリンガール英会話」の動画もその場で視聴できるので、海外にいなくてもその雰囲気を味わいながら、フレーズを練習できます。
また多くリクエストいただいたフレーズの聞き流し機能も加わったので、連続でフレーズを聞くことができます。
さらに他の言い回しや海外旅行のTipsなどを知ることが書籍「HELP me TRAVEL 旅が100倍楽しくなる英会話」（実業之日本社）も発売中です。こちらの本では、フレーズに加えて、私が今まで体験してきたリアルな会話、そして旅のTipsなどをシェアしています。
このアプリと書籍によって、皆さんが海外旅行に行った時、『勇気を出して話してみたら通じた！』『事前に知っていたから相手の言っていることが分かった！』など、素敵な思い出を作ることが出来たら私も嬉しいです！
海外に行く予定がある方はもちろんのこと、海外に行って英語でコミュニケーションをとってみたい！と思う方は、ぜひ利用してみて下さい！

· You can turn off auto renewal any time from your iTunes account settings.(it should be turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period)

“Barbarous - Tavern of Emyr” is a brand-new time management game unlike any other!
Emyr was once the realm’s most famous hero. That is, until his career was destroyed by a dreadful wound feared by all adventurers! Robbed of the chance to defeat his archenemy whom “no hero can defeat”, Emyr awakens in a shabby tavern without a single coin to his name – as its new owner! And to make matters worse, now a teenager claiming to be his daughter has shown up!
Will Emyr be able to get his adventuring career back on track?

Will he rise to the challenge of responsible parenting?
Old habits die hard in this comical adventure!

Welcome to Rolling Ball 3D – a fun and exciting ball control game set in a stunning 3D world!
In this game, you control a ball as it rolls, jumps, and speeds through challenging paths full of twists, turns, and obstacles. Your goal is simple: stay on the platform, avoid falling, and reach the finish line. Sounds easy? Think again! Each level brings new challenges, sharper curves, moving platforms, and unexpected traps.
Rolling Ball 3D is easy to learn but hard to master. You’ll need quick reflexes, good timing, and smart moves to keep your ball on track. The controls are smooth and responsive, making it fun for players of all ages.
Features:
Master the art of ball parkour.
Stunning visuals and smooth controls.
Multiple exciting levels with increasing difficulty
Endless fun and excitement with multiple balls to choose.
Navigate colorful balls through challenging ramps and obstacles.
As you progress, levels get more complex and thrilling. Some paths are narrow, some moves, and some disappear right under your ball! Stay focused, be patient, and don’t give up – every level is a new adventure.

Can you complete all the levels and become the ultimate Rolling Ball master?

bluejetty:00076431:ios.summary:
iSharing is the comprehensive family locator and GPS tracker app that keeps your loved ones safe and connected in real-time across iPhone, iPad, web, and other popular platforms.
No more texting "where are you?"
Download iSharing, the famil
bluejetty:00076431:ios.description:
iSharing is the comprehensive family locator and GPS tracker app that keeps your loved ones safe and connected in real-time across iPhone, iPad, web, and other popular platforms.
No more texting "where are you?"
Download iSharing, the family tracker trusted by over 60 million families, and get real-time GPS location tracking updates with precision GPS technology and complete privacy protection.
iSharing includes complete safety features like:
• Real-Time Tracker & Location Tracking: See exactly where your family and friends are with live GPS updates on interactive maps - perfect for teen monitoring and elderly care
• Find My Phone/Device/Family: Locate lost or stolen devices with real-time tracking and last known location even with a dead battery
Place Alerts: Get instant notifications when family arrives or leaves important places like home, school, or work. Plus, nearby zone alerts when family members are close to each other
• Panic Alert: Send emergency alerts with a single tap - works immediately when you need help most
• 365-Day Location History: Access the industry's longest location history with detailed GPS timelines, routes, and exact timestamps for up to 1 year
• Live Location Sharing: Share your location via SMS, email, or social media with friends and family who don't have the app, or invite them to download iSharing
• Walkie-Talkie Feature: Enjoy instant voice messaging for quick family communication
Premium Features for Enhanced Family Safety:
• Driving Reports: Monitor driving behavior including phone usage detection while driving, speed monitoring, hard braking, rapid acceleration, and complete driving history - perfect for teen driver safety and senior driver monitoring
• Unlimited Place Alerts: Set up unlimited custom locations with geofencing and receive automatic notifications
• Emergency Sound Recording: Enhanced SOS alerts that include audio messages for clearer emergency communication
• 3D Street View: Explore places with street view on Google Maps and Apple Maps - an easy way to understand exactly where your family is
• Battery & Drive Alerts: Get notifications for low battery levels and driving activities
• Linked Device & Web App: Link and track all your multiple devices through one central account - phones, tablets, and computers. Check your family's locations from any device or web browser
• Inactivity Alerts: Receive notifications if a family member hasn't moved for an extended period, especially helpful for elderly care and dementia monitoring
Perfect For Every Family: Whether you're monitoring teen drivers, providing elderly care, coordinating family activities, or ensuring emergency safety, iSharing, a family safety app, helps parents reduce anxiety with easy tracking and smart alerts.
Start protecting your family today with iSharing's free features, then unlock premium safety features including driving reports, emergency sound recording, and 365-day location history with your 7-day free trial.
Premium subscription includes a 7-day free trial and renews automatically. Payment charged to iTunes Account at purchase confirmation. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal turned off in Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.
**Important Note:** Sharing GPS locations requires mutual consent from all family members and friends
Continuous GPS use may impact battery life - our optimized technology minimizes battery drain.
Push notifications and GPS must be enabled for the app to function.
Privacy and data security are our top priorities with end-to-end encryption and advanced app security - share your location only with people you trust.
Terms of Use: http://isharingsoft.com/terms_of_use
Privacy Policy: http://isharingsoft.com/privacy_policy
Support: contact@isharingsoft.com

bluejetty:00155351:ios.description:
PieZoni's®, a family owned and operated business, started as a casual dining restaurant chain in 1996, operating under the name "Pepperoni's." It's current concept has evolved under the ownership of Victor Martinez and Joe Ferreira. PieZoni's® features pizza with a complementing array of items that has proven its appeal to a value-conscious clientele. 
Creativity, hard work and the support of its founders led to the formation of PieZoni's® Franchising, LLC in January of 2006. The family's passion for excellence in preparing Italian foods and providing superior customer service continues to exist today. 
PieZoni's® was created in response to the demands of consumers who wanted great pizzas, sandwiches, salads and Italian pastas, prepared with fresh ingredients, served in a clean, bright, visually exciting atmosphere by friendly, efficient restaurant personnel. Our "Bar Pie" pizza is the foundation upon which we have constructed our menu. PieZoni's 10-inch round thin-crust pizza distinguishes itself from the competition through the development of proprietary recipes for our dough and sauce.
We can assure our customers that they will have the same experience every time they enter a PieZoni's® restaurant. We have created PieZoni's® as a brand that brings fun, quality and consistency to our customers. 
You will be prompted to opt-in or opt-out of push notifications upon the first app start up after download from Apple App Store to an iOS device. Once a selection has been made, any changes to push notifications preferences have to come from your device operating system settings.

bluejetty:00082818:ios.description:
Unleash your inner artist with Art Tracer: Photo To Drawing!
Art Tracer: Photo To Drawing makes it easy to create stunning artwork by blending your drawings with the real world. Whether you're a beginner or just want to have fun with art, AR Drawing will give you the tools to bring your imagination to life.
Here's what makes Art Tracer special:
- AR Camera: Trace and Sketch with AR Camera. Simply position your phone and start tracing the projected lines onto your paper. Enjoy the fun of AR Drawing with 3 modes to draw and sketch.
- 500+ Drawing Templates: Choose from a vast library of templates, including Anime, Cute, and unique designs. 
- Create your own Artwork: Upload and draw on your favorite photos and images. Simply follow the line AR Drawing created, and you will have a perfect sketch painted in no time!
- Advanced Tools: Enhance your drawings with a variety of tools and effects, including pencil photo conversion, video recording, opacity adjustment, and more.
- Share Your Masterpieces: Connect with a vibrant community of artists. Share your creations and get inspired by others.
How to Draw AR Photos:
Simply hold your iPhone or iPad between your eyes and your canvas. AR Drawing will overlay a virtual image on your screen, guiding your hand as you draw. It's like having an invisible art teacher, making it incredibly easy and fun to create masterpieces!
Download Art Tracer: Photo To Drawing now and start creating amazing AR drawings!

• Register for offender custody change notifications by in-app notification, phone, email, text message (where available) or TTY device

bluejetty:00089470:ios.description:
KERO 23 ABC News Bakersfield gives you up-to-the-minute local news, breaking news alerts, 24/7 live streaming video, accurate weather forecasts, severe weather updates, and in-depth investigations from the local news station you know and trust.
Connect to your community through our local news app. We're celebrating what makes our community great, giving you context to understand local issues and sharing solutions to help you solve problems.
LOCAL NEWS:
• Get up-to-the-minute breaking news alerts and stories.
• Tap 'Top News' to read the most important news of the day as curated by our local news teams.
• Tap 'Most Recent' to read the news stories published most recently.
• Get full support for Dark Mode and Light Mode based on your device preference.
LOCAL VIDEO:
• Watch our 24/7 live streaming news channel.
• Watch video on demand clips from recent newscasts.
• You're in control over what you want to watch and when.
LOCAL WEATHER:
• Get daily video weather updates from your trusted local weather team.
• Stay up to date with hourly and daily weather forecasts.
• View interactive weather radar to help you track rain, snow and storms.
• Get weather conditions and forecasts for your location.
We're committed to continually improving your experience in our app. Please let us know how we're doing by leaving a review in the App Store.
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00022596:ios.description:
EXPLORE A VAST MMORPG WORLD LIKE NO OTHER
RuneScape is a high fantasy open world MMORPG. Explore an ever changing and evolving living world where new challenges, skills, and quests await. Featuring unprecedented player freedom, you choose how to play, adventure, and grow.
PLAY YOUR WAY
It's all up to you. Will you explore the world and embark on a risky raid with friends, or seek fame and fortune as a lone adventurer? Whether you’re the hero of daring quests, quietly tending to your farm, a legend risking it all against a high-level boss or simply a gentle soul spending a night at the circus, RuneScape is the perfect AFK second-screen game. Play how you want, the choice is yours! Warrior or wizard, farmer or cook – what type of hero will you be?
ENDLESS DISCOVERY
With a world and story that’s been growing for an incredible 20 years, RuneScape continues to thrill players with a magic packed adventure unlike any other. With 270 million installations and cross-playability on PC and mobile, join the hundreds of millions of people who have explored the fantastic and mystical world of Gielinor.
UNFORGETTABLE ENCOUNTERS
Make friends – and perhaps sometimes enemies – with a rich roster of memorable NPC characters. From lovable companions and friendly rogues, to deceitful villains and vengeful gods, the many faces of Gielinor offer a deep fantasy experience unlike anything else.
A THRIVING WORLD
Visit dozens and dozens of unique and striking locations, from the medieval city of Burthorpe and the tranquil harbours of Catherby, to the dangerous dragon filled expanses of the Wilderness or the barren and parched Kharidian Desert. Own your own port! Run your own farm! Make a pretty penny trading with players at The Grand Exchange… but be sure to keep your exotic wares safe in the Bank!
POWERFUL SKILLS
With 29 skills to master, what will you become? Will you be one with nature by perfecting Woodcutting, Fishing, Herblore and Cooking? Or perhaps you prefer to be creative with Crafting, Farming, Smithing and Construction? Maybe your tastes lay elsewhere – with Hunting, Divination, Invention or Runecrafting? Or does your soul yearn for action, with Magic, Summoning, Slayer and Dungeoneering? 
VERSATILE COMBAT
Do you want to get up close and personal with a sharp blade in your hand? Or will you take a tactical approach and attack from range? Or perhaps your skills are more mystical, and you prefer the arena of magic? Defeat a dazzling assortment of foes including an unimaginable array of epic bosses. From demons to dragons and rock monsters to serpents, nightmares beyond your wildest imagination lay in wait. 
MEMBERSHIP BENEFITS
RuneScape can be played for free, but also offers optional membership that unlocks even more thrilling content, including 8 additional skills, over 120 extra quests and access to the entire world map! Enjoy RuneScape at its best!
JOIN OUR COMMUNITY
Add your unique voice to our vibrant RuneScape community. Enjoy a strong connection to RuneScape's independent development team by joining them for regular livestreams and share ideas on the forums. We shape RuneScape together!
RuneScape supports EN, FR, DE and PT-BR languages.
Not Supported: iPhone 5S (and older), iPhone 6/6 Plus, iPad Mini 2, iPad Mini 3, iPad Air (2013)
Privacy Policy: https://legal.jagex.com/docs/policies/privacy
Terms and Conditions: https://www.jagex.com/terms
Do Not Sell Or Share My Personal Information: https://www.jagex.com/en-GB/terms/privacy#do-not-sell
RuneScape is free to download and play, however, this game also offers players the opportunity to purchase in-game items such as Treasure keys. These keys can be used to unlock treasure chests, which contain random items. Please see the PEGI information page for more information: https://pegi.info/search-pegi?q=runescape

bluejetty:00128547:ios.summary:
This app allows you to track every inch/centimeter of all your skiing adventures! 
 • Real-Time Location Insights: Stay informed on-the-go with SkiPal's up-to-the-minute location data, ensuring you never lose your way.
 • Comprehensive
bluejetty:00128547:ios.description:
This app allows you to track every inch/centimeter of all your skiing adventures! 
 • Real-Time Location Insights: Stay informed on-the-go with SkiPal's up-to-the-minute location data, ensuring you never lose your way.
 • Comprehensive Trip Analysis: Dive deep into your skiing statistics with detailed trip measurements, capturing every moment of your exhilarating experience.
 • Visualized Routes on Maps: Relive your skiing journey with routes artistically drawn over maps, showcasing every twist and turn of your adventure.
 • Versatile Activity Selection: Whether you're skiing or snowboarding, SkiPal tailors its features to your chosen snow sport for a customized experience.
 • In-Depth Ski Metrics: Track your ski distance, maximum speed, and calories burned, turning every ski trip into a measurable adventure.
 • Dynamic Data Charts: Uncover patterns in your performance with various charts displaying elevation, speed, and more, over time.
 • SOS Rescue Feature: Ski with peace of mind knowing the SOS rescue message feature is there to keep you safe in emergencies.
 • Enhanced Trip Photography: Capture breathtaking photos with overlaid trip data and pinpoint their exact locations on a map for a unique storytelling experience.
 • Customizable Waypoints: Personalize your ski map with waypoints, marking important locations and data for a more organized adventure.
 • Quick Ride Launch: Instantly start a new ride and track its duration with SkiPal's quick ride feature, perfect for spontaneous skiing sessions.
 • Historical Trip Archive: Look back on your skiing milestones with easy access to historical trip data, creating a legacy of your snowy escapades.
 • Versatile Data Export and Import: Flexibly export your trips to GPX, KML, KMZ formats, and import GPX data for a seamless data management experience.
 • Offline Map Accessibility: Navigate confidently without internet connection using SkiPal's offline map downloads, ensuring uninterrupted ski adventures.
 • Segmented Trip Analysis: Dissect your trip into uphill and downhill segments, offering detailed insights into every aspect of your skiing experience.
 • Cloud Sync and Web Panel Access: Log in to synchronize your data across devices and access it through a convenient web panel for comprehensive trip management.
 • Motivational Audio Cues: Stay motivated and informed with audio cues that activate after specific time intervals or distances traveled, keeping you engaged throughout your ski trip.
 • Apple Watch Integration: Enjoy the freedom of measuring your ski trips with Apple Watch compatibility, enhancing your experience with hands-free convenience.
Simply tap or move your finger over the chart to see when and where a given value occurred. You can also choose from multiple snowbound activities, the app will function as a speedometer, calorie counter, keep track of checkpoint times, alert you with notification sounds at pre-set milestones, and even auto pause should you decide to stop somewhere for coffee or to take a photo. If you do stop to take photos, they can easily be added with the data of your current position overplayed right on top. Your photos will have- elevation, average speed, location and even route info right on them. 
More precise data tracking - improved functionality of your routes and ski data collection for more precise results.
Health app integration. On your watch track your health and workout data, observe your heart rate. Your data will be synchronized with system health kit on your watch device.
Enjoy.

**UNIQUE VALUES FOR YO
bluejetty:00182906:ios.description:
Tired of boring to-do lists? Struggle to stay focused or maintain a daily routine? It's time to gamify your life! Welcome to Habit Hunter, the ultimate RPG habit tracker that turns self-improvement into an epic game.
**UNIQUE VALUES FOR YOU**
Habit Hunter rewards you for real-world progress. Treat your tasks like quests, earn XP, gather gold, and level up your hero! It’s the perfect productivity companion featuring modern design, powerful tools, and a built-in Pomodoro timer to boost motivation and help you conquer your goals.
**FEATURES**
1. Epic RPG Gamification
Create your hero and earn XP by completing daily tasks. Use your gold to buy weapons, armor, and skills. Defeat monsters by keeping your habit streaks alive!
2. Goal & Task Management
Set S.M.A.R.T goals and break them into manageable to-do lists. Organize your daily routines effortlessly and never miss a task with smart reminders.
3. Focus Timer with Rewards
Use the built-in Pomodoro timer to stay focused on deep work. Sync your focus sessions with your RPG progression for extra rewards.
4. Perfect for ADHD
Struggling with executive dysfunction? Habit Hunter provides the visual progress and instant dopamine hits needed to stay engaged and accountable.
5. Social Quests
Team up with friends for social quests. Build unstoppable streaks and multiply your rewards together.
**PEOPLE LOVE IT**
Join over 50,000 heroes who have transformed their lives with our gamified habit tracker. Stop procrastinating and start your adventure.
Download Habit Hunter today and level up your daily routine!
------
You can subscribe to Habit Hunter to get access to premium features.
* You'll be charged once a week or once a year depending on the subscription option you choose.
* Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
* Your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
* Your account will be charged within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Prices are in US Dollars and may vary outside of the US.
* You can manage your subscription and renewal settings, or discontinue your subscription by going to Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Use: https://habithunter.net/policy
Privacy policy: https://habithunter.net/policy

• Start, stop, or transfer service

And much more…

Forge your destiny in a realm of Immortals. Mast
bluejetty:00151812:ios.description:
Eternal Sword Pact: The next-gen Xianxia MMORPG featuring Massive GVG Siege Wars! Dive into an exquisitely beautiful Open World inspired by the Classic of Mountains and Seas (Shan Hai Jing).
Forge your destiny in a realm of Immortals. Master tactical combat, cultivate powerful Mystic Familiars, and embark on an epic journey to recover the soul of a Demon Lord. Gather allies for Challenging Boss Raids and redefine your Legend.
— CORE GAMEPLAY —
Epic GVG & PVP Battles: Command your Guild in large-scale Siege Wars and conquer the Global Arena for honor and dominion.
Deep Cultivation System: Evolve your character with unique Xianxia skills and master the secrets of Immortal arts to achieve ultimate power.
Mystic Familiars: Capture and fuse Agile Spirit Monsters into powerful Familiars, essential companions that adapt to your combat style.
— SOCIAL & PROGRESSION —
Dynamic Progression: Acquire powerful Gear and materials by defeating Bosses. Customize your loadout to match any challenge in the open world.
Soulmate & Couple System: Forge deep bonds and discover exclusive Couple Dungeons and shared experiences within the beautiful Orient.
Seamless Experience: Enjoy the vast world of the MMORPG with convenient Auto-Battle and efficient progression features designed for mobile play.
— THE LORE — [Eternal Sword Pact] is an exquisitely beautiful mobile game based on the ancient "Shan Hai Jing" (Classic of Mountains and Seas). Its meticulously crafted world scenes and agile spirit characters are all designed from classic mythology. You, the new Demon Lord, will embark on a journey through the mountains and seas to recover the memories and weapons of the mighty Demon Lord Xuanyuan, ultimately uniting the Demon Clan and facing the great threat of the Demon God Xie Tu.

Gronda is the #1 app for professional and home chefs. Learn from the world’s best, fine dining recipes, and connect with a global community of culinary experts. Discover inspiration, sharpen your skills, and build your personal brand as a chef.
Explore an extensive library of 50,000+ recipes from top chefs, 60+ masterclasses from industry legends, and exclusive content from chefs at starred restaurants. Use cutting-edge tools like the AI Recipe Creator to craft unique dishes, and join a community of over 2M chefs.
Subscribe to PRO to access premium content and support the chefs who inspire you. Whether you're an aspiring home chef or a seasoned professional, Gronda is your gateway to the culinary world.
GRONDA FEATURES
RECIPES FROM STARRED CHEFS 
* Find 50,000+ recipes chefs actually cook in their restaurants. 
* Exclusive content from 1,500+ chefs at starred restaurants. 
* Explore fine dining recipes and discover new inspiration for your dishes.
MASTERCLASSES FROM INDUSTRY LEGENDS
* 60+ classes from world-renowned chefs, including:

* Learn techniques and tips that transform your cooking. 
ALL TOPICS COVERED
* Techniques (Sous-vide, Fermentation, Gelification, Dehydrating, Emulsifying, Freezing, Spehrification, Baking, Drying, Pressure Cooking, and many more)
* Pastry 
* Plating techniques 
* Seasonal ingredient selection 
* Flavor balancing 
* Sauce creation (Hollandaise, Béchamel, emulsifications) 
* Dessert techniques (e.g., tempering chocolate, macarons) 
* Protein preparation 
* Knife skills 
COMMUNITY OF CHEFS
* Join 2M+ chefs worldwide, from home cooks to culinary professionals. 
* Connect, share, and grow together in the only platform for real chefs. 
* Follow chefs and restaurants you love.
AI RECIPE CREATOR

ACCESS YOUR PAY IN REAL TIME – NO LOANS, NO INTEREST OR HIDDEN FEES, NO STRESS
Stream is the simplest way to access your paycheck before payday—completely stress-free. Whether you're navigating surprise bills, unexpected expenses, or just need extra cash, Stream is here to help. Stream is not a loan—there are no credit checks, no interest, no late fees, and no tipping. Download Stream today and access your earned pay in minutes, 24/7.
WHY CHOOSE STREAM?
1. Access Pay Instantly, Anytime
Access your paycheck in real-time from your employer, whenever you need it—24/7. No waiting, no paperwork.
2. No Loans, Ever
Stream is not a loan! There's no debt, no interest, and no hidden fees—just access to your earned pay.
3. Instant Cash Transfers
Transfer your pay directly to your bank or debit card in seconds. Meet your financial needs without delay.
4. Build Better Financial Health
Use Stream regularly to increase your access limits over time and manage your pay more flexibly.
5. Works Seamlessly with Most Employers
Connecting Stream to your payroll provider takes just a few minutes. Once connected, you're ready to access your pay early.
6. No Credit? No Problem
Stream doesn't rely on credit scores. Your income is all that matters.
7. No Membership Fees or Tips
Unlike other services, Stream does not ask for tipping or recurring subscriptions.
PERFECT FOR:
 • Workers who want to get paid early without hassle.
 • Those looking for fast cash access, 24/7, without interest, credit checks or late fees.
 • Anyone who values financial flexibility and control over their earnings.
HOW STREAM WORKS:
 1. Download the App – Get started in minutes.
 2. Connect Your Employer – Stream works with most payroll systems.
 3. Access Pay Early – Withdraw part of your paycheck anytime you need it.
 4. Automatic Repayment – Automatically repayment on payday.
ADDITIONAL BENEFITS:
 • 24/7 Availability: Access your pay anytime, day or night.
 • No Hidden Costs: Transparent and straightforward—what you see is what you get.
 • Quick Setup: Connect your payroll and access funds in just a few clicks.
YOUR 24/7 FINANCIAL COMPANION
Stream is here to help you navigate surprise bills, unexpected expenses, or anything life throws your way—24/7, without the stress of loans or credit checks.
CONTACT US
Have questions? Need assistance? We're here to help! Contact us at support@getstreamapp.com.
Note: Stream is a financial services platform, not a bank. Approval depends on application review, and delays may occur during high-traffic times. While we aim to support everyone, not all applications can be approved.
Download Stream now and enjoy financial freedom. Get started in less than 5 minutes!

bluejetty:00018737:ios.description:
Your Official Guide and Passport to Ohio’s Craft Breweries
Steeped in tradition and brimming with creativity, Ohio’s craft brewers invite you to taste the world-class beers made right here in the Buckeye State. Let the Ohio On Tap app be your official reference guide as you earn badges and prizes for visiting the 140+ brewery members of the Ohio Craft Brewers Association.
Ohio On Tap is the definitive guide to Ohio craft beer and offers these interactive features:
• Statewide passport program in which you earn prizes and achievement badges by visiting Ohio breweries
• Comprehensive brewery info including beers on tap, location and hours
• Tour planning function with built-in maps
• Location-based tool to identify nearby breweries
• Beer suggestions based on your previous check-in activity
• Photobooth and social media integration
• Event listings including Ohio Craft Brewers Association signature tasting events
• Label scanning function
• Craft beer style guide

bluejetty:00015632:ios.description:
Quimbee is an all-in-one learning platform built to support law students and bar examinees at every stage of their legal learning journeys. More than 900,000 students have trusted Quimbee Study Aids for expertly written case briefs, engaging video lessons, essay practice exams, and multiple-choice quizzes that help them survive cold calls and excel on exams. 
With Quimbee SideBar Videos, bar examinees get short, science-backed lessons designed to help them quickly understand and apply core bar exam concepts — plus hundreds of targeted multiple-choice questions that reinforce learning, strengthen retention, and train recall when it matters most. The result: smarter studying and greater confidence on exam day. 
From your first day of law school through your final days of bar prep, Quimbee is by your side. 
Quimbee includes: 
- The world’s largest database of case briefs keyed to 990+ casebooks 
- 1,290 short, engaging video lessons designed to help you comprehend the most complex legal concepts in all 1L, 2L, and 3L subjects 
- 3 case brief viewing options allow you to read full briefs, quick summaries, or bullet points to study how you prefer 
- Learning Hub, which lets you add your classes and recommends essential study tools tailored to your law school casebooks 
- Comprehensive outlines, plus short Quicklines for last-minute reviewing 
- 7,000+ multiple-choice questions with answer explanations 
- 210+ issue spotters with model answers written by real law professors 
- Materials designed using integrated learning-science methodologies for efficient, effective learning 
- 270+ digestible videos covering every subject on your bar exam 
- 800+ multiple-choice questions to test your knowledge of bar exam material 
- Bonus videos on bar exam tips and strategy

bluejetty:00068801:ios.summary:
EMT PASS - The Ultimate NREMT Prep Tool
EMT PASS is the result of a collaboration with Bill Brown, former Executive Director of the NREMT. Designed to transform your study process and boost your confidence, it increases your chances of pas
bluejetty:00068801:ios.description:
EMT PASS - The Ultimate NREMT Prep Tool
EMT PASS is the result of a collaboration with Bill Brown, former Executive Director of the NREMT. Designed to transform your study process and boost your confidence, it increases your chances of passing the NREMT on the first attempt. Our EMT PASS Predictive Scoring[TM] system evaluates your performance on practice exams to predict whether you're on track to pass.
With 700 high-quality review questions, EMT PASS ensures you're prepared for every key topic on the NREMT:
Assessment (Scene/Primary/Secondary) - NEW!
Airway and Ventilation
Cardiology and Resuscitation
Medical
Trauma
Operations
Pediatrics
Obstetrics
Multiple Response - The NREMT now includes questions requiring multiple correct answers. We've added this category to ensure you're ready.
New Style TEIs - Be prepared for Technology-Enhanced Items (TEIs) that require you to interact with the test beyond simple multiple-choice answers.
Each question includes a detailed rationale, helping you understand the reasoning behind the correct answer. Use these topic-based sections to identify your strengths and target areas for improvement.
When you're ready, take your preparation to the next level with two full-length, 120-question simulated NREMT exams. After each exam, receive detailed diagnostic feedback to refine your study plan and pinpoint areas that need more focus.
Get the most effective, predictive, and comprehensive NREMT prep with EMT PASS!

bluejetty:00039883:ios.description:
Relatio is your trusted companion for enhancing relationships and emotional well-being. Offering expert-backed, easy-to-follow guidance, Relatio helps you build deeper connections and improve your emotional health with practical tools designed for real life.
WHO IS RELATIO FOR?
For anyone seeking:
- Deeper emotional connections
- Improved communication
- Support with relationship challenges
- Better emotional management in personal life
Relatio provides personalized guidance, reflective tools, and expert advice to help you strengthen your relationships.
FEATURES OF RELATIO
- Personalized Plans
Customized plans tailored to your unique relationship needs, offering actionable steps and insights to build stronger, healthier connections.
- Mood & Journaling Tool
Track your emotions and reflect on your experiences with a combined mood tracker and journaling tool. By logging your daily thoughts and feelings, you can identify patterns, manage emotional reactions, and gain deeper self-awareness.
- Bite-Sized, Effective Courses
Access expertly designed courses on emotional wellness and relationship growth. Each short, impactful lesson provides practical strategies you can apply in everyday life.
- Expert Advice
Receive professional insights on relationship dynamics, offering support and guidance whenever you need it.
A SPACE FOR YOUR WELL-BEING
Relatio offers professional support for everyday relationship challenges, helping you build meaningful connections and enhance your emotional well-being.
SUBSCRIPTION AND TERMS

bluejetty:00083599:ios.description:
“Would this cut actually suit me…?”
Ever left the salon thinking, “That’s not what I pictured”? With HairTry, you can try hairstyles and hair colors on your own photo before you cut or dye.
From bangs and bobs to layers and lighter shades, HairTry is a hairstyle simulator that lets you check how a look suits you first. Here’s to feeling more excited than nervous the next time you try something new.
When it comes in handy
• The night before your salon appointment, checking whether the cut you saved online really suits you
• Not sure about bangs? Compare with and without, side by side
• Going from long hair to a bob, and wanting a preview before the big chop
• Thinking about bleach or a bolder shade, and wanting to see yourself with it first
• Moving to a new city and bringing a photo to your first appointment with a new stylist: “like this”
• Seeing a different stylist and showing them the look you have in mind instead of describing it
• Sending two options to a friend so you can choose together: “Which one?”
How it works
1. Pick a photo where your face is clearly visible.
2. Choose the hairstyle or hair color you want to try.
3. Compare it with your original, then save or share it.
What you can do
Hairstyle try-on
“Would a bob make me look childish?” Check it on your own face. Switch between 300+ styles, from short cuts and bobs to mid-length, long, perms, and with or without bangs, and compare them side by side. Using every style requires HairTry Pro.
Hair color simulation
“I want to go lighter, but will it look off on me?” See it on your own photo before you dye, right up to bleached brightness. Multi Paint lets you color just part of your hair, and Custom Color lets you create your own shade.
AI stylist Lumina
“I have no idea what suits me.” Then ask Lumina in the chat. It analyzes your facial features, suggests styles that may suit you, and lets you try them on right away.
Choose by face shape
Round, oval, square, heart, oblong, diamond: compare styles by face shape.
Import a hairstyle
Found a look you love on social media or in a photo? Import it and try it on your own face.
Trends for your country
Start with the styles popular in your country. Look for curtain bangs, a shag bob, face-framing layers, a mixie cut, and honey blonde curls.
Save and share
Save the looks you like to compare later, or show them to friends and your stylist.
Men’s hairstyles and bald filter
A men’s section with styles like a wolf cut, a textured quiff with a fade, and an afro taper, plus a filter that shows how you would look with a shaved head. Fun to try with a partner or friends.
About HairTry Pro
HairTry is free to download, but the free version limits how many AI images you can create. HairTry Pro is an auto-renewing subscription that unlocks every hairstyle, more colors and editing tools, and unlimited creations, and hides ads and watermarks. The price and whether a free trial is offered are shown in the app before you subscribe.
Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.
Results are AI-generated previews to help you decide. Actual results may vary with your hair type, hair condition, and your stylist.
A little rehearsal before you meet your new look. Before your next salon visit, try it on your own photo first.
Terms of Use: https://hair-try.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://hair-try.com/privacy

bluejetty:00200192:ios.summary:
Clackity is a split-flap clock for your desk, your nightstand and your iPhone Duo.

bluejetty:00200192:ios.description:
Clackity is a split-flap clock for your desk, your nightstand and your iPhone Duo.
It looks and sounds like the departure boards in old train stations. Every minute, the flaps tumble over and land on the new time with a soft clatter. Around the clock, smaller flaps show the date, the weather, sunrise and sunset, and your battery. It's calm, it's always on, and it's easy to read from across the room.
Designed for iPhone Duo. Works on any iPhone.
CLOCK
• Big flaps for the time, small flaps for everything else
• Each flap turns over its drum card by card, like the real thing
• 12- or 24-hour time, from your phone's settings
• Five classic typefaces: Futura, Avenir Next, Helvetica Neue, DIN Alternate and Rockwell
• A soft flip sound, or none at all
WEATHER
• Temperature, conditions, high and low, and chance of rain
• Now and then the big flaps flip to the sky and temperature, then back to the time
• Sunrise and sunset times
TIMER
• Swipe the clock to set a timer: left flaps for minutes, right flaps for seconds
• Watch it count down, flap by flap
• A gentle chime when it's done, not an alarm
IPHONE DUO
• Fold it into a tent and it stands on your desk as a dedicated clock
• A lit ring around the camera glows with the weather and counts down your timer
• Open it and hold it upright for a full departures board
On other iPhones the board fills the screen, and the Dynamic Island gets the same lit ring.
MAKE IT YOURS
• Choose what each row shows, and in what order
• Touch and hold the board to arrange it
BUILT TO STAY ON
• The board shifts slightly over time, so nothing burns in
• It dims when you're not using it, and again after dark
• On iPhone Duo, the screen stays awake only while it's folded into a tent
PRIVACY
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your approximate location is used only for local weather, from Apple Weather
Clackity is made by an independent developer. Pay once and it's yours: no subscription, no in-app purchases.

bluejetty:00015465:ios.summary: Hello Oklahomans! The Mesonet app brings a host of Oklahoma weather information right to your phone, including data from the award-winning Oklahoma Mesonet, plus forecasts, radar and severe weather advisories from the National Weather Servi
bluejetty:00015465:ios.description:
Hello Oklahomans! The Mesonet app brings a host of Oklahoma weather information right to your phone, including data from the award-winning Oklahoma Mesonet, plus forecasts, radar and severe weather advisories from the National Weather Service. Get fast access to the same info that the experts use!
Features:
• Get real-time weather observations from 120 Mesonet weather stations — at least one in every county — across the state.
• Add a widget (or two or five) to your home screen for your favorite station(s).
• Check out 5-day National Weather Service forecasts for all locations across Oklahoma, updated every hour.
• Use your device location to find the closest weather stations.
• Access maps of air temperature, rainfall, winds, dewpoint, humidity, soil temperature, soil moisture, pressure, solar radiation, satellite, and upper air conditions.
• View NWS advisories for severe weather, fire weather, flooding, wind, heat, cold, winter weather, and visibility.
• Animate the most recent NWS radar data from the Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Frederick, Enid, and other regional radars.
• Read the latest Mesonet Ticker post.
The Mesonet is a joint project of the University of Oklahoma and Oklahoma State University, operated by the Oklahoma Climatological Survey.

bluejetty:00021352:ios.description:
This app is for pumping mummies who insist on breast milk feedings for babies.
You can time the pumping, track the time, duration and amount of each pump, monitor the freezer stash and estimate the days to reach your goal.
It’s easy and effective to help you stress relief on ‘When did I pump last time?’, ‘When should I pump next time?’, ‘How much did I produce recent days?’ and ‘When can I stop pumping?’ these staffs.
Key Features:
⁃ Time the pumping.
⁃ Add pumping log manually.
⁃ Track how much produced and how long pumped for each log.
⁃ Track pumping times and total volume for each day.
⁃ Track time and duration of each pump.
⁃ Monitor current freeze stash.
⁃ Custom baby’s consumption in different age group and weaning time.
⁃ Estimate days and date that you can drop pumping.
⁃ Custom reminders to alert pumping.
⁃ Report for daily freezer stash.
⁃ Report for daily pumping volume.
⁃ Export logs by email in format of PDF, CSV or HTML.
⁃ Dropbox backup and restore.
⁃ Passcode protection.
⁃ Supports Apple Watch version.
⁃ Supports universal version (available on both iPhone and iPad).
If you have any question, please email to linklinksapp@tom.com.

Want to edit your photos quickly and easily? Our app has a huge collection of great effects and filters for your pictures. Use presets when editing photos to turn your pics into works of art!

- large variety of photo filters;
- search for filters by tags;
- add presets to favorites;
