You can see the effects of the Lightroom filters immediately in the examples and see if they are good for you or not! Enhance your photography with quality and beautiful photo-effects. 
~ Create content for social media
Make your social media posts unforgettable! Show your friends your colorful photos in a single color design! Our mobile app gives you a huge selection of presets that you can use to edit your images in Lightroom.

Do not waste time looking for the necessary filter and do not be afraid to lose your favorite preset! Our app has a very useful feature - you can add your preset filters to favorites and use them at least every day! Enjoy our application and get inspired, because there are no limits to your creativity!

Personalized Notifications｜Receive tailored information based on your preferences

bluejetty:00126269:ios.description:
It is the application created to be able to convert the format of a photograph and an image easily!
JPG/PNG/HEIC conversion is supported.
JPG/HEIC can adjust the compression quality.
It is possible to convert multiple images at once.
Format conversion procedure
It is intended to be easy to convert, so there is no need for difficult operations.
1.Select a photo(s)
2. Select the conversion format and compression quality
3.Select the destination and share
It is useful in such cases.
- If you send it as an email attachment
- Uploading to SNS such as Twitter
Destination
- In this application, you can not only save it in the camera roll, but also send the image that you converted to other applications and send it by mail!
Compression quality
- You can reduce the file size by adjusting the quality, but the image quality is visibly degraded.
About JPG
- JPGs are not compatible with transparency.
- Please be careful when you convert from PNG or GIF to JPG
About HEIC
- HEIC can reduce the file size from JPG by increasing the compression ratio, but it is not compatible with models before iPhone7.

Learn how to harness the power of your dreams to steer yourself in your desired direction with Angel Dreams Oracle Card App by Melissa Virtue. 
This beautifully illustrated card deck app reveals the meaning behind 55 basic dream symbols.
Every night when you're asleep, your angels, your unconscious mind, and the universe are giving you guidance, answers to your questions, and cautionary signs. This 55-card deck app will help you to take charge of your life and experience deep healing by understanding and processing these dream messages.
With this Oracle Cards app you can:
- Give "angel readings" anywhere, anytime on your iPad, iPhone or iPod touch
- Choose between 1-card, 3-card, 5-card and 12-card readings

- E-mail readings to friends

- Review the entire deck of cards in Browse mode

Melissa teaches workshops on dream interpretation and angels; created and teaches SpiralDance™, a spiritually based dance technique; and is the author of Dreamtime and the children's book series Magical Dream Journeys. Learn more about Melissa at https://www.beautyeverywhere.com/author/melissa-virtue/

bluejetty:00144241:ios.description:
Hiwell is a secure software chosen by more than 1 million users.
Find the right licensed psychologist and dietitian for you, and take a step toward feeling better today! 
With Hiwell, used by more than 2,000 licensed psychologists, you can access online psychological support based on scientific approaches for anxiety, stress, unhappiness, relationship and work problems, and other well-being needs. You can also get support from professional dietitians to reach your nutrition goals.
Hiwell psychologists are therapists trained and specialized in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dynamic Therapy, Interpersonal Therapy, Schema Therapy, and other psychotherapy methods.
All therapy and dietitian sessions are conducted with 100% confidentiality and security. None of the sessions can be viewed or recorded by third parties. All payments are processed through encrypted pages.
What Does Hiwell Offer?
Online Therapist (Psychologist)
Licensed therapists (psychologists) using Hiwell’s infrastructure are certified and have passed thorough evaluations and interviews.
After selecting the therapist that suits you best, you can have a free 15-minute video call to test your compatibility and ask questions about the support process.
Online Dietitian – New
Now you can also receive online nutrition counseling from expert dietitians on Hiwell. With personalized nutrition plans, flexible appointment hours, and ongoing follow-up support, you can take steps toward a sustainable lifestyle.
You can also have a free 15-minute video call with your dietitian to test compatibility and ask questions.
Why Hiwell?
Hiwell’s advanced algorithm, based on your registration answers, matches you with the most suitable therapists according to your expectations, needs, and schedule, and dietitians according to your nutrition goals.
With the mission of making psychological support and dietitian consultations accessible to everyone, Hiwell leverages technology to provide professional online services worldwide at affordable prices.
Through Hiwell’s free psychological tests, you can gain awareness about anxiety, low mood, social anxiety, phobias, alcohol use, traumatic grief, post-traumatic stress, self-esteem, attention difficulties, and more. You can then discuss these issues with your psychologist during therapy sessions.
You also get free access to a rich content library written by experts.
With psychologists on Hiwell’s platform, you can safely access adult therapy, couples therapy, and child & adolescent therapy.
From dietitians, you can get support for healthy weight management, PCOS, thyroid, insulin resistance, diabetes, sports nutrition, pregnancy and breastfeeding nutrition, vegan/vegetarian diets, child & adolescent nutrition, and personalized meal plans.
Contact Us
You can reach us via the Client Support Line or by emailing hello@hiwellapp.com for questions, feedback, or to apply as a psychologist (therapist) and dietitian (nutritionist).

bluejetty:00026517:ios.description:
If you like gangster simulator gaming - try to play our best action game: Gangster Simulator Vegas Crime. The criminal world will always exist on the streets in the town. In this free game, you have to try to go adventure crime saga to the pinnacle of mafia city. The price of success in this gang world is very high, few can reach the top. 
Try your skills in an exciting 3D third-person shooter with RPG elements and plunge into the atmosphere of street gang wars in an open 3D world. You are waiting for adventure missions throughout the big city. A dangerous and fascinating world in which harsh laws apply will appear before you in all its glory. If you are ready to test yourself - then go ahead, show everyone who is a real gangster in the town, eliminate all fake competitors and call a big underground empire yourself.
 Huge modern city
 The plot of the game takes place in a large modern city surrounded by ghetto streets. Tall skyscrapers and luxurious life make this city an oasis in the desert. This sinful town never sleeps and attracts with its lights all who dare to challenge the stone jungle. Try your hand at this exciting crime adventure to success and glory.
 Exciting quests
 Exciting adventure missions are waiting for you to get the necessary game resources that will be useful to you for more serious tasks. bluejetty:00124092:ios.description:
The new open world off-road driving simulator is here! It's time to get Off The Road!
Drive your rig on the hills of your own open world, get into a boat and explore islands, pick a helicopter and fly freely to the top of the mountains or just walk around if you need a peaceful hike it's up to you. 
Beat challenges to earn money and upgrade your car. Make it stronger, faster, look more awesome!
Earn experience points to level up and get cool rewards. 
[DRIVE ANYWHERE]
Using your car's winch you can climb the highest mountains, nothing can stop you. Thanks to the accurate rope physics the cable rope behaves realistically. You can drive boats to travel the sea or fly a helicopter or airplane to get anywhere easily.
[SIMULATION]
Realistic damage model for vehicles. Falls, crashes deform your car's chassis. Tyre pressure is simulated, tires deform based on load. Simulated water ripples, buoyancy etc.
[CHALLENGES]
Try to be fast to beat the Checkpoint Hunt challenges, use your driving skills to reach checkpoints in Pathfinder challenges. Find and transport the required materials for Transport challenges!
[MULTIPLAYER]
Compete against players around the world in multiplayer! Play sandbox or competitive in various game modes! Participate in Weekly Ranked Race events for amazing rewards!
[TRANSPORTATION]
Use trailers to transport materials to their destinations, or use your winch to attach to objects in the world and drag them around freely.
[CONSTRUCTION]
Construct houses, bridges, roads, vehicles by transporting the required materials to the site!
[VEHICLES]
Drive 4x4 cars, trucks, off-road behemoths, boats, helicopters, airplanes, trains!
[MUD PHYSICS]
Dynamic mud surface that deforms. You can find muddy fields to get your car dirty. Chassis can get muddy and dirty, you can wash it by driving into water or repairing.
Features:
-Explore beautiful landscapes
-55 cars to unlock and drive
-Driveable boats, helicopters, airplanes and train
-Online Multiplayer
-Weekly Ranked race events
-Tons of challenges to beat
-Collect card packs to unlock new cars
-Tons of collectibles
-Dynamic day and night cycle
-Physically simulated water
-Get out your vehicle and walk freely or get into other vehicles

Download now and become humanity’s last hope!

BUCKLE UP. The most INSANE Monster Truck experience on mobile is HERE.
Crush, race, stunt, and dominate across 8 legendary game modes — all in one adrenaline-loaded arena.
Monster Truck: Drag Race Clash — built for those who refuse to drive anything ordinary.
Premium Fleet
Get behind the wheel of DOZENS of exclusive premium Monster Trucks — beasts you won't find anywhere else in the App Store. Each truck is engineered for power, speed, and destruction. Unlock your dream machine and own the arena.
8 Explosive Game Modes
Stunts Arena — Crush challenges, earn glory, or go full freestyle in an open arena. Smash objects, pull gravity-defying stunts, and live out your monster truck fantasy.
Mud Drag Race Arena — The ultimate mud-bogging challenge. Tear through thick terrain and dominate every rival in the filthiest race of your life.
Taptime Rumble — Head-to-head drag racing with precision tap mechanics. Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard — and prove your reflexes are unbeatable.
Volcano Race — Long track, big rivals, explosive scenery. Survive the heat and cross the finish line first.
Freestyle Race — Day or night, the race never stops. Compete across stunning drag strips under the blazing sun or under the lights.
Drag Race Mode — Quick, raw, and ruthless. Jump into an interactive open arena and put the pedal to the metal.
Sprint Race — Tight stadium circuits with adaptive camera modes. Every corner is a battle. Every second counts.
Quick Play — Pick your mode, your truck, your time, and your laps — all from one fast single screen. Zero friction. Pure action.
Rewards. Offers. Glory.

Your Profile. Your Legacy.
Track every stunt. Count every flip. Watch your level grow. Customise your username and avatar and show the world who's behind the wheel. Your stats tell your story — make it legendary.
This Is Just the Beginning
We're only getting started. More trucks, more modes, more madness — all coming soon. Stay connected. Stay revved up. The next drop will blow your tires off.
Download NOW and join millions of monster truck fans who are already crushing it.
Free to play. Impossible to put down.

bluejetty:00161448:ios.description:
Enter the World of Dice vs Monsters: Roguelike TD
Embark on an exhilarating tower defense battle where strategy meets luck in an idle war against hordes of menacing monsters! Roguelike TD is a unique blend of strategy games, dice games, and fantasy games, offering an epic adventure for players of all kinds.
Gameplay Features:
- Strategic Tower Defense: Assemble your team of idle heroes, each represented by a unique die. Choose from mages wielding powerful spells, archers with deadly accuracy, necromancers summoning the undead, and more. Strategize your attacks and utilize each hero's special abilities for castle defense against waves of monstrous foes.
- Unlock Idle Heroes: Progress through the game to unlock new idle heroes and grow your idle army. Upgrade their abilities using dice rolls and collect artifacts to enhance their powers. Build a formidable kingdom guard capable of facing increasingly formidable enemies.
- Magic Survival: Harness wizard arcane powers to cast spells that turn the tide of battle. Survive in a world where every encounter is shaped by random dice rolls and roguelike challenges. Will your strategy and luck be enough to overcome the relentless onslaught?
- Defend Your Kingdom: Assume the role of kingdom guard and protect it from the forces of darkness. Master the art of dice rolling and tower defense to emerge victorious in this idle war for survival.
Why Play Dice vs Monsters: Roguelike TD?
Experience the thrill of combining idle heroes management with tower defense strategy in a dynamic and addictive gameplay experience. Whether you're a seasoned strategist or new to dice games, Dice vs Monsters: Roguelike TD offers endless hours of roguelike tactical fun.
Will you roll the perfect combination of idle heroes and claim victory, or will the monsters reign supreme? The fate of the realm rests in your hands. Join Dice vs Monsters: Roguelike TD, embark on an epic quest to vanquish the monstrous horde and prove you're the dice master!

bluejetty:00064305:ios.description:
Cette application vous offre la possibilité de contrôler votre Box directement depuis votre iPhone ou votre iPad, vous permettant ainsi de profiter de toutes les fonctionnalités de votre télécommande physique sans avoir à vous déplacer de votre fauteuil. 
Une solution simple et efficace si vous avez perdu votre télécommande ou si vos piles sont HS.
Mode d'emploi de l'application :
-Assurez-vous que votre iPhone est connecté au même réseau Wi-Fi que votre Box.
-Entrez le code de la télécommande dans l'application. Si vous ne savez pas où le trouver, suivez simplement la vidéo explicative de 10 secondes intégrée à l'application.
Une fois que vous avez mémorisé votre Box, l'application se connectera automatiquement, vous permettant ainsi de l'utiliser comme une télécommande originale.
Si vous avez des questions ou des remarques, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter par e-mail à l'adresse : support@nstx.io

bluejetty:00027444:ios.name: Life Lists: Notes & Habits
bluejetty:00027444:ios.summary:
Life Lists is the super organizer with a place for everything: checklists, notes, habits, groceries, budgets and more — with an assistant right under your lists that adds, answers and keeps it all tidy.
EVERY KIND OF LIST
• Checklists, pri
bluejetty:00027444:ios.description:
Life Lists is the super organizer with a place for everything: checklists, notes, habits, groceries, budgets and more — with an assistant right under your lists that adds, answers and keeps it all tidy.
EVERY KIND OF LIST
• Checklists, prioritized and numbered lists, lists with sections
• Groceries that sort themselves by aisle: add "apples" and it lands in Produce
• Habits with streaks and gentle reminders
• Reminders with due dates, repeats and subtasks
• Notes, notebooks, a journal and stickies
• Budgets that add themselves up, weighted pro/con lists, side-by-side comparisons
• Packing lists with to-buy / have / packed statuses
• People lists for birthdays and the details worth remembering
• Photo albums, counters and a breathing timer
• Tools beside your lists: timer, stopwatch, alarms, focus mode, voice memos and meeting notes
AN AMAZING ORGANIZER
• Folders for every part of your life — Home, Health, Family, Work — and folders within folders
• Your day at a glance above your lists: what's due, what's late, your habits and the weather
• Star an item to see it in Important; everything with a date shows in Upcoming
• Search, sort, reset a checklist to do it again, archive a list to keep a record
• Pin a list to open the app on it
• 500+ icons and colors, unlimited lists, no ads
AN ASSISTANT ON YOUR LISTS
• Ask or add anything from the bar under your lists: "add milk and eggs", "what's left to pack?", "remind me Friday at 9"
• Tap the mic and just say it
• Ask a question and the answer becomes something you keep — a checklist, a budget, a pro/con list, habits — filed in the right folder
• Snap a photo of a listing or a receipt and get the answer it implies: is it a good deal? how do we split it?
• Organize automatically tidies as you go; every change is one tap to undo
THE BEST GROCERY APP
• Auto-section: every item lands in the right aisle
• Build your own catalog to make long lists in seconds
• One list per store, and reset it to shop again
EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
• iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch, plus home screen widgets
• Sync with iCloud and share a list with family and friends — or keep everything on your device
YOUR DATA IS SAFE
• Your lists live on your device and, if you choose, in your iCloud, secured by Apple
• AI features send what you ask to our AI providers only after you allow it. Turn AI off anytime and Life Lists works as a classic list app.

bluejetty:00169757:ios.summary:
Find Catholic Churches near me, and their Mass Times, instantly. A completely FREE service.
Discover the #1 MOST POPULAR APP WORLDWIDE for locating Catholic churches and their Mass times. 
Featured by all leading Catholic media outlets, i
bluejetty:00169757:ios.description:
Find Catholic Churches near me, and their Mass Times, instantly. A completely FREE service.
Discover the #1 MOST POPULAR APP WORLDWIDE for locating Catholic churches and their Mass times. 
Featured by all leading Catholic media outlets, including EWTN, Vatican News, Rome Reports, Aleteia, ACI Prensa, National Catholic Register, Omnes, AICA, Catholic.net, Religion en Libertad, Infobae, CNA, and Relevant Radio, this application is a vital resource for Catholics everywhere.
GLOBAL COVERAGE
Access information for over 140,000 churches globally, with more than 10,000 updates each month. The most comprehensive and updated database of Catholic churches in existence!
INSTANT LOCATION AND DIRECTIONS
Quickly find nearby churches with precise addresses and transit directions. You can even request an Uber ride to Mass, even if you don't speak the local language, with just a couple of clicks! 
COMPREHENSIVE SCHEDULES
View Mass, confession, and adoration times. Parish office and parish activities.
DETAILED CONTACT INFORMATION
Get phone numbers, email addresses, and website links for churches.
SEARCH AND FILTER
Visualize nearby churches by distance, search by text (within church names, addresses, cities, or zip codes), or filter churches using the quick action buttons Mass Today, Confession Today, Adoration Today, or the advanced filters by day, time range, and language. Easily find nearby masses between 6:00 PM and 6:59 PM, or masses in English (when visiting another country), masses in Latin, or mass/confession in Spanish if you prefer that language.
SAVE YOUR FAVORITE CHURCHES, AND THE ONES YOU VISITED, ALL OVER THE WORLD
Favorite your usual parishes to quickly find their times. And collect all the churches you've attended Mass at, even across the world, and enjoy re-visiting them. 
COMMUNITY-DRIVEN UPDATES
Report errors or request the addition of a church directly through the app. Updates are typically published within a few hours. 
Whether you're at home or traveling, this app empowers you to attend daily Mass or weekly confession with ease, anywhere you go. 
Join this thriving global community of Catholics supporting each other in practicing their faith!

bluejetty:00033952:ios.summary:

Navigate the dynamic transfer market, master matchday tactics, and compete across 54 le
bluejetty:00033952:ios.description:
Step into the dugout in Soccer Manager 2027, a realistic football manager game where you take charge as manager of elite clubs and world-class players.
Navigate the dynamic transfer market, master matchday tactics, and compete across 54 leagues in 36 countries worldwide.
Experience the thrilling action unfold on the pitch with our improved 3D Match Motion Engine, bringing every football game to life with greater realism and immersion. SM27 delivers an authentic management experience for fans of football games and football management games.
KEY FEATURES
• Build your ultimate dream team from real players in this immersive soccer manager experience.
• Master formations and player instructions as you manage elite teams like Manchester City, Bayern Munich, and Borussia Dortmund.
• Compete across 54 football leagues globally, including the official Bundesliga.
• Develop your football club through training facilities and youth academy investments.
• Experience stunning 3D football games powered by the upgraded Match Motion Engine.
• Step onto the global stage and lead one of over 100 national football teams.
NEW FOR THE 2027 SEASON
• The improved 3D Engine features remastered player models and brand-new animations that bring matchday action to life.
• Refreshed UI with a sleek new colour theme for a more intuitive football management experience.
• Exciting additions: Live Scores, Squad Planner, and World Player of the Year awards.
• Enhanced tactics with a redesigned interface and robust club planning tools.
• New Club Focuses, immersive inbox messaging, and authentic continental cup draws add incredible depth to your football management career.
BUILD YOUR DREAM TEAM
Take control of the world's biggest clubs. Sign elite superstars, discover hidden wonderkids, and make critical transfer market decisions. Shape a squad capable of competing for the biggest trophies in this immersive football manager game.
MASTER MATCHDAY TACTICS
Take charge of your squad's formations and playing style. Select your top eleven, adapt your strategies on the fly, and guide your club to domestic titles and continental glory. Watch your tactical genius unfold in stunning 3D.
DEVELOP YOUR CLUB
Upgrade stadium facilities, improve your youth academy, and craft a long-term sporting strategy. Make every administrative decision count as you secure the future and financial success of your club.
AUTHENTIC COMPETITIONS & LEAGUES
Choose from over 900 clubs across 54 leagues in 36 countries worldwide, including the fully licensed Bundesliga. Take control of your chosen club, conquer domestic leagues and continental competitions, and build your managerial legacy.
INTERNATIONAL MANAGEMENT
Take the reins of over 100 national teams. Call up your country's best, shape the international squad, and compete for international glory in major global tournaments.
CREATE YOUR OWN CLUB
Want to start from scratch? Create and customise your very own club. Compete in authentic leagues, fight your way up through the lower divisions, and forge your unique legacy as a top football manager.
Do you have what it takes to become a legend of the beautiful game? Download Soccer Manager 2027 now and lead your club to glory!

bluejetty:00018376:ios.description:
Achieve your financial goals with a banking app that gives you control of your financial future.
The SCU mobile app gives you the freedom to manage your daily banking whenever, wherever. You can monitor your savings goals, manage payments, and make important transactions — all in one place. It’s a secure and easy-to-use solution for your personal or business banking needs.
With the SCU app, you can:
• Open personal chequing, saving, and investment accounts completely online
• Transfer funds and pay bills faster by creating shortcuts for your favourite transactions
• Deposit cheques in minutes with mobile deposit
• Monitor your spending habits with our activity timeline and financial overview
• Create goal-oriented accounts by giving each account a custom nickname and picture
• Enjoy extra banking security with two-factor authentication and instant alerts
• Receive security messages for account activity and customized alerts for transactions and logins
• View all of your business and personal SCU accounts with a single username and password

Introducing BetGPT: Your AI-Powered Prediction Companion for Sports Betting.
BetGPT is your ultimate sports prediction tool, harnessing the power of AI and built on OpenAI's GPT models. Our model is finely tuned using data from the vast landscape of football, with a primary focus on the Football API, featuring insights from over 2 million past matches spanning 47 international leagues and competitions.
BetGPT's model is based on GPT-5.6 Terra. Being traned on over 2 milion past maches, the model has been traied to leverage the input-data, which includes past 25 matches played by each team, past 10 direct matches between the two teams, recent form both home and away, current league stats, distance treaveled by the away team, stadium capacity & attendance, field width and height and many more, to determine the strengths and weaknesses of both teams.
While we can't guarantee 100% accuracy, BetGPT boasts an impressive track record, consistently achieving an 80% win rate. We encourage users to delve into the art of selecting the most promising predictions our model serves before placing real bets.
BetGPT caters to a wide range of markets, including:
Classic (1X2)
Both Teams to Score
Over/Under 2.5 Goals
Over/Under 3.5 Goals
Teams to Score
Teams to Score Over 1.5 Goals
Our model goes beyond boundaries, offering predictions for over 110 leagues, including both First Divisions and Second Divisions. We meticulously track over 2500 teams from across the globe, ensuring you have the most comprehensive insights at your fingertips.
Get ready to elevate your betting experience with BetGPT, your trusted ally for informed wagers.
BetGPT is available at no cost, with certain content accessible through a subscription.

Take control of your personal finances with Spentify (formerly Jamnay)—the simple, clean daily expense tracker and budget planner designed to help you monitor spending, track income, and save money effortlessly. 
Whether you want to manage household expenses, build a daily budget, or keep track of multiple wallets, Spentify makes managing money simple and stress-free.
KEY FEATURES TO HELP YOU SAVE MORE:
1. Fast Transaction Tracking
• Record daily spending and income in just seconds.
• Keep track of your monthly balance and see where your money goes.
2. Custom Category Budgets
• Set monthly budget limits for groceries, dining out, bills, and more.
• Get clear progress indicators so you stick to your financial goals.
3. Visual Reports & Analytics
• View clear, beautiful charts and statistics summarizing your cash flow.
• Identify spending habits and spot instant opportunities to save.

bluejetty:00030941:ios.name: CCM Exam Practice Test
bluejetty:00030941:ios.summary:
Prepare for the CCM exam with 350+ Certified Case Manager practice questions, detailed rationales, personalized study tools, timed exam practice, and the new Decode feature.
Created by Deanna Cooper Gillingham, RN, CCM, CCM Exam Practice Te
bluejetty:00030941:ios.description:
Prepare for the CCM exam with 350+ Certified Case Manager practice questions, detailed rationales, personalized study tools, timed exam practice, and the new Decode feature.
Created by Deanna Cooper Gillingham, RN, CCM, CCM Exam Practice Test is a dedicated Q&A resource for case managers preparing for the Certified Case Manager (CCM) examination.
NEW: DON'T JUST LEARN THE ANSWER. LEARN HOW TO FIND IT
The new Decode feature takes you beyond traditional answer rationales. After answering a question, tap Decode to turn it into a short lesson in CCM exam strategy.
Each Decode includes:
• Correct Answer – Quickly confirm the correct option and understand why it is the strongest choice. • Decoding Technique – Identify the question type, recognize important context clues, and learn which elimination strategy to use. • Reasoning – Review every option to understand why the correct answer works and why distractors do not. • Exam Tip – Learn a practical strategy you can apply to similar questions on exam day.
Instead of simply memorizing answers, Decode helps you practice the reasoning process behind finding the best answer.
350+ CCM PRACTICE QUESTIONS 
Practice with 350+ questions covering all six knowledge domains of the CCM exam. Practice by individual domain, focus on areas that need review, or practice across the complete exam blueprint.
PRACTICE ALL SIX CCM KNOWLEDGE DOMAINS 
• Care Management • Ethical, Legal, & Practice Standards • Psychosocial Concepts & Support Systems • Quality & Outcomes Evaluation & Measurement • Rehabilitation Concepts & Strategies • Reimbursement Methods
UNDERSTAND WHY 
Detailed rationales explain why an answer is correct and reinforce important case management concepts. Use Decode to go further by learning how to break down questions, recognize clues, evaluate options, and apply exam-taking strategies.
SIMULATE THE EXAM EXPERIENCE 
When you're ready to move beyond individual questions, use timed exam practice to simulate the testing experience. Practice pacing and time management, work through exam-style questions, apply knowledge across CCM domains, and identify topics that need additional review.
PRACTICE YOUR WAY
• Study mode • Exam mode • Timed practice • Domain-specific practice • Question bookmarks • Detailed rationales • Decode question analysis • Progress tracking • Strong and weak area identification • Study goals and reminders
FOCUS YOUR STUDY 
Use performance results to identify stronger and weaker knowledge areas. Focus your study time where you need it most, then return to practice questions to reinforce concepts and measure progress.
PRACTICE ANYTIME, ANYWHERE 
Answer CCM practice questions, practice individual knowledge domains, review detailed rationales, decode questions, strengthen exam strategy, practice in a timed environment, identify areas for additional study, and reinforce important case management concepts.
TRY BEFORE YOU BUY 
Download CCM Exam Practice Test FREE and explore sample questions before purchasing full access. Choose from available subscription options to unlock the complete question bank and study tools.
NEED MORE THAN PRACTICE QUESTIONS? 
CCM Certification Made Easy, also by Deanna Cooper Gillingham, RN, CCM, provides the full 4th Ed. study resource with author-narrated audio, CCMC blueprint coverage, and chapter review questions.
Use CCM Certification Made Easy to learn and review the material. Use CCM Exam Practice Test to practice applying what you know.
ABOUT THE AUTHOR 
Deanna Cooper Gillingham, RN, CCM, is the author of CCM Certification Made Easy and creator of CCM Exam Practice Test.
Publisher: Case Management Institute
Don't just learn the answer. Learn how to find it.

bluejetty:00140145:ios.description:
GlucoLog: Your Smart Glucose and Blood Sugar Tracker
GlucoLog is the ultimate app for individuals managing diabetes or tracking their blood sugar levels. Designed to be user-friendly and ad-free, this app provides seamless logging, tracking, and analysis of glucose data, ensuring you have everything you need at your fingertips for maintaining optimal health.
Whether you're managing Type 1 or Type 2 diabetes, gestational diabetes, or prediabetes, GlucoLog is built to support you with advanced tracking features. Our app helps you stay on top of your glucose levels, weight, insulin intake, blood pressure, medications, and much more.
Key Features:
Simple Glucose Logging: Track your blood sugar levels throughout the day. Just enter your data, tag it for time of day (before/after meals), and get a clear view of your glucose trends over time.
Personalized Reports: Export your logs as comprehensive reports for your doctor or share it with family members. Easily view trends and make informed decisions about your health.
Customizable Reminders: Never miss a blood sugar check with personalized reminders that fit your schedule. Whether you need to log readings before meals or just before bed, GlucoLog will keep you on track.
Comprehensive Tracking: In addition to blood sugar, GlucoLog lets you log insulin use, medications, carbohydrates, A1C, blood pressure, weight, and even ketones.
Visual Graphs & Data Insights: See all your vital health data in clean, easy-to-understand graphs. GlucoLog helps you identify trends in your glucose levels and other health metrics, so you can take action when necessary.
A1C Estimation: Keep tabs on your estimated A1C between doctor visits. Use this valuable feature to stay proactive about your health.
Completely Ad-Free Experience: Enjoy an uninterrupted, clean, and distraction-free experience. GlucoLog is designed to give you the information you need without annoying ads.
Dark Mode Support: For users who prefer a darker interface or like to use their phone at night, GlucoLog offers full Dark Mode support. This feature not only reduces eye strain but also makes nighttime logging more comfortable.
Tailored for Diabetes & Prediabetes: GlucoLog is perfect for both individuals with diabetes and those managing prediabetes, making it easy to track and control your blood sugar levels in any condition.
If you’re living with diabetes, you know that keeping your blood sugar levels within a healthy range is critical for avoiding complications. GlucoLog simplifies diabetes management by helping you track your glucose readings, insulin usage, and medication schedule all in one place. By maintaining accurate logs, you can spot trends, identify triggers for high or low blood sugar, and take steps to keep your diabetes under control.
GlucoLog is designed for people of all ages and experience levels. Whether you’re newly diagnosed or have been managing diabetes for years, the app’s user-friendly interface and powerful features make glucose tracking easy. From logging your first reading to analyzing your progress over time, GlucoLog is there to support you every step of the way.
Ready to take control of your blood sugar? Download GlucoLog today and experience the best glucose tracking app available. With its ad-free design, comprehensive features, and simple interface, GlucoLog is the perfect companion for managing your diabetes and maintaining a healthy lifestyle.
Privacy Policy: https://hussainmustafa.com/privacy-policy-glucolog/

bluejetty:00160317:ios.description:
Welcome to the ultimate location-tracking app that prioritizes your safety and keeps you connected with your loved ones. Ensure the safety of your loved ones by sharing and tracking their real-time locations, communicate seamlessly with in-app chat, and have peace of mind with the SOS button in emergencies. Download now and embark on a journey of enhanced security and togetherness.
KEY FEATURES:
*Create and Join Circles - form circles with your family and friends. Stay connected effortlessly, and never lose sight of those who matter most.
*Real-Time Location Sharing - share your live location with circle members. Effortlessly track your loved ones to ensure they are safe and sound.
*Chat in Real Time - communicate seamlessly within your circles. Share updates, make plans, and stay connected with the built-in chat feature.
*SOS Button for Emergencies - in times of need, use the SOS button for quick assistance. Alert your circle members and share your location in emergency situations.
Premium access
To access all the premium features and content, you need to subscribe or pay once for lifetime access. The cost of the purchase is charged to your iTunes account.
Subscriptions automatically renew and are billed at the rate and period you choose based on your subscription plan. User accounts are charged for auto-renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off in iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://maria-apps.com/policy 
Terms of Use: https://maria-apps.com/terms

bluejetty:00169057:ios.description:
Can't find your remote again? Introducing the TV Remote app! Say goodbye to the hassle of searching for your remote. Simply connect it to the same Wi-Fi network as your TV, you can effortlessly turn the TV on/off, switch channels, adjust the volume and manage content playback - just like a typical physical remote control. It even has a touchpad and voice input for added convenience. Enhance your TV experience with the TV Remote app today! 
Here are the guidelines for using the TV Remote:
1. Download and install the universal TV Remote app.
2. Select a TV that is connected to the same WiFi network.
3. Tap to connect.
4. Voila! The TV Remote control is now all set up.
Enjoy seamless control of your TV with these simple steps!
With the TV Remote app, you'll enjoy a range of convenient features:
- Automatic detection of TVs on the same WiFi network makes setup a breeze.
- Rapid TV control gives you instant access to volume adjustment, reverse, and fast forward functions.
- Experience smooth and efficient TV control with the touchpad feature.
- Swift text input and search functionality help you find your favorite shows and movies quickly.
- Power on/off your TV directly from your device including LED, OLED, 4K etc.
- Take advantage of voice search functionality for hands-free control.
- Just like a standard remote like AKB series, or Magic Remote
Enjoy the functionalities and features of the app at your own discretion.
For troubleshooting:
- The app can only connect to the same WiFi network as your TV device.
- For connection failure with TV, app reinstallation and TV reboot are suggested to resolve most issues.
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/tv-remote-ios-privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/tv-remote-ios-terms-of-use

bluejetty:00128355:ios.name: Flood Me - Color Switch Puzzle
bluejetty:00128355:ios.summary: Welcome to Flood Me, a liquid puzzle for brain training and relaxation! Most of us remember the Minesweeper, one of the first logic puzzles we all have encountered at different periods. But what happens, if you take the logical essence of a
bluejetty:00128355:ios.description:
Welcome to Flood Me, a liquid puzzle for brain training and relaxation! Most of us remember the Minesweeper, one of the first logic puzzles we all have encountered at different periods. But what happens, if you take the logical essence of a purely tactical game and combine it with something… pleasurable? Soft shapes of colored liquid figures will do the trick! Here you are – a perfect relaxing puzzle with vibrant visuals and smart gameplay. Just start the game and you will forget about everything!
Liquid core, solid rules
● There is a playing field with liquid squares on it. Each figure has its own size, shape, and color.
● Under the main field, you will see six colors. Choose a color and change the color of any figure on the field.
● When there are several same color figures nearby, they merge into a bigger figure. You get points for each successful merge.
● Keep an eye on the number of moves left. 
● Merge figures as wise as you can. Make the right decisions, raise your score and win!
Relax and enjoy
● The game has a very mild and neat color scheme. Pastel colors will soothe your mind after a hard day.
● All the shapes and figures have round angles. It means that there are no “sharp” edges. Stay smooth!
● A combination of both colors and shapes creates a friendly and safe atmosphere. Forget about stress!
● Amazing level themes are creating a special atmosphere! Dive into the new world every time you play! 
Just FLOOD ME!
● The game has 2 playing modes: Single Mode, and Versus Mode.
● You lose in Versus if your opponent scored most of the figures on the field.
● There is no timer in both modes. Just enjoy the process!
● Daily challenges in a hexa puzzle style. Complete it 7 days in a row and collect extra rewards. 
● Watch out for the secret tiles and chain tiles. They need more attention. 
● A secret tile is indicated by the question mark. You never know what color it is hiding.
● You will need to color the chain tiles twice to open them. 
Boost the Fun
Sometimes, especially in the tensest moments, you would want to reverse your choice or get some help. We are ready to give you a hand! Choose between several useful boosters that will aid you in your mind battle:
● Magnet – pulls the figures in a close range with the same color on tap.
● Bucket – fills the chosen area with a certain color.
● Shuffle – swaps all tiles on the playing field at once.

apple-macos:6761471179.name: Hoodik: Private Cloud Storage
apple-macos:6761471179.description:
Hoodik is the client for your own Hoodik cloud storage server. Every file is encrypted on your device before it leaves, so the server never sees your data.
YOUR FILES. YOUR KEYS. YOUR SERVER.
All encryption and decryption happens locally on your device using native Rust cryptography. The server stores only ciphertext, and your private key never leaves your device. Not even the server administrator can read your files.
FEATURES
• Quantum-Proof Encryption: post-quantum hybrid key wrapping (X25519 + ML-KEM-768) with Ed25519 identities, so your files stay private even against future quantum computers. Each file gets its own key, sealed so only you can open it.
• Secure Sign-In: login uses OPAQUE, so your password is never sent to the server. Existing accounts upgrade to the new encryption automatically the next time you log in.
• Fast Chunked Transfers: upload and download large files with concurrent chunked transfers, real-time progress, and integrity checks. Where the server allows it, chunks move straight between your device and its storage. Interrupted transfers pick up where they stopped.
• Encrypted Sharing: share files and folders with other Hoodik users end-to-end encrypted, with reader, editor, and co-owner roles and group sharing. Or create public links with the decryption key in the URL fragment, so recipients get the file without ever seeing your key.
• Markdown Notes: write encrypted notes in a full markdown editor with version history. Notes sync to your server like any other file, ciphertext only.
• File Preview: view images, videos, PDFs, and text files decrypted locally on your device.
• Work On Many At Once: select several files and export or pin them in one go.
• Privacy-Preserving Search: find notes by what is written inside them, not only by their names. Words are tokenized on your device under keys the server never holds, so it matches a query without learning a word of it.
• Offline Access: pin files for offline use. Cached files stay encrypted on disk, and you set how much room the cache may take before older unpinned copies go.
• PIN & Biometric Unlock: protect your account with a PIN or Touch ID / Face ID.
• AI Access on Mac: a built-in MCP server lets local AI assistants work with your files on your terms, secured with a token you control. Decryption still happens only on your device.
• Multi-Server Support: connect to multiple Hoodik servers with different accounts.
• Light and Dark: pick the appearance in Account, or follow the system. Menus and navigation follow each platform's own conventions.
SECURITY YOU CAN TRUST
Hoodik uses modern, post-quantum cryptography: hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-768 key wrapping, Ed25519 signatures, and AEGIS-128L and AEGIS-256 for fast hardware-accelerated encryption, with Ascon-128a and ChaCha20-Poly1305 as alternatives. Login uses OPAQUE so your password never crosses the network, and SHA-256 and BLAKE2b handle hashing and integrity. Older accounts using RSA-2048 migrate to the new keys automatically.
FULLY AUDITABLE
The complete source code of the app is published on GitHub, and the Rust crypto engine is shared across every Hoodik client. Read the code, build it yourself, verify every claim:
https://github.com/hudikhq/hoodik-client
NO TRACKING. NO ANALYTICS. NO ADS.
Hoodik contains no analytics SDKs, no crash reporting tools, and no advertising frameworks. We don't track how you use the app.
WHAT YOU NEED
Hoodik connects to a Hoodik server. Run one yourself on your own hardware, or let us run a private instance for you at https://hoodik.cloud. Either way, your files are encrypted on your device first, so nobody who operates the server can read them, us included.
The server's source code is published, and it's free for personal use:
https://github.com/hudikhq/hoodik
Deploy in minutes with Docker.
Privacy Policy: https://hoodik.io/privacy-policy
